13.m: through that [external perception], that which is beyond perception is to be apprehended. / His earthy quality is firmness, for it is by his quality that she [the earth] is firm. // 43

13.s:
parasparānubhāvena saṃvṛttau tadupāruhet |
āhlādo yastadīyo'pi satoye copalabhyate || 44 ||
13.d:
परस्परानुभावेन संवृत्तौ तदुपारुहेत् |
आह्लादो यस्तदीयोऽपि सतोये चोपलभ्यते || 44 ||
13.m: When they coalesce through mutual influence, it ascends there. / The delight which is his is perceived also in water; // 44

13.s:
toye guṇastu tasyāsti kathaṃ syādanyathā mune |
smṛtamātreṇa mantreṇa āhlādo mānaso mahān || 45 ||
13.d:
तोये गुणस्तु तस्यास्ति कथं स्यादन्यथा मुने |
स्मृतमात्रेण मन्त्रेण आह्लादो मानसो महान् || 45 ||
13.m: and its quality is present in water; how else could it be, O sage, / that by merely remembering the mantra a great mental delight arises? // 45

13.s:
rūpātmanā pariṇatassacāgnau pārameśvaraḥ |
yo rūpākhyo guṇaścāgnessamantrātmani tiṣṭhati || 46 ||
13.d:
रूपात्मना परिणतस्सचाग्नौ पारमेश्वरः |
यो रूपाख्यो गुणश्चाग्नेस्समन्त्रात्मनि तिष्ठति || 46 ||
13.m: That quality of fire, supreme lordly, transformed as visible form, / which is called the quality of form in fire, abides in the mantra-self, // 46

13.s:
tejo vinā yato dhyānaṃ kutracinnopalabhyate |
sparśadharmo hi yo vāyossa tadīyo mahāmate || 47 ||
13.d:
तेजो विना यतो ध्यानं कुत्रचिन्नोपलभ्यते |
स्पर्शधर्मो हि यो वायोस्स तदीयो महामते || 47 ||
13.m: since without radiance meditation is nowhere perceived. / That property of touch which belongs to wind is his, O highly intelligent one; // 47

13.s:
yo vāyavyo guṇassūkṣmassa ca mantratanau sthitaḥ |
sa cāntaḥkaraṇe caiva saṃhṛte syāttadutthitaḥ || 48 ||
13.d:
यो वायव्यो गुणस्सूक्ष्मस्स च मन्त्रतनौ स्थितः |
स चान्तःकरणे चैव संहृते स्यात्तदुत्थितः || 48 ||
13.m: that subtle quality of wind is situated in the body of the mantra, / and it arises from it when the internal organ is withdrawn. // 48

13.s:
yadākāśasya śūnyatvamasti tasmāttadudbhavaḥ |
sa mantrātmani saṃviṣṭo guṇo hyasminmahāmate || 49 ||
13.d:
यदाकाशस्य शून्यत्वमस्ति तस्मात्तदुद्भवः |
स मन्त्रात्मनि संविष्टो गुणो ह्यस्मिन्महामते || 49 ||
13.m: That voidness which belongs to space has its source in him; / for that quality entered into the mantra-self is in this [space], O highly intelligent one. // 49

13.s:
p. 101) agrāhyatvācca karaṇaiḥ prākṛtairbhāvanāṃ vinā |
ityevaṃ mantrasāmarthyaṃ purā jñātvā yathārthataḥ || 50 ||
13.d:
प्. 101) अग्राह्यत्वाच्च करणैः प्राकृतैर्भावनां विना |
इत्येवं मन्त्रसामर्थ्यं पुरा ज्ञात्वा यथार्थतः || 50 ||
13.m: And because he cannot be grasped by material organs without creative contemplation, / having thus understood correctly the power of the mantra beforehand, // 50

13.s: [mudrāmantrapūrvakamāvāhanam]
13.d: [मुद्रामन्त्रपूर्वकमावाहनम्]
13.m: [The invocation preceded by mudrā and mantra]

13.s:
sannidhānaṃ bhavedyena pūjākāle hyupasthite |
mudrāsamanvito mantro ya āvāhanasaṃjñitaḥ || 51 ||
13.d:
सन्निधानं भवेद्येन पूजाकाले ह्युपस्थिते |
मुद्रासमन्वितो मन्त्रो य आवाहनसंज्ञितः || 51 ||
13.m: by which presence is effected when the time of worship has arrived: / with the mudrā accompanying the mantra known as invocation, // 51

13.s:
pūrakeṇa dvijaśreṣṭha manasā samudīrayet |
samāhūya tataḥ paścānmūrtimantreṇa cetasā || 52 ||
13.d:
पूरकेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मनसा समुदीरयेत् |
समाहूय ततः पश्चान्मूर्तिमन्त्रेण चेतसा || 52 ||
13.m: he should recite it mentally during inhalation, O best of the twice-born. / Having called [him] then mentally with the mūrtimantra, // 52

13.s:
dhyānoktāṃ kalpayenmūrttiṃ tasya hṛtpadmamadhyagām |
pareṇādhiṣṭhitaṃ dhyāyenmūlamantraṃ jvalatprabham || 53 ||
13.d:
ध्यानोक्तां कल्पयेन्मूर्त्तिं तस्य हृत्पद्ममध्यगाम् |
परेणाधिष्ठितं ध्यायेन्मूलमन्त्रं ज्वलत्प्रभम् || 53 ||
13.m: he should fashion his form, described in the meditation, as positioned in the center of the heart-lotus; / he should meditate on the root-mantra, blazing with light, presided over by the Supreme. // 53

13.s: [āvāhitasya tasya saṃukhīkaraṇam]
13.d: [आवाहितस्य तस्य संउखीकरणम्]
13.m: [Facing the invoked Lord]

13.s:
sammukhīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmantramūrterdvijātmanaḥ |
ātmamantrādito bhūyo mantraissarvaiśca pūrvavat || 54 ||
13.d:
सम्मुखीकरणं कुर्यान्मन्त्रमूर्तेर्द्विजात्मनः |
आत्ममन्त्रादितो भूयो मन्त्रैस्सर्वैश्च पूर्ववत् || 54 ||
13.m: He should face the mantra-embodiment of the twice-born soul / starting from the ātmamantra again with all the mantras as before. // 54

13.s:
karanyāsaṃ vinā dehe nyāsaṃ tasya ca saṃsmaret |
puṣpamarghyaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ mālyaṃ vilepanam || 55 ||
13.d:
करन्यासं विना देहे न्यासं तस्य च संस्मरेत् |
पुष्पमर्घ्यं तथा धूपं दीपं माल्यं विलेपनम् || 55 ||
13.m: Leaving out the installation on the hands, he should visualize the installation on his body; / flowers, arghya-water, incense, a lamp, a garland, anointing unguent, // 55

13.s:
cetasā sādareṇaiva pādyapūrvaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ |
praṇāmamatha cāṣṭāṅgaṃ jayaśabdāṃśca mānasān || 56 ||
13.d:
चेतसा सादरेणैव पाद्यपूर्वं च भक्तितः |
प्रणाममथ चाष्टाङ्गं जयशब्दांश्च मानसान् || 56 ||
13.m: along with water for washing the feet, [offered] through the mind with reverence and devotion; / then an eight-limbed prostration and mental shouts of victory; // 56

13.s:
kṛtvā bhagavate brahmamudrāṃ vai saṃpradarśayet |
svāgataṃ tava deveśa sannidhiṃ bhajame'cyuta || 57 ||
13.d:
कृत्वा भगवते ब्रह्ममुद्रां वै संप्रदर्शयेत् |
स्वागतं तव देवेश सन्निधिं भजमेऽच्युत || 57 ||
13.m: having done this, he should show the Brahmamudrā to the Lord: / “Welcome to you, O Lord of the gods! Abide in my presence, O Acyuta! // 57

13.s:
gṛhāṇa mānasīṃ pūjāṃ yathārthaparibhāvitām |
jñātvā tu suprasannaṃ taṃ prasādābhimukhaṃ prabhum || 58 ||
13.d:
गृहाण मानसीं पूजां यथार्थपरिभाविताम् |
ज्ञात्वा तु सुप्रसन्नं तं प्रसादाभिमुखं प्रभुम् || 58 ||
13.m: Accept this mental worship, conceived in its true nature!” / Then, knowing that Lord to be gracious and inclined toward benevolence, // 58

13.s: [atha vistareṇa mānasayāgārambhaḥ]
13.d: [अथ विस्तरेण मानसयागारम्भः]
13.m: [Now the beginning of the mental sacrifice in detail]

13.s:
vistareṇa dvijaśreṣṭha mānasaṃ yāgamārabhet |
saṅkalpajanitairdravyaiḥ pavitrairakṣayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 59 ||
13.d:
विस्तरेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मानसं यागमारभेत् |
सङ्कल्पजनितैर्द्रव्यैः पवित्रैरक्षयैः शुभैः || 59 ||
13.m: he should begin the mental sacrifice in detail, O best of the twice-born, / with pure, inexhaustible, and auspicious substances produced from his volition. // 59

13.s:
sarvakāmapradaṃ devaṃ mantramūrttidharaṃ yajet |
abhyaṅgodvartane pūrvaṃ snānaṃ cātha vilepanam || 60 ||
13.d:
सर्वकामप्रदं देवं मन्त्रमूर्त्तिधरं यजेत् |
अभ्यङ्गोद्वर्तने पूर्वं स्नानं चाथ विलेपनम् || 60 ||
13.m: He should worship the god who grants all desires and bears the form of the mantra: / first inunction and massage, then bathing and anointing unguent; // 60

13.s:
vastrapūrvāṇi mālyāni sugandhāni nivedya ca |
hārakeyūrakaṭakairmukuṭairbhūṣitaṃ smaret || 61 ||
13.d:
वस्त्रपूर्वाणि माल्यानि सुगन्धानि निवेद्य च |
हारकेयूरकटकैर्मुकुटैर्भूषितं स्मरेत् || 61 ||
13.m: and having offered fragrant garments, garlands, and the like, / he should visualize him adorned with necklaces, armlets, bracelets, and crowns, // 61

13.s:
citreṇa kaṭisūtreṇa hemaratnamayena ca |
māṇikyaracitaiśśuddhairmuktāhāraiśca bhūṣayet || 62 ||
13.d:
चित्रेण कटिसूत्रेण हेमरत्नमयेन च |
माणिक्यरचितैश्शुद्धैर्मुक्ताहारैश्च भूषयेत् || 62 ||
13.m: and with a variegated waist-band made of gold and gems; / he should adorn him with pure pearl necklaces fashioned with rubies; // 62

13.s:
p. 102) saṃpūrṇendusamānaṃ ca hemadaṇḍasamanvitam |
chatraṃ nivedayedviṣṇormāyūraṃ vyajanaṃ śubham || 63 ||
13.d:
प्. 102) संपूर्णेन्दुसमानं च हेमदण्डसमन्वितम् |
छत्रं निवेदयेद्विष्णोर्मायूरं व्यजनं शुभम् || 63 ||
13.m: and he should present to Viṣṇu a parasol resembling the full moon / and fitted with a golden handle, and an auspicious fan of peacock feathers; // 63

13.s:
karpūracūrṇasaṃmiśraṃ sugandhi madhuraṃ bahu |
dhūpaṃ bhagavate datvā dīpamālāṃ ghṛtena ca || 64 ||
13.d:
कर्पूरचूर्णसंमिश्रं सुगन्धि मधुरं बहु |
धूपं भगवते दत्वा दीपमालां घृतेन च || 64 ||
13.m: having offered the Lord abundant sweet, fragrant incense / blended with camphor powder, and a row of lamps with ghee, // 64

13.s:
madhusarpiḥplutaṃ cātha madhuparkaṃ nivedya ca |
paśuṃ ca vividhaṃ mūrtaṃ pāvanaṃ śakuniṃ tathā || 65 ||
13.d:
मधुसर्पिःप्लुतं चाथ मधुपर्कं निवेद्य च |
पशुं च विविधं मूर्तं पावनं शकुनिं तथा || 65 ||
13.m: and having presented honey-mixture overflowing with honey and clarified butter, / and various kinds of animals, represented mentally, and pure birds, // 65

13.s:
auṣadhīśśālidūrvāṃ ca satphalāḍhyaṃ vanaspatim |
mūrtaṃ nivedayetpūrvamidamannaṃ caturvidham || 66 ||
13.d:
औषधीश्शालिदूर्वां च सत्फलाढ्यं वनस्पतिम् |
मूर्तं निवेदयेत्पूर्वमिदमन्नं चतुर्विधम् || 66 ||
13.m: herbs, śāli rice, and dūrvā grass, and trees rich with fine fruits, / he should first present this fourfold food in visualized form, // 66

13.s:
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ śuddhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyānyanekaśaḥ |
hṛdyāni phalamūlāni ṣaḍ-ṛtuprabhavāni ca || 67 ||
13.d:
नैवेद्यं विविधं शुद्धं भक्ष्यभोज्यान्यनेकशः |
हृद्यानि फलमूलानि षड्-ऋतुप्रभवानि च || 67 ||
13.m: manifold pure food-offerings, various foods to chew and eat, / and delightful fruits and roots produced in all six seasons. // 67

13.s:
ṣaḍrasāni ca citrāṇi pānānyatha nivedya ca |
sarvāṇyātmopabhogyāni bhaktiśraddhāvaśāddvija || 68 ||
13.d:
षड्रसानि च चित्राणि पानान्यथ निवेद्य च |
सर्वाण्यात्मोपभोग्यानि भक्तिश्रद्धावशाद्द्विज || 68 ||
13.m: And then, having offered various drinks endowed with the six tastes, / everything fit for his own enjoyment, impelled by devotion and faith, O twice-born, // 68

13.s:
prāgdikṣvapyaviruddhāni devāya vinivedayet |
tantrīvādyānyanekāni nṛttageyānvitāni ca || 69 ||
13.d:
प्राग्दिक्ष्वप्यविरुद्धानि देवाय विनिवेदयेत् |
तन्त्रीवाद्यान्यनेकानि नृत्तगेयान्वितानि च || 69 ||
13.m: and also things not prohibited, [facing] the eastern directions, he should offer [them] to the Lord: / numerous stringed instruments accompanied by dance and singing, // 69

13.s:
bherīpaṭahaghoṣādistutipāṭhānvitāni ca |
cintayeddevadevasya lokatrayagatāni ca || 70 ||
13.d:
भेरीपटहघोषादिस्तुतिपाठान्वितानि च |
चिन्तयेद्देवदेवस्य लोकत्रयगतानि च || 70 ||
13.m: and accompanied by the sounds of kettle-drums and tabors, and recitations of praise; / and he should contemplate [all these], throughout the three worlds, belonging to the God of gods. // 70

13.s:
kiṅkiṇījālayuktena cāmareṇopavījya ca |
vitānakaṃ patākāśca dhvajāni vividhāni ca || 71 ||
13.d:
किङ्किणीजालयुक्तेन चामरेणोपवीज्य च |
वितानकं पताकाश्च ध्वजानि विविधानि च || 71 ||
13.m: And having fanned him with a fly-whisk fitted with a cluster of small bells, / and having presented a canopy, banners, and various flags // 71

13.s:
vinivedya vibhorbhaktyā prasannenāntarātmanā |
gajāśvadhenuyānāni suvastrālaṅkṛtāni ca || 72 ||
13.d:
विनिवेद्य विभोर्भक्त्या प्रसन्नेनान्तरात्मना |
गजाश्वधेनुयानानि सुवस्त्रालङ्कृतानि च || 72 ||
13.m: to the Lord with devotion, with a serene inner self, / and having offered elephants, horses, cows, and vehicles adorned with fine garments, // 72

13.s:
nivedya cāntarā tāni grāhayantaṃ smarettataḥ |
ātmānaṃ sasutāndārāṃstasmai ca namasā yutān || 73 ||
13.d:
निवेद्य चान्तरा तानि ग्राहयन्तं स्मरेत्ततः |
आत्मानं ससुतान्दारांस्तस्मै च नमसा युतान् || 73 ||
13.m: he should then remember him within, making [him] accept them. / And having offered himself together with his sons and wives, bowing down // 73

13.s:
nivedya praṇato mūrdhnā ānandāśrusamanvitaḥ |
kāmadhenumayīṃ mudrāṃ manasā mantrasaṃyutām || 74 ||
13.d:
निवेद्य प्रणतो मूर्ध्ना आनन्दाश्रुसमन्वितः |
कामधेनुमयीं मुद्रां मनसा मन्त्रसंयुताम् || 74 ||
13.m: with his head bowed, filled with tears of joy, / having mentally formed the mudrā consisting of Kāmadhenu, joined with mantra, // 74

13.s:
badhvā saṃcintayedviṣṇossarvakāmaprapūraṇīm |
hṛdvyomapuṣkarāgrasthaṃ devamiṣṭvā jagadgurum || 75 ||
13.d:
बध्वा संचिन्तयेद्विष्णोस्सर्वकामप्रपूरणीम् |
हृद्व्योमपुष्कराग्रस्थं देवमिष्ट्वा जगद्गुरुम् || 75 ||
13.m: he should contemplate it as fulfilling all desires of Viṣṇu. / Having worshipped the God, the guru of the world, residing on the lotus at the summit of the sky of the heart, // 75

13.s: samastamantradehaṃ tu sakalaṃ niṣkalātmakam |
13.d: समस्तमन्त्रदेहं तु सकलं निष्कलात्मकम् |
13.m: whose body consists of all mantras, with form yet having the nature of the formless:

13.s: [lakṣmyādyaṅgapūjanam tatralayayāgādibhedaḥ]
13.d: [लक्ष्म्याद्यङ्गपूजनम् तत्रलययागादिभेदः]
13.m: [Worship of the ancillary deities such as Lakṣmī; the division into dissolution sacrifice and the others therein]

13.s: śaktayaścāṅgaṣaṭkaṃ ca lāṃchanaṃ kamalādikam || 76 ||
13.d: शक्तयश्चाङ्गषट्कं च लांछनं कमलादिकम् || 76 ||
13.m: the śaktis, the group of six limbs, the insignia such as the lotus, // 76

13.s:
bhūṣaṇaṃ kaustubhādyaṃ ca vadanānāṃ tathā trayam |
p. 103) satyādyā mūrtayaścaiva dehe devasya bhāvitāḥ || 77 ||
13.d:
भूषणं कौस्तुभाद्यं च वदनानां तथा त्रयम् |
प्. 103) सत्याद्या मूर्तयश्चैव देहे देवस्य भाविताः || 77 ||
13.m: the ornament such as the Kaustubha, and likewise the triad of faces, / and the forms such as Satya conceived in the body of the God, // 77

13.s:
vyāpayya ca tathātvena sve sve sthāne tathātmakāḥ |
taddehasaṃsthitāssarve pūjanīyāḥ krameṇa tu || 78 ||
13.d:
व्यापय्य च तथात्वेन स्वे स्वे स्थाने तथात्मकाः |
तद्देहसंस्थितास्सर्वे पूजनीयाः क्रमेण तु || 78 ||
13.m: having pervaded as such, having that nature, in each respective place, / all of them situated in his body are to be worshipped in order // 78

13.s:
parivāraṃ vinā mantraiḥ svaiḥ svaiḥ puṣpānulepanaiḥ |
layayāgo hyayaṃ vipra lakṣmyādiṣvanukīrtitaḥ || 79 ||
13.d:
परिवारं विना मन्त्रैः स्वैः स्वैः पुष्पानुलेपनैः |
लययागो ह्ययं विप्र लक्ष्म्यादिष्वनुकीर्तितः || 79 ||
13.m: without retinue, with their respective mantras, flowers, and unguents. / For this, O vipra, is proclaimed as the dissolution sacrifice regarding Lakṣmī and the others. // 79

13.s:
tasmāddhṛtkarṇikādhāre mūrtau vā yatra kutracit |
mūlamantraśarīrasthaṃ parivāraṃ yajetsadā || 80 ||
13.d:
तस्माद्धृत्कर्णिकाधारे मूर्तौ वा यत्र कुत्रचित् |
मूलमन्त्रशरीरस्थं परिवारं यजेत्सदा || 80 ||
13.m: Therefore, in the receptacle of the pericarp of the heart, or in an image, or anywhere else, / he should always worship the retinue located in the body of the root-mantra. // 80

13.s:
yāga eṣa layākhyastu saṃkṣiptassarvasiddhidaḥ |
mantrarāṭ karṇikāmadhye lakṣmyādyāḥ kesarādiṣu || 81 ||
13.d:
याग एष लयाख्यस्तु संक्षिप्तस्सर्वसिद्धिदः |
मन्त्रराट् कर्णिकामध्ये लक्ष्म्याद्याः केसरादिषु || 81 ||
13.m: This sacrifice, called dissolution, is concise and yields all accomplishments. / Where the king of mantras is in the middle of the pericarp, Lakṣmī and the others are on the filaments and so forth, // 81

13.s:
sākārāḥ kevalāssarve yatra bhogābhidhassa tu |
kevalena ca yāgena pṛthagbhūtena nārada || 82 ||
13.d:
साकाराः केवलास्सर्वे यत्र भोगाभिधस्स तु |
केवलेन च यागेन पृथग्भूतेन नारद || 82 ||
13.m: and all are endowed with form and distinct, that is named [the sacrifice] of enjoyment. / And where the worship of the lotus and the others is performed by an isolated, // 82

13.s:
pūjanaṃ kamalādīnāmadhikārābhidhassa tu |
sāṃprataṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ bhogayāgārthameva ca || 83 ||
13.d:
पूजनं कमलादीनामधिकाराभिधस्स तु |
सांप्रतं सर्वमन्त्राणां भोगयागार्थमेव च || 83 ||
13.m: separate sacrifice, that is named [the sacrifice] of dominion, O Nārada. / Now, for the sake of the enjoyment sacrifice of all mantras, // 83

13.s:
hṛtpadme tu vibhāgena vinyāsamavadhāraya |
pūrvabhāge vibhorlakṣmīṃ kesarasthāṃ ca vinyaset || 84 ||
13.d:
हृत्पद्मे तु विभागेन विन्यासमवधारय |
पूर्वभागे विभोर्लक्ष्मीं केसरस्थां च विन्यसेत् || 84 ||
13.m: comprehend the installation according to division in the lotus of the heart. / In the eastern part of the Lord, on a filament, he should install Lakṣmī; // 84

13.s:
kīrttiṃ dakṣiṇatastasya pṛṣṭatastu jayāṃ hareḥ |
tasyaiva cottare bhāge māyāṃ kesaragāṃ nyaset || 85 ||
13.d:
कीर्त्तिं दक्षिणतस्तस्य पृष्टतस्तु जयां हरेः |
तस्यैव चोत्तरे भागे मायां केसरगां न्यसेत् || 85 ||
13.m: Kīrti to the south of him, Jayā behind Hari, / and on the northern part of him he should install Māyā, residing on a filament. // 85

13.s:
vidukṣvaṅgāni vinyasya kesareṣūpari dvija |
pūrvayāmyāntare viṣṇorhṛnmantraṃ viniveśya ca || 86 ||
13.d:
विदुक्ष्वङ्गानि विन्यस्य केसरेषूपरि द्विज |
पूर्वयाम्यान्तरे विष्णोर्हृन्मन्त्रं विनिवेश्य च || 86 ||
13.m: Having installed the limbs in the intermediate directions upon the filaments, O twice-born, / and having placed the heart-mantra between the east and south of Viṣṇu, // 86

13.s:
śiraḥpūrvottare dadyācchikhāṃ paścimadakṣiṇe |
paścimottaradiṅmadhye kavacaṃ vinyasedvibhoḥ || 87 ||
13.d:
शिरःपूर्वोत्तरे दद्याच्छिखां पश्चिमदक्षिणे |
पश्चिमोत्तरदिङ्मध्ये कवचं विन्यसेद्विभोः || 87 ||
13.m: he should place the head in the north-east, the tuft in the south-west, / and he should install the armour of the Lord in the middle of the north-western direction. // 87

13.s:
agrataḥ kesaroddeśe netraṃ dikṣvastrameva ca |
dakṣiṇe mantranāthasya padmapatre nṛkesarī || 88 ||
13.d:
अग्रतः केसरोद्देशे नेत्रं दिक्ष्वस्त्रमेव च |
दक्षिणे मन्त्रनाथस्य पद्मपत्रे नृकेसरी || 88 ||
13.m: In front, in the region of the filament, the eye; and the weapon in the [four cardinal] directions. / On the lotus-petal to the south of the lord of mantras, the Man-Lion; // 88

13.s:
kapilaḥ paścimenyasyo varāhaścottare dale |
kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca vibhoḥ pūrvadalāntare || 89 ||
13.d:
कपिलः पश्चिमेन्यस्यो वराहश्चोत्तरे दले |
कौस्तुभं वनमालां च विभोः पूर्वदलान्तरे || 89 ||
13.m: Kapila is to be installed in the west, and the Boar on the northern petal; / the Kaustubha and the garland of forest flowers in the middle of the eastern petal of the Lord; // 89

13.s:
nṛsihmakroḍamantrābhyāṃ samīpe taddaladvaye |
padmaśaṅkhau tu vinyasya gadācakre tathaiva ca || 90 ||
13.d:
नृसिह्मक्रोडमन्त्राभ्यां समीपे तद्दलद्वये |
पद्मशङ्खौ तु विन्यस्य गदाचक्रे तथैव च || 90 ||
13.m: on the two petals near those of the mantras of the Man-Lion and the Boar, / having installed the lotus and conch, and likewise the mace and discus; // 90

13.s:
samīpe ratnamālāṃ ca garuḍaṃ nātidūrataḥ |
pāśaṃ ca tatsamīpe tu gadāyā nikaṭe'ṅkuśam || 91 ||
13.d:
समीपे रत्नमालां च गरुडं नातिदूरतः |
पाशं च तत्समीपे तु गदाया निकटेऽङ्कुशम् || 91 ||
13.m: and nearby, the necklace of gems, and Garuḍa not too far away; / the noose near it, and the goad close to the mace. // 91

13.s:
aniruddhādyupāṅgāni patrāgreṣu tu vinyaset |
p. 104) saummāpyadakṣiṇe pūrve karṇikāsaṃsthitasya ca || 92 ||
13.d:
अनिरुद्धाद्युपाङ्गानि पत्राग्रेषु तु विन्यसेत् |
प्. 104) सौम्माप्यदक्षिणे पूर्वे कर्णिकासंस्थितस्य च || 92 ||
13.m: He should install the secondary limbs such as Aniruddha on the tips of the petals; / on the north, west, south, and east of the one situated on the pericarp, // 92

13.s:
tadīśapatrādārabhya dalāgreṣu caturṣvapi |
satyamantraṃ tu vinyasya yāvadvāyudalāvadhi || 93 ||
13.d:
तदीशपत्रादारभ्य दलाग्रेषु चतुर्ष्वपि |
सत्यमन्त्रं तु विन्यस्य यावद्वायुदलावधि || 93 ||
13.m: and having installed the Satyamantra on all four petal-tips, / beginning from its north-eastern petal up to the limit of the wind-petal. // 93

13.s:
brahmarandhrādviniṣkrānte mūlamantrasya nārada |
prabhānāle nirādhāre pracaradraśmipallave || 94 ||
13.d:
ब्रह्मरन्ध्राद्विनिष्क्रान्ते मूलमन्त्रस्य नारद |
प्रभानाले निराधारे प्रचरद्रश्मिपल्लवे || 94 ||
13.m: Having emerged from the aperture of Brahman of the root-mantra, O Nārada, / upon a stalk of light, supportless, with shoots of radiant rays spreading, // 94

13.s:
ānandakesarākīrṇe mahānandākhyakarṇike |
nyasetsaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ niṣkalaṃ tu ca kevalam || 95 ||
13.d:
आनन्दकेसराकीर्णे महानन्दाख्यकर्णिके |
न्यसेत्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं निष्कलं तु च केवलम् || 95 ||
13.m: crowded with filaments of bliss, whose pericarp is called great bliss, / he should install the seven-syllable mantra, formless and pure. // 95

13.s:
yadvai tadbhāvabhāvitvametāvattasya pūjanam |
saṅkalpajanitairbhogairvikalpapadavartibhiḥ || 96 ||
13.d:
यद्वै तद्भावभावित्वमेतावत्तस्य पूजनम् |
सङ्कल्पजनितैर्भोगैर्विकल्पपदवर्तिभिः || 96 ||
13.m: To the extent that there is immersion in that state, such is his worship. / With objects of enjoyment produced by mental resolve, belonging to the plane of conceptual thought, // 96

13.s:
kathaṃ syātpūjanaṃ tasya yatastebhyaḥ sthitaḥ pare |
nyasyaivaṃ mantrasaṅghaṃ tu pūrvavatpūjayetkramāt || 97 ||
13.d:
कथं स्यात्पूजनं तस्य यतस्तेभ्यः स्थितः परे |
न्यस्यैवं मन्त्रसङ्घं तु पूर्ववत्पूजयेत्क्रमात् || 97 ||
13.m: how could there be worship of him, since he stands beyond them? / Having thus installed the collection of mantras, he should worship them in sequence as before, // 97

13.s:
dhyātvaikaikaṃ svamantreṇa taddhyānamavadhāraya |
bhogasthāne ca mantrāṇāṃ yatsadā saṃprayojayet || 98 ||
13.d:
ध्यात्वैकैकं स्वमन्त्रेण तद्ध्यानमवधारय |
भोगस्थाने च मन्त्राणां यत्सदा संप्रयोजयेत् || 98 ||
13.m: having contemplated each one with its own mantra. Comprehend that visualization / which he should always apply in the locus of enjoyment of the mantras. // 98

13.s:
yatpūrvaṃ kathitaṃ rūpaṃ mantrāṇāṃ niṣkalaṃ mayā |
sakalena bahisthena churitaṃ bhāvayettataḥ || 99 ||
13.d:
यत्पूर्वं कथितं रूपं मन्त्राणां निष्कलं मया |
सकलेन बहिस्थेन छुरितं भावयेत्ततः || 99 ||
13.m: The formless nature of the mantras that was previously described by me— / he should then conceive it as overlaid with the formed [nature] situated outside, // 99

13.s:
nirmalaṃ sphaṭikaṃ yadvaduparāgeṇa kenacit |
sphaṭikaṃ coparāgasya nāntaraṃ saṃviśedyathā || 100 ||
13.d:
निर्मलं स्फटिकं यद्वदुपरागेण केनचित् |
स्फटिकं चोपरागस्य नान्तरं संविशेद्यथा || 100 ||
13.m: just as pure crystal [is overlaid] by some tint; / and just as the crystal does not enter into the interior of the tint, // 100

13.s:
uparāgastvanicchātassaṃviśetsphaṭikāntaram |
evaṃ hi sakalaṃ rūpaṃ niṣkalena saha smaret || 101 ||
13.d:
उपरागस्त्वनिच्छातस्संविशेत्स्फटिकान्तरम् |
एवं हि सकलं रूपं निष्कलेन सह स्मरेत् || 101 ||
13.m: yet the tint, without intention, enters into the interior of the crystal, / even so he should remember the formed state together with the formless. // 101

13.s:
bhogasthānagatasyaiva viddhi taccobhayātmakam |
adhikārapadasthasya mantrasya munisattama || 102 ||
13.d:
भोगस्थानगतस्यैव विद्धि तच्चोभयात्मकम् |
अधिकारपदस्थस्य मन्त्रस्य मुनिसत्तम || 102 ||
13.m: Know that this belonging to the locus of enjoyment has both natures. / For the mantra situated in the plane of dominion, O best of sages, // 102

13.s:
sakalaṃ yojayeddhyānaṃ tasya hṛptadmamadhyagam |
nirādhārasthitaṃ dhyāyettadrūpaṃ niṣkalaṃ tu tat || 103 ||
13.d:
सकलं योजयेद्ध्यानं तस्य हृप्तद्ममध्यगम् |
निराधारस्थितं ध्यायेत्तद्रूपं निष्कलं तु तत् || 103 ||
13.m: he should apply formed meditation, going into the middle of its heart-lotus; / but he should meditate on that formless nature as resting without support. // 103

13.s:
bhinnātmabhyāṃ tatastābhyāmekatvena sthitiṃ purā |
iti cetasi vai kṛtvā tatassaṃpūjayeddvija || 104 ||
13.d:
भिन्नात्मभ्यां ततस्ताभ्यामेकत्वेन स्थितिं पुरा |
इति चेतसि वै कृत्वा ततस्संपूजयेद्द्विज || 104 ||
13.m: Having previously resolved in mind that they abide in unity, / though their natures are distinct, he should then perform worship, O twice-born. // 104

13.s:
pādapaśca yathā bhaumairguṇairdūratare sthitaḥ |
pādapīyairguṇaistadvaddūre tiṣṭhati medinī || 105 ||
13.d:
पादपश्च यथा भौमैर्गुणैर्दूरतरे स्थितः |
पादपीयैर्गुणैस्तद्वद्दूरे तिष्ठति मेदिनी || 105 ||
13.m: Just as a tree stands far away from earthy qualities, / and likewise the earth stands far away from qualities of the tree, // 105

13.s:
sakalākalamantrābhyāmavinābhāva īdṛśaḥ |
kevalātsakalāddhyānātpadasiddhirna jāyate || 106 ||
13.d:
सकलाकलमन्त्राभ्यामविनाभाव ईदृशः |
केवलात्सकलाद्ध्यानात्पदसिद्धिर्न जायते || 106 ||
13.m: such is the inseparable connection between the formed and formless mantras. / From mere meditation on the formed, the attainment of the state does not arise; // 106

13.s:
p. 105) svabhāvaniṣkalānmantrāttadvaddūre ca siddhayaḥ |
ata eva kramāddhyātaiḥ pūjitaistoṣitaistataḥ || 107 ||
13.d:
प्. 105) स्वभावनिष्कलान्मन्त्रात्तद्वद्दूरे च सिद्धयः |
अत एव क्रमाद्ध्यातैः पूजितैस्तोषितैस्ततः || 107 ||
13.m: likewise, attainments are far removed from a mantra that is purely formless by nature. / Therefore, after they have been meditated upon in order, worshipped, and propitiated, // 107

13.s: [viśeṣapūjanam]
13.d: [विशेषपूजनम्]

13.s:
viśeṣapūjanaṃ vipra kalpayedacyutasya tu |
sauvarṇapuṣpasaṃpūrṇamañjaliṃ saṃprasārya ca || 108 ||
13.d:
विशेषपूजनं विप्र कल्पयेदच्युतस्य तु |
सौवर्णपुष्पसंपूर्णमञ्जलिं संप्रसार्य च || 108 ||
13.m: he should perform the special worship of Acyuta, O vipra. / And having extended his joined palms filled with golden flowers, // 108

13.s:
mūlamantraṃ samuccārya prayatnātpūrakādibhiḥ |
dīrghaghaṇṭāravaprakhyaṃ yāvattatsaṃbhavāvadhi || 109 ||
13.d:
मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य प्रयत्नात्पूरकादिभिः |
दीर्घघण्टारवप्रख्यं यावत्तत्संभवावधि || 109 ||
13.m: and having enunciated the root-mantra with effort through inhalation and the rest, / resembling the prolonged sound of a bell, as long as it can be produced, // 109

13.s:
sphuradraśmicayākīrṇamagnyarkenduśataprabham |
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ devamañcalau sannirodhayet || 110 ||
13.d:
स्फुरद्रश्मिचयाकीर्णमग्न्यर्केन्दुशतप्रभम् |
ध्यात्वा नारायणं देवमञ्चलौ सन्निरोधयेत् || 110 ||
13.m: having contemplated God Nārāyaṇa, crowded with a mass of sparkling rays, / possessing the brilliance of a hundred fires, suns, and moons, he should confine [him] in his joined palms. // 110

13.s:
tamañjaliṃ kṣipenmūrdhni tasminvai mantravigrahe |
arghyaṃ nivedayedbhūyaḥ punaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ śubham || 111 ||
13.d:
तमञ्जलिं क्षिपेन्मूर्ध्नि तस्मिन्वै मन्त्रविग्रहे |
अर्घ्यं निवेदयेद्भूयः पुनः पुष्पाञ्जलिं शुभम् || 111 ||
13.m: He should cast those joined palms onto the head of that mantra-body; / he should again offer arghya water, and once more an auspicious handful of flowers. // 111

13.s:
mudrāṃ sandarśya mūlākhyāṃ mānasaṃ japamārabhet |
saṃkhyāhīnaṃ yathāśakti ghaṇṭhākhyakaraṇena ca || 112 ||
13.d:
मुद्रां सन्दर्श्य मूलाख्यां मानसं जपमारभेत् |
संख्याहीनं यथाशक्ति घण्ठाख्यकरणेन च || 112 ||
13.m: Having displayed the mudrā called the root, he should begin mental recitation, / without counting, according to his capacity, and by means of the performance called the bell. // 112

13.s:
bhogasthānagatānāṃ ca lakṣmyādīnāṃ krameṇa ca |
manasā darśayenmudrāṃ japaṃ kuryātsakṛtsakṛt || 113 ||
13.d:
भोगस्थानगतानां च लक्ष्म्यादीनां क्रमेण च |
मनसा दर्शयेन्मुद्रां जपं कुर्यात्सकृत्सकृत् || 113 ||
13.m: And in due order, for Lakṣmī and the others situated in the place of enjoyment, / he should mentally display the mudrā and perform recitation once each. // 113

13.s:
srotramantraiḥ pavitraiśca stutvā samyakprasādayet |
evaṃ krameṇa viprendra kṛtvā yāgaṃ tu mānasam || 114 ||
13.d:
स्रोत्रमन्त्रैः पवित्रैश्च स्तुत्वा सम्यक्प्रसादयेत् |
एवं क्रमेण विप्रेन्द्र कृत्वा यागं तु मानसम् || 114 ||
13.m: Having praised [them] with holy stream-mantras, he should properly propitiate [them]. / Having thus performed the mental sacrifice in due order, O best of Brahmins, // 114

13.s: [atha mānasa homaprakāraḥ]
13.d: [अथ मानस होमप्रकारः]
13.m: [Now the method of mental fire-oblation]

13.s:
homaṃ tathāvidhaṃ kuryānmokṣalakṣmīpradaṃ śubham |
nābhicakrāntarasthaṃ tu dhyāyedvanhigra(gṛ ?)haṃ mune || 115 ||
13.d:
होमं तथाविधं कुर्यान्मोक्षलक्ष्मीप्रदं शुभम् |
नाभिचक्रान्तरस्थं तु ध्यायेद्वन्हिग्र(गृ ?)हं मुने || 115 ||
13.m: he should perform a homa of that kind, auspicious and bestowing the fortune of liberation. / He should meditate on the house of fire situated within the navel-circle, O sage, // 115

13.s:
trikoṇaṃ triguṇenaiva avyaktenāvṛtaṃ pari |
dhyānāraṇiṃ tu nirmathya cidagnimavatārya ca || 116 ||
13.d:
त्रिकोणं त्रिगुणेनैव अव्यक्तेनावृतं परि |
ध्यानारणिं तु निर्मथ्य चिदग्निमवतार्य च || 116 ||
13.m: triangular, enclosed entirely by the unmanifest consisting of the three guṇas. / And having churned the fire-stick of meditation and brought down the fire of consciousness, // 116

13.s:
suśuddhaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ dīptaṃ sadaivordhvaśikhaṃ dvija |
vāsudevātmakaṃ yasmātsa vasatyantarātmasu || 117 ||
13.d:
सुशुद्धं संस्कृतं दीप्तं सदैवोर्ध्वशिखं द्विज |
वासुदेवात्मकं यस्मात्स वसत्यन्तरात्मसु || 117 ||
13.m: pure, consecrated, blazing, always with upright flame, O twice-born, / having the nature of Vāsudeva, since he dwells within inner selves, // 117

13.s:
proccarenmūlamantraṃ tu yāvacchabdasya gocaram |
tatrasthamāhareddivyamāhlādājyāmṛtaṃ param || 118 ||
13.d:
प्रोच्चरेन्मूलमन्त्रं तु यावच्छब्दस्य गोचरम् |
तत्रस्थमाहरेद्दिव्यमाह्लादाज्यामृतं परम् || 118 ||
13.m: he should enunciate the root-mantra as far as the range of sound extends. / Remaining there, he should extract the divine, supreme nectar of ghee consisting of bliss, // 118

13.s:
brahmasarpiḥsamudrādyannistaraṅgāptarisrutam |
gṛhītvā'mṛtamārgeṇa brahmarandhreṇa saṃviśet || 119 ||
13.d:
ब्रह्मसर्पिःसमुद्राद्यन्निस्तरङ्गाप्तरिस्रुतम् |
गृहीत्वाऽमृतमार्गेण ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण संविशेत् || 119 ||
13.m: which has flowed forth from the ocean of Brahman-ghee without waves, obtained [by him]. / Having taken [it] through the path of nectar, he should enter through the aperture of Brahman. // 119

13.s:
hṛdayānmadhyamārgeṇa cinmayena sadīptinā |
prollasantaṃ smarenmantraṃ brahmasaktyupabṛṃhitam || 120 ||
13.d:
हृदयान्मध्यमार्गेण चिन्मयेन सदीप्तिना |
प्रोल्लसन्तं स्मरेन्मन्त्रं ब्रह्मसक्त्युपबृंहितम् || 120 ||
13.m: Through the central path from the heart, which consists of consciousness and is endowed with light, / he should remember the mantra flashing forth, augmented by the power of Brahman. // 120

13.s:
p. 106) svakāraṇāgnau nābhisthe ya ūrdhvendhanavatsthitaḥ |
svabhāvadīptabrahmāgnau paritaścodarojvalam || 121 ||
13.d:
प्. 106) स्वकारणाग्नौ नाभिस्थे य ऊर्ध्वेन्धनवत्स्थितः |
स्वभावदीप्तब्रह्माग्नौ परितश्चोदरोज्वलम् || 121 ||
13.m: It stands in its own causal fire situated in the navel, like upright fuel, / in the naturally blazing Brahman-fire, brilliant all around within the belly. // 121

13.s:
smṛtvā mantraṃ tu tanmūrdhni patamānaṃ dvijāmbarāt |
cintayedamṛtaṃtvājyaṃ purā yaccāhṛtaṃ dvija || 122 ||
13.d:
स्मृत्वा मन्त्रं तु तन्मूर्ध्नि पतमानं द्विजाम्बरात् |
चिन्तयेदमृतंत्वाज्यं पुरा यच्चाहृतं द्विज || 122 ||
13.m: Having remembered the mantra falling onto its summit from the sky, O twice-born, / he should contemplate the ghee, the nectar that was previously fetched, O twice-born, // 122

13.s:
cidagnimeva santarpya nābhau mantrasvarūpiṇam |
jvālāgrāvasthitaṃ caiva bhūyo hṛtpaṅkaje smaret || 123 ||
13.d:
चिदग्निमेव सन्तर्प्य नाभौ मन्त्रस्वरूपिणम् |
ज्वालाग्रावस्थितं चैव भूयो हृत्पङ्कजे स्मरेत् || 123 ||
13.m: satiating the fire of consciousness itself in the form of the mantra in the navel; / and situated at the tip of the flame, he should remember [it] again in the lotus of the heart. // 123

13.s:
proccārayaṃśca mantreśaṃ plutaṃ dhyānasamanvitam |
kṛtvaivamekasandhānaṃ sthānadvayagatasya ca || 124 ||
13.d:
प्रोच्चारयंश्च मन्त्रेशं प्लुतं ध्यानसमन्वितम् |
कृत्वैवमेकसन्धानं स्थानद्वयगतस्य च || 124 ||
13.m: And while enunciating the lord of mantras prolonged, accompanied by meditation, / having thus effected the unification of what is located in the two places, // 124

13.s:
viṣṇormantrasvarūpasya nānāmantrātmakasya ca |
sarvaṃ tu sanyasetpaścāttasminmantrakṛtaṃ ca yat || 125 ||
13.d:
विष्णोर्मन्त्रस्वरूपस्य नानामन्त्रात्मकस्य च |
सर्वं तु सन्यसेत्पश्चात्तस्मिन्मन्त्रकृतं च यत् || 125 ||
13.m: of Viṣṇu whose essence is mantra and whose self consists of various mantras, / he should then deposit in him all that was produced by mantra. // 125

13.s:
toyapuṣpākṣataiḥ pūrṇaṃ bhāvayeddakṣiṇaṃ karam |
tanmadhye niṣkalaṃ mantraṃ saṃsmaretkiraṇākulam || 126 ||
13.d:
तोयपुष्पाक्षतैः पूर्णं भावयेद्दक्षिणं करम् |
तन्मध्ये निष्कलं मन्त्रं संस्मरेत्किरणाकुलम् || 126 ||
13.m: He should imagine his right hand full of water, flowers, and unhusked barley grains; / in the middle of it, he should remember the undivided mantra, filled with rays. // 126

13.s:
yāgotthāṃ phalasaṃpattiṃ lakṣmīrupāṃ vicintya ca |
mūlamantraṃ samuccārya pāṇimadhye tathā smaret || 127 ||
13.d:
यागोत्थां फलसंपत्तिं लक्ष्मीरुपां विचिन्त्य च |
मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य पाणिमध्ये तथा स्मरेत् || 127 ||
13.m: And having contemplated the attainment of the fruit arising from sacrifice in the form of Lakṣmī, / having enunciated the root-mantra, he should likewise remember [it] in the middle of his hand. // 127

13.s:
bhūyaśca niṣkalaṃ mantraṃ tasyāmupari bhāvayet |
saśīrṣe jānunī bhūmau kṛtvā viṣṇornivedayet || 128 ||
13.d:
भूयश्च निष्कलं मन्त्रं तस्यामुपरि भावयेत् |
सशीर्षे जानुनी भूमौ कृत्वा विष्णोर्निवेदयेत् || 128 ||
13.m: And again he should imagine the undivided mantra above it; / having placed his knees on the ground together with his head, he should offer [it] to Viṣṇu. // 128

13.s:
prasādābhimukhenātha tena taccātmasātkṛtam |
bhāvanīyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha parituṣṭena cādarāt || 129 ||
13.d:
प्रसादाभिमुखेनाथ तेन तच्चात्मसात्कृतम् |
भावनीयं द्विजश्रेष्ठ परितुष्टेन चादरात् || 129 ||
13.m: Then it should be meditated on, O best of Brahmins, as appropriated by him / who is disposed toward grace and fully pleased with respect. // 129

13.s:
ayaṃ yo mānaso yāgo jarāvyādhibhayāpahaḥ |
pāpoghasargaśamano bhavābhāvakaro dvija || 130 ||
13.d:
अयं यो मानसो यागो जराव्याधिभयापहः |
पापोघसर्गशमनो भवाभावकरो द्विज || 130 ||
13.m: This mental sacrifice, which removes fear of old age and disease, / which pacifies the flood of sins and produces the cessation of worldly existence, O twice-born, // 130

13.s:
satatābhyāsayogena dehapātātpramocayet |
yastvevaṃ parayā bhaktyā sakṛdācarate naraḥ || 131 ||
13.d:
सतताभ्यासयोगेन देहपातात्प्रमोचयेत् |
यस्त्वेवं परया भक्त्या सकृदाचरते नरः || 131 ||
13.m: through the practice of constant repetition, liberates [one] from the falling of the body. / But that person who performs [it] once with supreme devotion, // 131

13.s:
kramoditena vidhinā tasya tuṣyāmyahaṃ mune |
yājakānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ pradhānatvena varttate || 132 ||
13.d:
क्रमोदितेन विधिना तस्य तुष्याम्यहं मुने |
याजकानां च सर्वेषां प्रधानत्वेन वर्त्तते || 132 ||
13.m: according to the rule set forth in order—with him I am pleased, O sage; / and he exists as foremost among all sacrificers. // 132

13.s:
tārayetsvapitṝnyātāneṣyāṃścaiva tu sāṃpratāt |
kiṃ punarnityayukto yastadbhāvagatamānasaḥ || 133 ||
13.d:
तारयेत्स्वपितॄन्यातानेष्यांश्चैव तु सांप्रतात् |
किं पुनर्नित्ययुक्तो यस्तद्भावगतमानसः || 133 ||
13.m: He delivers his ancestors of the past, and those of the future from the present onward; / what then of him who is constantly disciplined, whose mind has attained his state, // 133

13.s:
mantrārādhanamārgasthaśraddhābhaktisamanvitaḥ |
na tasya punarāvṛttissa yāti paramaṃ padam || 134 ||
13.d:
मन्त्राराधनमार्गस्थश्रद्धाभक्तिसमन्वितः |
न तस्य पुनरावृत्तिस्स याति परमं पदम् || 134 ||
13.m: who stands upon the path of mantra-worship, endowed with faith and devotion? / For him there is no return; he goes to the supreme abode. // 134

13.s:
jñātvaivaṃ yatnato nityaṃ kuryādyāgaṃ tu mānasam |
idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mayoktaṃ te'dya nārada || 135 ||
13.d:
ज्ञात्वैवं यत्नतो नित्यं कुर्याद्यागं तु मानसम् |
इदं रहस्यं परमं मयोक्तं तेऽद्य नारद || 135 ||
13.m: Knowing this, one should always perform the mental sacrifice with effort. / This supreme secret has been spoken by me to you today, O Nārada. // 135

13.s:
p. 107) nāśiṣyāṇāṃ ca vaktavyaṃ nābhaktānāṃ kadācana |
atyantabhavabhītānāṃ bhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 136 ||
13.d:
प्. 107) नाशिष्याणां च वक्तव्यं नाभक्तानां कदाचन |
अत्यन्तभवभीतानां भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 136 ||
13.m: It should not be spoken to non-disciples, nor ever to the non-devoted; / to those terrified of worldly existence, devoted, whose minds are cultured, // 136

13.s: idaṃ rahasyaṃ vaktavyaṃ samyagbhāvaṃ parīkṣya ca |
13.d: इदं रहस्यं वक्तव्यं सम्यग्भावं परीक्ष्य च |
13.m: this secret should be spoken, after having thoroughly examined their disposition.

13.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ mānasayāgo nāma dvādaśaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 12 ||
13.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां मानसयागो नाम द्वादशः
पटलः || 12 ||
13.m: Thus ends the twelfth chapter, called The Mental Sacrifice, in the venerable Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the Pāñcarātra. // 12

14.s: atha bāhyayāgākhyānaṃ nāma trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
14.d: अथ बाह्ययागाख्यानं नाम त्रयोदशः पटलः
14.m: Now the thirteenth chapter, called The Account of External Sacrifice.

14.s: śrībhagavān
14.d: श्रीभगवान्

14.s:
purā'nena vidhānena kṛtvā yāgaṃ tu mānasam |
karmaṇā bhaktiyuktena maṇḍalasthaṃ yajettataḥ || 1 ||
14.d:
पुराऽनेन विधानेन कृत्वा यागं तु मानसम् |
कर्मणा भक्तियुक्तेन मण्डलस्थं यजेत्ततः || 1 ||
14.m: Having first performed the mental sacrifice according to this procedure, / he should then worship [him] situated in the maṇḍala through devotion-filled ritual. // 1

14.s:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhye ya iṣṭo mantragaṇaḥ purā |
prasphurantaṃ tamatraiva prāṇāpānagataṃ smaret || 2 ||
14.d:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्ये य इष्टो मन्त्रगणः पुरा |
प्रस्फुरन्तं तमत्रैव प्राणापानगतं स्मरेत् || 2 ||
14.m: The assembly of mantras that was previously worshipped in the middle of the heart-lotus, / he should remember that flashing forth right here, located in the prāṇa and apāna breaths. // 2

14.s:
visarjayenna taṃ yāvanna kṛtā bāhyataḥ kriyāḥ |
nyasanīyo hyayaṃ yasmādarghyapātre dvijottama || 3 ||
14.d:
विसर्जयेन्न तं यावन्न कृता बाह्यतः क्रियाः |
न्यसनीयो ह्ययं यस्मादर्घ्यपात्रे द्विजोत्तम || 3 ||
14.m: He should not dismiss it as long as the external rites have not been performed, / for this is to be deposited in the arghya vessel, O best of Brahmins, // 3

14.s: maṇḍale hyakṣasūtre ca kuṇḍamadhyagate'nale |
14.d: मण्डले ह्यक्षसूत्रे च कुण्डमध्यगतेऽनले |
14.m: in the maṇḍala, on the rosary, and in the fire situated within the pit.

14.s: [praśnaprativacanamukhena bāhyayāgasyāvaśyakatvanirūpaṇam]
14.d: [प्रश्नप्रतिवचनमुखेन बाह्ययागस्यावश्यकत्वनिरूपणम्]
14.m: [Determination of the necessity of external sacrifice by way of question and answer]

14.s: [nāradaḥ]
14.d: [नारदः]

14.s: bhagavaṃstvatprasādena jñāto hyajñānanāśanaḥ || 4 ||
14.d: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन ज्ञातो ह्यज्ञाननाशनः || 4 ||
14.m: O Blessed One, by your grace, that which destroys ignorance has indeed been understood, // 4

14.s:
jñānavijñānasahito hṛdyāgassarvasiddhidaḥ |
kimarthaṃ bāhyataḥ pūjā kāryā vai maṇḍalāntare || 5 ||
14.d:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसहितो हृद्यागस्सर्वसिद्धिदः |
किमर्थं बाह्यतः पूजा कार्या वै मण्डलान्तरे || 5 ||
14.m: the sacrifice in the heart, accompanied by knowledge and discernment, bestowing all accomplishments. / For what purpose must worship be performed externally within a maṇḍala? // 5

14.s: etadācakṣva bhagavaṃstatra me saṃśayo mahān |
14.d: एतदाचक्ष्व भगवंस्तत्र मे संशयो महान् |
14.m: Explain this, O Blessed One; herein lies my great doubt.

14.s: śrībhagavān
14.d: श्रीभगवान्

14.s: bāhyotthā vāsanā vipra bahujanmārjitā dṛḍhā || 6 ||
14.d: बाह्योत्था वासना विप्र बहुजन्मार्जिता दृढा || 6 ||
14.m: The latent trace arising from the external is firm, O Brahmin, accumulated over many births; // 6

14.s:
lolīkṛto'nayā hyātmā śuddho'śuddhasvarūpayā |
yā mantraviṣayā śuddhā kriyā śāntasvarūpadā || 7 ||
14.d:
लोलीकृतोऽनया ह्यात्मा शुद्धोऽशुद्धस्वरूपया |
या मन्त्रविषया शुद्धा क्रिया शान्तस्वरूपदा || 7 ||
14.m: by this [trace], whose nature is impure, the pure self is made agitated. / That pure ritual having mantra as its object, which bestows a peaceful nature— // 7

14.s:
samutthānavināśārthamasyāssā saṃprakīrtitā |
sa bāhyābhyantarābhyāṃ ca kriyābhyāṃ tanmayo bhavet || 8 ||
14.d:
समुत्थानविनाशार्थमस्यास्सा संप्रकीर्तिता |
स बाह्याभ्यन्तराभ्यां च क्रियाभ्यां तन्मयो भवेत् || 8 ||
14.m: it is proclaimed for the sake of the destruction of the rise of that [latent trace]. / By both external and internal rituals, he becomes identical with that. // 8

14.s:
dṛḍhotthavāsanānāṃ ca tānavaṃ syācchanaiśśanaiḥ |
yanmayassādhako vipra dehasthassāṃprato bhavet || 9 ||
14.d:
दृढोत्थवासनानां च तानवं स्याच्छनैश्शनैः |
यन्मयस्साधको विप्र देहस्थस्सांप्रतो भवेत् || 9 ||
14.m: And there will be gradual thinning of firmly arisen latent traces. / Having become identical with that which the practitioner now is while residing in the body, O Brahmin, // 9

14.s: tanmayo dehapātātsyādityetatkathitaṃ mayā |
14.d: तन्मयो देहपातात्स्यादित्येतत्कथितं मया |
14.m: he will become identical with that upon the fall of the body; thus has this been declared by me.

14.s: nāradaḥ-
14.d: नारदः-

14.s: brūhi me devadeveśa maṇḍale yajanaṃ yathā || 10 ||
14.d: ब्रूहि मे देवदेवेश मण्डले यजनं यथा || 10 ||
14.m: Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, how worship is done in the maṇḍala, // 10

14.s: p. 108) svarūpaṃ maṇḍalasyāpi yadi sānugraho'si me |
14.d: प्. 108) स्वरूपं मण्डलस्यापि यदि सानुग्रहोऽसि मे |
14.m: and also the nature of the maṇḍala, if you are gracious to me.

14.s: śrī bhagavān
14.d: श्री भगवान्

14.s: [maṇḍala vinyāsaḥ]
14.d: [मण्डल विन्यासः]

14.s: śṛṇu maṇḍalavinyāsaṃ viṣṇoradbhutatejasaḥ || 11 ||
14.d: शृणु मण्डलविन्यासं विष्णोरद्भुततेजसः || 11 ||
14.m: Hear the arrangement of the maṇḍala of Viṣṇu of wondrous splendour; // 11

14.s:
pravakṣyāmi samāsena yena śreyo hyavāpsyasi |
parīkṣya vividhāmurvīṃ gandhavarṇassānvitām || 12 ||
14.d:
प्रवक्ष्यामि समासेन येन श्रेयो ह्यवाप्स्यसि |
परीक्ष्य विविधामुर्वीं गन्धवर्णस्सान्विताम् || 12 ||
14.m: I shall explain [it] in brief, by which you will indeed attain the highest good. / Having examined the diverse ground, endowed with [pleasant] smell and colour, // 12

14.s:
lāṅgalādyaiḥ purā yatnāskṛtvā tu pariśodhitām |
duṣṭaśalyavinirmuktāṃ hastibhāravatīṃ dṛḍhām || 13 ||
14.d:
लाङ्गलाद्यैः पुरा यत्नास्कृत्वा तु परिशोधिताम् |
दुष्टशल्यविनिर्मुक्तां हस्तिभारवतीं दृढाम् || 13 ||
14.m: having previously purified it with effort by means of ploughs and the like, / freed from noxious bones and thorns, capable of bearing the weight of an elephant, firm, // 13

14.s:
tatpṛṣṭhe maṇḍapaṃ kuryātsudhādhavalitaṃ śubham |
vitānakapatākābhirvastraiśca supariṣkṛtam || 14 ||
14.d:
तत्पृष्ठे मण्डपं कुर्यात्सुधाधवलितं शुभम् |
वितानकपताकाभिर्वस्त्रैश्च सुपरिष्कृतम् || 14 ||
14.m: on its surface he should construct an auspicious pavilion, whitewashed with lime, / beautifully adorned with canopies, banners, and cloths. // 14

14.s:
tatrādau lakṣayedbudhyā brahmasthānaṃ prayatnataḥ |
vṛkṣajām(?)unnatāṃ kuryādvediṃ yāga(ge ?)dvijādhikā(yatā?)m || 15 ||
14.d:
तत्रादौ लक्षयेद्बुध्या ब्रह्मस्थानं प्रयत्नतः |
वृक्षजाम्(?)उन्नतां कुर्याद्वेदिं याग(गे ?)द्विजाधिका(यता?)म् || 15 ||
14.m: There he should first identify with care the Brahmasthāna through his intellect; / he should make an elevated altar born of trees […] for the sacrifice […]. // 15

14.s:
astrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā pañcagavyaṃ tu tejasā |
upalipyāgratassūtraṃ vedikāmabhimantrya ca || 16 ||
14.d:
अस्त्राभिमन्त्रितं कृत्वा पञ्चगव्यं तु तेजसा |
उपलिप्याग्रतस्सूत्रं वेदिकामभिमन्त्र्य च || 16 ||
14.m: Having consecrated the five products of the cow with the astra-mantra through [spiritual] fire, / having smeared [the ground], and having first consecrated the cord and the altar, // 16

14.s:
dadyātpūrvaparaṃ sūtraṃ tatra madhye ca nārada |
aṣṭahastaṃ tadarddhaṃ vā caturasraṃ tu sādhayet || 17 ||
14.d:
दद्यात्पूर्वपरं सूत्रं तत्र मध्ये च नारद |
अष्टहस्तं तदर्द्धं वा चतुरस्रं तु साधयेत् || 17 ||
14.m: he should lay down the east-west cord in its middle, O Nārada; / he should construct a square of eight cubits or half of that. // 17

14.s:
mānādardhārdhasūtreṇa brahmasthānasthitena ca |
digdvayānmadhyasūtraṃ tu cinhīkṛtya samaṃ yathā || 18 ||
14.d:
मानादर्धार्धसूत्रेण ब्रह्मस्थानस्थितेन च |
दिग्द्वयान्मध्यसूत्रं तु चिन्हीकृत्य समं यथा || 18 ||
14.m: With a cord of one quarter of the measure located at the Brahmasthāna, / marking the middle cord from the two directions so that it is even, // 18

14.s:
cinhācinhagataṃ sūtraṃ kṛtvā tadanu nārada |
ullaṅghyollaṅghya vai kuryāllāṃchane saumyayāmyage || 19 ||
14.d:
चिन्हाचिन्हगतं सूत्रं कृत्वा तदनु नारद |
उल्लङ्घ्योल्लङ्घ्य वै कुर्याल्लांछने सौम्ययाम्यगे || 19 ||
14.m: having then drawn the cord from mark to mark, O Nārada, / crossing over repeatedly, he should make marks in the northern and southern directions. // 19

14.s:
evamevāpare cinhe tadvattasmiṃśca digdvaye |
kuryāttenaiva sūtreṇa cinhāccinhagatena ca || 20 ||
14.d:
एवमेवापरे चिन्हे तद्वत्तस्मिंश्च दिग्द्वये |
कुर्यात्तेनैव सूत्रेण चिन्हाच्चिन्हगतेन च || 20 ||
14.m: In the very same way at the other mark, likewise in those two directions, / he should do it with that very cord extending from mark to mark. // 20

14.s:
prasāryorddhasthitaṃ sūtraṃ matsyasandhidvaye dvija |
dakṣiṇottaradigyātaṃ prākpūrvāparasaṃsthitam || 21 ||
14.d:
प्रसार्योर्द्धस्थितं सूत्रं मत्स्यसन्धिद्वये द्विज |
दक्षिणोत्तरदिग्यातं प्राक्पूर्वापरसंस्थितम् || 21 ||
14.m: Extending the cord held above at the two fish-intersections, O twice-born, / running in the north-south direction, as previously established in the east-west direction, // 21

14.s:
tato mānārdhasūtreṇa cinhayeddikcatuṣṭayam |
teṣu cinheṣu vai pṛṣṭhe kṛtvā taccātha sūtrakam || 22 ||
14.d:
ततो मानार्धसूत्रेण चिन्हयेद्दिक्चतुष्टयम् |
तेषु चिन्हेषु वै पृष्ठे कृत्वा तच्चाथ सूत्रकम् || 22 ||
14.m: then with a cord of half the measure he should mark the four directions. / Placing that cord behind those marks, // 22

14.s:
sallāṃchya koṇabhāgānvai pūrvatulyaistu lāṃchitaiḥ |
didgalasthena sūtreṇa tatassūtracatuṣṭayam || 23 ||
14.d:
सल्लांछ्य कोणभागान्वै पूर्वतुल्यैस्तु लांछितैः |
दिद्गलस्थेन सूत्रेण ततस्सूत्रचतुष्टयम् || 23 ||
14.m: duly marking the corner sections with marks equal to the previous ones, / by means of the cord situated at the edge of the directions, then four cords // 23

14.s:
dadyādvai kṣetrasidhyarthaṃ koṇātkoṇe ca nārada |
p. 109) samaiḥ padaistu tatkṣetraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśadhā tataḥ || 24 ||
14.d:
दद्याद्वै क्षेत्रसिध्यर्थं कोणात्कोणे च नारद |
प्. 109) समैः पदैस्तु तत्क्षेत्रं कृत्वा षोडशधा ततः || 24 ||
14.m: he should lay from corner to corner for the sake of establishing the field, O Nārada. / Then, having divided that field into sixteen with equal squares, // 24

14.s:
caturbhistu padairmadhye padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhet |
tadvadaṣṭāsu vai kuryādāśāsu kamalāṣṭakam || 25 ||
14.d:
चतुर्भिस्तु पदैर्मध्ये पद्ममष्टदलं लिखेत् |
तद्वदष्टासु वै कुर्यादाशासु कमलाष्टकम् || 25 ||
14.m: he should draw an eight-petalled lotus in the center with four squares; / likewise he should make eight lotuses in the eight directions. // 25

14.s:
dikṣu padmacatuṣkaṃ tu devīnāṃ pūjanāya ca |
vidukṣvanyāni catvāri satyāntā yeṣvavasthitāḥ || 26 ||
14.d:
दिक्षु पद्मचतुष्कं तु देवीनां पूजनाय च |
विदुक्ष्वन्यानि चत्वारि सत्यान्ता येष्ववस्थिताः || 26 ||
14.m: The four lotuses in the cardinal directions are for worshipping the goddesses, / and the other four are in the intermediate directions, in which those ending with Satya are situated. // 26

14.s:
teṣāṃ madhye tu navamaṃ pūjyate yatra keśavaḥ |
madhyamaṃ kamalaṃ kṣetraṃ caturddhā bhrāmayenmune || 27 ||
14.d:
तेषां मध्ये तु नवमं पूज्यते यत्र केशवः |
मध्यमं कमलं क्षेत्रं चतुर्द्धा भ्रामयेन्मुने || 27 ||
14.m: In the middle of them is the ninth, where Keśava is worshipped. / He should sweep [circles in] the central lotus-field fourfold, O sage: // 27

14.s:
varjayitvā'ṣṭamāṃśaṃ tu vyoma tenārdhato bahiḥ |
bhramaṇenāntarasthena bhavati dvija karṇikā || 28 ||
14.d:
वर्जयित्वाऽष्टमांशं तु व्योम तेनार्धतो बहिः |
भ्रमणेनान्तरस्थेन भवति द्विज कर्णिका || 28 ||
14.m: setting aside an eighth part, [that is] the space; by half beyond that, / by the innermost sweeping, O twice-born, the pericarp is formed; // 28

14.s:
kesarāṇi dvitīyena tṛtīye patrasandhayaḥ |
patrāgrāṇi caturthena bhramaṇopari kalpayet || 29 ||
14.d:
केसराणि द्वितीयेन तृतीये पत्रसन्धयः |
पत्राग्राणि चतुर्थेन भ्रमणोपरि कल्पयेत् || 29 ||
14.m: the filaments are formed by the second, the junctions of the petals in the third, / and he should fashion the tips of the petals upon the fourth sweeping. // 29

14.s:
koṇātkoṇagataṃ tasminpadme sūtradvayaṃ kṣipet |
sūtrāṇāmantare bhūyaḥ kṣipetsūtrāṣṭhakaṃ tathā || 30 ||
14.d:
कोणात्कोणगतं तस्मिन्पद्मे सूत्रद्वयं क्षिपेत् |
सूत्राणामन्तरे भूयः क्षिपेत्सूत्राष्ठकं तथा || 30 ||
14.m: In that lotus he should cast two cords running from corner to corner; / between the cords he should again cast eight cords in the same way. // 30

14.s:
padmasandhisthasūtreṇa dikkrameṇa dalāṣṭakam |
bhrāmya vṛttārthayogena evamanye bahisthitāḥ || 31 ||
14.d:
पद्मसन्धिस्थसूत्रेण दिक्क्रमेण दलाष्टकम् |
भ्राम्य वृत्तार्थयोगेन एवमन्ये बहिस्थिताः || 31 ||
14.m: With the cord situated at the junction of the petals, [he forms] the eight petals in the order of the directions; / having swept them by the use of half-circles, in this way the others situated outside, // 31

14.s:
padmāḥ kāryāḥ prayatnena susamāśca parasparam |
caturdhā keśarāṃśaṃ tu patre patre vibhajya ca || 32 ||
14.d:
पद्माः कार्याः प्रयत्नेन सुसमाश्च परस्परम् |
चतुर्धा केशरांशं तु पत्रे पत्रे विभज्य च || 32 ||
14.m: the lotuses should be made with effort, perfectly equal to one another. / Dividing the filament-portion into four on each petal, // 32

14.s:
kesaratritayaṃ madhye ekaikena yathā bhavet |
saṃsaktanavapadme tu garbhasyārdhena vīdhikāḥ || 33 ||
14.d:
केसरत्रितयं मध्ये एकैकेन यथा भवेत् |
संसक्तनवपद्मे तु गर्भस्यार्धेन वीधिकाः || 33 ||
14.m: so that there is a triad of filaments in the middle by each [division]; / in the nine conjoined lotuses, corridors [are made] by half of the interior. // 33

14.s:
ādhāya vīdhivistārān ṣaḍaṃśaṃ vā'tha pañcakam |
tena padmasamūhasya caturaśraṃ likhedbahiḥ || 34 ||
14.d:
आधाय वीधिविस्तारान् षडंशं वाऽथ पञ्चकम् |
तेन पद्मसमूहस्य चतुरश्रं लिखेद्बहिः || 34 ||
14.m: Fixing the width of the corridors to a sixth or a fifth part, / by that he should draw a square on the outside of the cluster of lotuses. // 34

14.s:
tattridhā vibhajeddikṣu pīṭhaḥ syātpādagātrabhṛt |
digpadmaṃ parito dvāraṃ kuryāddikṣu caturṣvapi || 35 ||
14.d:
तत्त्रिधा विभजेद्दिक्षु पीठः स्यात्पादगात्रभृत् |
दिग्पद्मं परितो द्वारं कुर्याद्दिक्षु चतुर्ष्वपि || 35 ||
14.m: He should divide it threefold in the cardinal directions; there should be a pedestal bearing feet and limbs. / He should make a doorway around the directional lotus in all four directions. // 35

14.s:
tasminbhāgadvayenaiva karṇaṃ kuryāddvijottama |
caturbhirupakarṇaṃ tu koṇaṃ koṇaṃ bhavettataḥ || 36 ||
14.d:
तस्मिन्भागद्वयेनैव कर्णं कुर्याद्द्विजोत्तम |
चतुर्भिरुपकर्णं तु कोणं कोणं भवेत्ततः || 36 ||
14.m: On it he should make an ear with two parts, O best of the twice-born, / and a subordinate ear with four; then there should be corner after corner. // 36

14.s:
dvāviṃśatipadaiḥ pūrṇamekīkṛtya viśodhya ca |
viviktaṃ paścimadvāraṃ kuryādrekhāvivarjitam || 37 ||
14.d:
द्वाविंशतिपदैः पूर्णमेकीकृत्य विशोध्य च |
विविक्तं पश्चिमद्वारं कुर्याद्रेखाविवर्जितम् || 37 ||
14.m: Completing it with twenty-two squares, joining and purifying [them], / he should make the secluded western doorway free of lines. // 37

14.s:
karṇikāṃ pītavarṇena pītaraktena kesarān |
patrāṣṭakaṃ sitaṃ kuryādantarālaṃ nabhassamam || 38 ||
14.d:
कर्णिकां पीतवर्णेन पीतरक्तेन केसरान् |
पत्राष्टकं सितं कुर्यादन्तरालं नभस्समम् || 38 ||
14.m: He should make the pericarp with the colour yellow, the filaments yellow-red, / the eight petals white, and the intervening space resembling the sky. // 38

14.s:
p. 110) pītena pīṭhakoṇādi gātrakāṇyaruṇena tu |
sitaṃ dvāracatuṣkaṃ tu koṇātraktena bhūṣayet || 39 ||
14.d:
प्. 110) पीतेन पीठकोणादि गात्रकाण्यरुणेन तु |
सितं द्वारचतुष्कं तु कोणात्रक्तेन भूषयेत् || 39 ||
14.m: With yellow [he should colour] the corners and other parts of the pedestal, but the limbs with red; / the four doorways should be white, and he should adorn each corner with red. // 39

14.s:
bāhye rekhātrayaṃ dadyādraktapītāsitāntimam |
antaḥśaktigatenaiva svaraṣoḍaśakena ca || 40 ||
14.d:
बाह्ये रेखात्रयं दद्याद्रक्तपीतासितान्तिमम् |
अन्तःशक्तिगतेनैव स्वरषोडशकेन च || 40 ||
14.m: On the outside he should draw three lines, ending in red, yellow, and black, / with the sixteen vowels adhering to the internal power. // 40

14.s: [maṇḍale prakārabhedāḥ phalabhedāśca]
14.d: [मण्डले प्रकारभेदाः फलभेदाश्च]
14.m: [Varieties of Maṇḍalas and Varieties of Their Fruits]

14.s:
athavā dvādaśāraṃ tu dvādaśasvarabhāvitam |
aṣṭāraṃ vilikhennityaṃ nābhinemisamanvitam || 41 ||
14.d:
अथवा द्वादशारं तु द्वादशस्वरभावितम् |
अष्टारं विलिखेन्नित्यं नाभिनेमिसमन्वितम् || 41 ||
14.m: Or else he should always draw [a wheel] of twelve spokes imbued with the twelve vowels, / or one of eight spokes, endowed with a hub and a rim, // 41

14.s:
vargāṣṭakena vai vyāptā arā ṛjvassuśobhanāḥ |
cakranābhau likhetpadmaṃ pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 42 ||
14.d:
वर्गाष्टकेन वै व्याप्ता अरा ऋज्वस्सुशोभनाः |
चक्रनाभौ लिखेत्पद्मं पूर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् || 42 ||
14.m: with its straight, very beautiful spokes pervaded by the eight [consonant] groups. / In the hub of the wheel he should draw a lotus marked with the previously mentioned characteristics. // 42

14.s:
śaṅkhodare'thavā lekhyaṃ paṅkajaṃ sumanoharam |
kaumodakyāṃ puro vā'pi bimbe vā kaustubhopame || 43 ||
14.d:
शङ्खोदरेऽथवा लेख्यं पङ्कजं सुमनोहरम् |
कौमोदक्यां पुरो वाऽपि बिम्बे वा कौस्तुभोपमे || 43 ||
14.m: Or a very captivating lotus is to be drawn inside a conch, / or on the Kaumodakī, or in front, or on a disk resembling the Kaustubha, // 43

14.s:
puṣpamālākṛtau vā'tha yathākāmāptaye mune |
svalāṃchanākṛtau yāge dadātyabhimataṃ viduḥ || 44 ||
14.d:
पुष्पमालाकृतौ वाऽथ यथाकामाप्तये मुने |
स्वलांछनाकृतौ यागे ददात्यभिमतं विदुः || 44 ||
14.m: or in the form of a garland of flowers, for attaining whatever is desired, O sage; / in a sacrifice performed in the shape of his own emblem, the wise know it gives what is wished. // 44

14.s:
navanābhau parāṃ siddhimaihikāmuṣmikīṃ labhet |
padmodare kṛte yāge sadā lakṣmīḥ pravardhate || 45 ||
14.d:
नवनाभौ परां सिद्धिमैहिकामुष्मिकीं लभेत् |
पद्मोदरे कृते यागे सदा लक्ष्मीः प्रवर्धते || 45 ||
14.m: In a [maṇḍala] of nine hubs he obtains supreme perfection, both in this world and the next; / when the sacrifice is made in the interior of a lotus, fortune ever increases. // 45

14.s:
cakramadhye bhavedrājyaṃ śatrupakṣakṣayaṅkaram |
śāntikarmaṇi vai śaṅkhe gadāyāṃ subhago bhavet || 46 ||
14.d:
चक्रमध्ये भवेद्राज्यं शत्रुपक्षक्षयङ्करम् |
शान्तिकर्मणि वै शङ्खे गदायां सुभगो भवेत् || 46 ||
14.m: In the center of a wheel there will be kingship that destroys the faction of enemies; / in a conch for pacifying rites; on a mace one becomes fortunate; // 46

14.s:
kaustubhe rājyalābhastu puṣṭirvai puṣpamaṇḍale |
eṣa padmodaro yāgaḥ padmādermadhyagaḥ smṛtaḥ || 47 ||
14.d:
कौस्तुभे राज्यलाभस्तु पुष्टिर्वै पुष्पमण्डले |
एष पद्मोदरो यागः पद्मादेर्मध्यगः स्मृतः || 47 ||
14.m: on a Kaustubha there is acquisition of kingship; and prosperity in a flower-circle. / This sacrifice in the belly of a lotus is remembered as centered on lotuses and the like. // 47

14.s:
[maṇḍalasyeva kumbha puṣpamaṇḍala sthaṇḍila pratimādīnāmapi
bāhyayāga pradeśatvavidhānam]
14.d:
[मण्डलस्येव कुम्भ पुष्पमण्डल स्थण्डिल प्रतिमादीनामपि
बाह्ययाग प्रदेशत्वविधानम्]
14.m: [Injunction of the Pitcher, Flower-Circle, Mound, Image, etc., Like the Maṇḍala, as Places for External Sacrifice]

14.s:
nānāvarṇakasaṃyuktastvanyaḥ kumbhodare śṛṇu |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vā ghaṭaṃ dṛḍham || 48 ||
14.d:
नानावर्णकसंयुक्तस्त्वन्यः कुम्भोदरे शृणु |
सौवर्णं राजतं ताम्रं मृण्मयं वा घटं दृढम् || 48 ||
14.m: Listen now to another [sacrifice] endowed with various colours, in the belly of a pitcher: / a firm pot of gold, silver, copper, or clay, // 48

14.s:
kālamūlaistu rahitaṃ trāsaprāṇavivarjitam | (?)
kṣīrapūrṇa tu taṃ kuryāddadhnā vā gandhavāriṇā || 49 ||
14.d:
कालमूलैस्तु रहितं त्रासप्राणविवर्जितम् | (?)
क्षीरपूर्ण तु तं कुर्याद्दध्ना वा गन्धवारिणा || 49 ||
14.m: free from black roots, devoid of cracks and flaws […]; / he should make it filled with milk, or curd, or perfumed water, // 49

14.s:
sarvaratnauṣadhīgāḍhaṃ kuśadūrvāphalodaram |
siddhārthakākṣatopetaṃ kuṅkumodakabhāvitam || 50 ||
14.d:
सर्वरत्नौषधीगाढं कुशदूर्वाफलोदरम् |
सिद्धार्थकाक्षतोपेतं कुङ्कुमोदकभावितम् || 50 ||
14.m: thick with all gems and medicinal herbs, with kuśa grass, dūrvā grass, and fruits inside, / accompanied by white mustard and unbroken grains, infused with saffron-water, // 50

14.s:
praśastataruśākhābhiḥ komalābhiralaṅkṛtam |
śaṅkhasvastikapadmaiśca carcitaṃ candanena ca || 51 ||
14.d:
प्रशस्ततरुशाखाभिः कोमलाभिरलङ्कृतम् |
शङ्खस्वस्तिकपद्मैश्च चर्चितं चन्दनेन च || 51 ||
14.m: adorned with tender branches of auspicious trees, / anointed with sandalwood and [marked with] conches, svastikas, and lotuses, // 51

14.s:
p. 111) śobhitaṃ ca sitairvastraiḥ paṭṭaiścaiva sragādibhiḥ |
tanmadhye cāsanaṃ padmaṃ tanmadhye tu janārdanaḥ || 52 ||
14.d:
प्. 111) शोभितं च सितैर्वस्त्रैः पट्टैश्चैव स्रगादिभिः |
तन्मध्ये चासनं पद्मं तन्मध्ये तु जनार्दनः || 52 ||
14.m: beautified with white cloths, silk fillets, garlands, and the like. / In the middle of it is a lotus seat, and in the middle of that is Janārdana, // 52

14.s:
vainateyoparisthastu lakṣmādyāḥ pūrvavatsthitāḥ |
saṃkṣepapūjanārthaṃ tu kumbhe yāgaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 53 ||
14.d:
वैनतेयोपरिस्थस्तु लक्ष्माद्याः पूर्ववत्स्थिताः |
संक्षेपपूजनार्थं तु कुम्भे यागः प्रकीर्तितः || 53 ||
14.m: situated upon Garuda, while Lakṣmī and the others stand as before. / For the purpose of condensed worship, the sacrifice is proclaimed to be in a pitcher. // 53

14.s:
upalipya sthalaṃ vātha gomayena mṛdāmbhasā |
varttulaṃ parīyāttatra dadyādvā caturaśrakam || 54 ||
14.d:
उपलिप्य स्थलं वाथ गोमयेन मृदाम्भसा |
वर्त्तुलं परीयात्तत्र दद्याद्वा चतुरश्रकम् || 54 ||
14.m: Or having smeared a spot of ground with cow-dung, earth, and water, / he should trace a circle there, or he should make a square, // 54

14.s:
yathā kālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pavitraiḥ kaṭamuktaye |
tatra saṃpūjayeddevamathavā munisattama || 55 ||
14.d:
यथा कालोद्भवैः पुष्पैः पवित्रैः कटमुक्तये |
तत्र संपूजयेद्देवमथवा मुनिसत्तम || 55 ||
14.m: with pure seasonal flowers, to be released from affliction; / there he should worship the God, or else, O best of sages, // 55

14.s:
ahataṃ susitaṃ vastraṃ dhūpagandhādivāsitam |
pṛṣṭhatastu sthale datvā tatropari yajeddharim || 56 ||
14.d:
अहतं सुसितं वस्त्रं धूपगन्धादिवासितम् |
पृष्ठतस्तु स्थले दत्वा तत्रोपरि यजेद्धरिम् || 56 ||
14.m: having placed upon the ground behind [it] a brand-new, bright-white cloth / perfumed with incense, scents, and the like, he should worship Hari upon it. // 56

14.s:
pratimāṃ kārayedvā'tha ghātumṛcchailadārujām |
sapadmaṃ kevalaṃ vā'tha bhadrapīṭhaṃ prakalpayet || 57 ||
14.d:
प्रतिमां कारयेद्वाऽथ घातुमृच्छैलदारुजाम् |
सपद्मं केवलं वाऽथ भद्रपीठं प्रकल्पयेत् || 57 ||
14.m: Or he should have an image made of metal, clay, stone, or wood; / or he should fashion an auspicious seat, either with a lotus or plain; // 57

14.s:
kevale toyamadhye vā dīpte'gnau dhūmavarjite |
sthitamāyatane vā'tha sākāraṃ parameśvaram || 58 ||
14.d:
केवले तोयमध्ये वा दीप्तेऽग्नौ धूमवर्जिते |
स्थितमायतने वाऽथ साकारं परमेश्वरम् || 58 ||
14.m: or in pure water alone, or in a blazing fire free from smoke, / or [worship] the Supreme Lord possessing form as situated in a temple. // 58

14.s:
śaṅkhacakradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ surasiddhāvadhāritam |
ṛṣibhirmanujairvā'tha bhaktiyuktaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || 59 ||
14.d:
शङ्खचक्रधरं विष्णुं सुरसिद्धावधारितम् |
ऋषिभिर्मनुजैर्वाऽथ भक्तियुक्तैः प्रतिष्ठितम् || 59 ||
14.m: [worship] Viṣṇu holding the conch and discus, comprehended by the gods and siddhas, / or established by ṛṣis or humans filled with devotion. // 59

14.s:
tanmūrtau ca svamantreṇa yajedāvāhanaṃ vinā |
bhūmiṣṭhe hyacale vipra pāṣāṇe cakralāṃcchite || 60 ||
14.d:
तन्मूर्तौ च स्वमन्त्रेण यजेदावाहनं विना |
भूमिष्ठे ह्यचले विप्र पाषाणे चक्रलांच्छिते || 60 ||
14.m: And in his image he should worship with his own mantra, without invocation, / or on an immovable stone fixed in the earth, O Brahmin, marked with a discus, // 60

14.s:
cale vā śaṅkhapadmākhyamudrābhirvipra mudrite |
tatropari yathāpūrvaṃ tathā saṃpūjayetprabhum || 61 ||
14.d:
चले वा शङ्खपद्माख्यमुद्राभिर्विप्र मुद्रिते |
तत्रोपरि यथापूर्वं तथा संपूजयेत्प्रभुम् || 61 ||
14.m: or on a movable [stone] stamped with the signs named Conch and Lotus, O Brahmin; / upon it he should worship the Lord as before. // 61

14.s:
ebhiryāgaparairmadhyādekaṃ niṣpādya yatnataḥ |
karmaṇā bhaktiyuktena pūjayetsarvakāmadam || 62 ||
14.d:
एभिर्यागपरैर्मध्यादेकं निष्पाद्य यत्नतः |
कर्मणा भक्तियुक्तेन पूजयेत्सर्वकामदम् || 62 ||
14.m: Having carefully prepared one from among these [supports] dedicated to sacrifice, / he should worship the granter of all desires with ritual action endowed with devotion, // 62

14.s: yathāśaktyupacāreṇa vibhavena tu vā mune |
14.d: यथाशक्त्युपचारेण विभवेन तु वा मुने |
14.m: or with means according to his ability, O sage.

14.s: [atha maṇḍale bāhyayāgaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [अथ मण्डले बाह्ययागप्रकारः]
14.m: [Now, the procedure of the external sacrifice in the maṇḍala]

14.s: arghyapātraṃ samādāya suvarṇarajatādijam || 63 ||
14.d: अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय सुवर्णरजतादिजम् || 63 ||
14.m: Having taken up an arghya-vessel made of gold, silver, or the like, // 63

14.s:
śailaṃ mṛddārujaṃ vā'tha palāśāṃbujaparṇajam |
astrodakena prakṣālya lepayetkuṅkumādibhiḥ || 64 ||
14.d:
शैलं मृद्दारुजं वाऽथ पलाशांबुजपर्णजम् |
अस्त्रोदकेन प्रक्षाल्य लेपयेत्कुङ्कुमादिभिः || 64 ||
14.m: or of stone, clay, or wood, or made of the leaves of palāśa or lotus, / washing it with astra-water, he should smear it with saffron and the like. // 64

14.s: anekāṅgaṃ ca tatrārghyaṃ yojayedastrasaṃskṛtam |
14.d: अनेकाङ्गं च तत्रार्घ्यं योजयेदस्त्रसंस्कृतम् |
14.m: And he should prepare therein the arghya consisting of many ingredients, consecrated with the astra.

14.s: p. 112) [arghyadravyāṇi]
14.d: प्. 112) [अर्घ्यद्रव्याणि]

14.s: siddhārthakāstilādūrvāssayavāssitataṇḍulāḥ || 65 ||
14.d: सिद्धार्थकास्तिलादूर्वास्सयवास्सिततण्डुलाः || 65 ||
14.m: White mustard seeds, sesamum, dūrvā grass, barley, white unbroken rice, // 65

14.s:
toyakṣīraphalopetā idamarghyamudāhṛtam |
āpyāyya mūlamantreṇa sudhāsandohamūrtinā || 66 ||
14.d:
तोयक्षीरफलोपेता इदमर्घ्यमुदाहृतम् |
आप्याय्य मूलमन्त्रेण सुधासन्दोहमूर्तिना || 66 ||
14.m: accompanied by water, milk, and fruit: this is declared to be the arghya. / Having invigorated it with the root-mantra whose nature is an abundance of nectar, // 66

14.s: [arghyasya viniyogaḥ]
14.d: [अर्घ्यस्य विनियोगः]

14.s:
pātradvayasthitaṃ tena kṛtvā bhāgadvayaṃ mune |
ekasminniṣkalādhāre saṃsthitaṃ niṣkalātmakam || 67 ||
14.d:
पात्रद्वयस्थितं तेन कृत्वा भागद्वयं मुने |
एकस्मिन्निष्कलाधारे संस्थितं निष्कलात्मकम् || 67 ||
14.m: having divided it into two parts placed in two vessels, O sage— / one residing in the partless vessel, of a partless nature, // 67

14.s:
mantracakraṃ svavīryeṇa prasphurattacca vinyaset |
saṃsthāpya maṇḍalāgre tu pūjyaṃ puṣpādinā purā || 68 ||
14.d:
मन्त्रचक्रं स्ववीर्येण प्रस्फुरत्तच्च विन्यसेत् |
संस्थाप्य मण्डलाग्रे तु पूज्यं पुष्पादिना पुरा || 68 ||
14.m: the circle of mantras, flashing with its own power, he should install; / having placed it before the maṇḍala, it is to be worshipped first with flowers and the like. // 68

14.s:
dhāraṇādvitayenaiva agnīṣomamayena ca |
samyagdvitīyaṃ saṃskuryādyathāvadavadhāraya || 69 ||
14.d:
धारणाद्वितयेनैव अग्नीषोममयेन च |
सम्यग्द्वितीयं संस्कुर्याद्यथावदवधारय || 69 ||
14.m: By means of the two dhāraṇās, consisting of fire and moon, / he should properly consecrate the second; hear [how] in due order: // 69

14.s:
pracaṇḍakiraṇavrātairbhāskarīyairdahetpurā |
saṃcintya bhasmabhūtaṃ tu tataḥ pūrṇenduraśmibhiḥ || 70 ||
14.d:
प्रचण्डकिरणव्रातैर्भास्करीयैर्दहेत्पुरा |
संचिन्त्य भस्मभूतं तु ततः पूर्णेन्दुरश्मिभिः || 70 ||
14.m: he should first burn [the substances] with the fierce rays belonging to the sun; / having meditated upon [them] as reduced to ashes, then, with the rays of the full moon, // 70

14.s:
āpūryāmṛtakalloladhārāpātena nārada |
kāntimaccintayedbhūyo yaddagdhaṃ bhānunā tu vai || 71 ||
14.d:
आपूर्यामृतकल्लोलधारापातेन नारद |
कान्तिमच्चिन्तयेद्भूयो यद्दग्धं भानुना तु वै || 71 ||
14.m: having flooded them with a falling stream of waves of nectar, O Nārada, / he should meditate again upon that which was burned by the sun as radiant. // 71

14.s:
mūlamantrādibhirmukhyairmantraistadabhimantrya ca |
badhvākāmadudhāṃ mudrāṃ sravantīṃ mantrasaṃyutām || 72 ||
14.d:
मूलमन्त्रादिभिर्मुख्यैर्मन्त्रैस्तदभिमन्त्र्य च |
बध्वाकामदुधां मुद्रां स्रवन्तीं मन्त्रसंयुताम् || 72 ||
14.m: And having consecrated that with the principal mantras, beginning with the root-mantra, / having formed the wish-granting cow mudrā, flowing, accompanied by mantra, // 72

14.s:
gorūpāṃ himaśailābhāṃ nirādhārapathasthitām |
gandhadigdhau karau kṛtvā arghyapātroddhṛtena ca || 73 ||
14.d:
गोरूपां हिमशैलाभां निराधारपथस्थिताम् |
गन्धदिग्धौ करौ कृत्वा अर्घ्यपात्रोद्धृतेन च || 73 ||
14.m: having the form of a cow, resembling the snow-mountain, situated on the path without support; / having anointed both hands with perfume, with [water] taken from the arghya-vessel // 73

14.s:
maṇḍalaṃ maṇṭapaṃ prokṣya yāgadravyāṇyaśeṣataḥ |
dāhayedastramantreṇa mūlena plāvayettataḥ || 74 ||
14.d:
मण्डलं मण्टपं प्रोक्ष्य यागद्रव्याण्यशेषतः |
दाहयेदस्त्रमन्त्रेण मूलेन प्लावयेत्ततः || 74 ||
14.m: having sprinkled the maṇḍala, the pavilion, and all the sacrificial substances without exception, / he should burn [them] with the astra-mantra, and then inundate [them] with the root-mantra. // 74

14.s:
nirmalo dravyasaṅghaśca yāgayogyo bhavettadā |
namaskṛtya tato viṣṇuṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaret || 75 ||
14.d:
निर्मलो द्रव्यसङ्घश्च यागयोग्यो भवेत्तदा |
नमस्कृत्य ततो विष्णुं मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चरेत् || 75 ||
14.m: Then the collection of substances becomes spotless and fit for sacrifice. / Having then bowed down to Viṣṇu, he should utter the root-mantra. // 75

14.s: [dvārapūjā]
14.d: [द्वारपूजा]

14.s:
svamūrtisaṃsthitaḥ pūjyaḥ puṣpairañjalisaṃsthitaiḥ |
arghyapātraṃ samādāya puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ vilepanam || 76 ||
14.d:
स्वमूर्तिसंस्थितः पूज्यः पुष्पैरञ्जलिसंस्थितैः |
अर्घ्यपात्रं समादाय पुष्पं धूपं विलेपनम् || 76 ||
14.m: Abiding in his own form, he is to be worshipped with flowers held in joined palms. / Having taken up the arghya-vessel, [offering] flowers, incense, ointment, // 76

14.s: dīpanaivedyaparyantaṃ dvāraṃ bāhyaṃ tato yajet |
14.d: दीपनैवेद्यपर्यन्तं द्वारं बाह्यं ततो यजेत् |
14.m: up to lamp and food-offering, he should then worship the outer door.

14.s: [dvāradevatāpūjā]
14.d: [द्वारदेवतापूजा]

14.s: udumbarasya mūle tu bahirdvārasya madhyataḥ || 77 ||
14.d: उदुम्बरस्य मूले तु बहिर्द्वारस्य मध्यतः || 77 ||
14.m: At the base of the threshold, in the middle of the outer door, // 77

14.s:
p. 113) bhūmiṣṭhaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca pūjayettadanantaram |
dvāropari sthitāṃ lakṣmīmūrdhvasaṃsthaṃ udumbare || 78 ||
14.d:
प्. 113) भूमिष्ठं क्षेत्रपालं च पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् |
द्वारोपरि स्थितां लक्ष्मीमूर्ध्वसंस्थं उदुम्बरे || 78 ||
14.m: p. 113) he should immediately thereafter worship Kṣetrapāla situated on the ground, / and Lakṣmī situated above the door, on the upper lintel; // 78

14.s:
dakṣiṇottaraśākhābhyāṃ mūle caṇḍapracaṇḍakau |
tadvajjayaṃ ca vijayaṃ bāhye dvārasya cāntare || 79 ||
14.d:
दक्षिणोत्तरशाखाभ्यां मूले चण्डप्रचण्डकौ |
तद्वज्जयं च विजयं बाह्ये द्वारस्य चान्तरे || 79 ||
14.m: on the right and left jambs at the base, Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa, / and likewise Jaya and Vijaya, on the outside and the inside of the door; // 79

14.s:
śākhādvayasya madhye tu vāmadakṣiṇataḥ kramāt |
gaṅgāṃ ca yamunāṃ caiva pūjayettadanantaram || 80 ||
14.d:
शाखाद्वयस्य मध्ये तु वामदक्षिणतः क्रमात् |
गङ्गां च यमुनां चैव पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् || 80 ||
14.m: in the middle of the two jambs, on the left and right in order, / he should immediately thereafter worship Gaṅgā and Yamunā. // 80

14.s:
tenaiva kramayogena dvārasyābhyantarasthitau |
nidhīśau śaṅkhapadmākhyāvarghyapuṣpādibhiryajet || 81 ||
14.d:
तेनैव क्रमयोगेन द्वारस्याभ्यन्तरस्थितौ |
निधीशौ शङ्खपद्माख्यावर्घ्यपुष्पादिभिर्यजेत् || 81 ||
14.m: In that very same sequence, the two treasure-guardians named Śaṅkha and Padma / situated within the door, he should worship with arghya, flowers, and the like. // 81

14.s: [yāgamaṃdirapraveśavidhiḥ]
14.d: [यागमंदिरप्रवेशविधिः]
14.m: [Rule for entering the sacrifice chamber]

14.s:
kṛtvaiva dvārayāgaṃ tu tataḥ puṣpaṃ ca sammukham |
gṛhītvā'ṅguṣṭhapūrveṇa aṅgulītritayena tu || 82 ||
14.d:
कृत्वैव द्वारयागं तु ततः पुष्पं च सम्मुखम् |
गृहीत्वाऽङ्गुष्ठपूर्वेण अङ्गुलीत्रितयेन तु || 82 ||
14.m: Having performed the sacrifice at the door, taking a flower in front / with the three fingers beginning with the thumb, // 82

14.s:
abhimantrya tadastreṇa cakraṃ tadupari smaret |
niśitāraṃ jvaladrūpaṃ varṣantamanalāśanim || 83 ||
14.d:
अभिमन्त्र्य तदस्त्रेण चक्रं तदुपरि स्मरेत् |
निशितारं ज्वलद्रूपं वर्षन्तमनलाशनिम् || 83 ||
14.m: consecrating it with the astra, he should visualize the discus above it, / sharp-spoked, blazing in form, raining fire and thunderbolts, // 83

14.s:
kṣayakṛdvighnajālānāṃ kṣipedyāgagṛhāntare |
dakṣiṇāṃ tarjanīṃ vipra kuryādūrdhvamukhīṃ tataḥ || 84 ||
14.d:
क्षयकृद्विघ्नजालानां क्षिपेद्यागगृहान्तरे |
दक्षिणां तर्जनीं विप्र कुर्यादूर्ध्वमुखीं ततः || 84 ||
14.m: the destroyer of all obstacles, and cast [it] into the sacrificial chamber. / Then, O Brahmin, he should point the right forefinger upwards, // 84

14.s:
śikhāmantreṇa saṃyuktāṃ vidyudvilasitaprabhām |
smṛtvā bhrāmayamāṇastāṃ saṃviśedyāgamandiram || 85 ||
14.d:
शिखामन्त्रेण संयुक्तां विद्युद्विलसितप्रभाम् |
स्मृत्वा भ्रामयमाणस्तां संविशेद्यागमन्दिरम् || 85 ||
14.m: joined with the śikhā-mantra, having the flashing brilliance of lightning; / visualizing it, turning it around, he should enter the sacrificial chamber. // 85

14.s: [upaveśanaśeṣabhūtamāsanaprokṣaṇādi]
14.d: [उपवेशनशेषभूतमासनप्रोक्षणादि]
14.m: [Sprinkling the seat and other preliminaries to sitting]

14.s:
svāsanaṃ ca tataḥ prokṣya arghyapātrodakena ca |
sāstreṇa tāḍya puṣpeṇa tatpṛṣṭhe kramaśo dvija || 86 ||
14.d:
स्वासनं च ततः प्रोक्ष्य अर्घ्यपात्रोदकेन च |
सास्त्रेण ताड्य पुष्पेण तत्पृष्ठे क्रमशो द्विज || 86 ||
14.m: Then, having sprinkled his own seat with the water from the arghya-vessel, / striking it with a flower accompanied by the astra, on its surface in order, O twice-born, // 86

14.s:
ādhāraśaktipūrvaṃ tu mantrasaṅghaṃ prapūjayet |
upaviśya tataḥ paścāt
14.d:
आधारशक्तिपूर्वं तु मन्त्रसङ्घं प्रपूजयेत् |
उपविश्य ततः पश्चात्
14.m: he should worship the collection of mantras beginning with Ādhāraśakti. / Having then sat down,

14.s: [pūjanāṅgabhūtāvekṣaṇaprokṣaṇaviśeṣau]
14.d: [पूजनाङ्गभूतावेक्षणप्रोक्षणविशेषौ]
14.m: [The special gaze and sprinkling as limbs of worship]

14.s: hṛdayasthaṃ ca tatparam || 87 ||
14.d: हृदयस्थं च तत्परम् || 87 ||
14.m: and that supreme // 87

14.s:
tejo nārāyaṇākhyaṃ tu tatkuryānnetramadhyagam |
vāsudevābhidhānaṃ tu prāguktaṃ ca samāśrayet || 88 ||
14.d:
तेजो नारायणाख्यं तु तत्कुर्यान्नेत्रमध्यगम् |
वासुदेवाभिधानं तु प्रागुक्तं च समाश्रयेत् || 88 ||
14.m: splendour situated in the heart, called Nārāyaṇa, he should bring into the centre of his eyes; / and he should resort to that named Vāsudeva which was spoken of before. // 88

14.s:
nirīkṣya sakalaṃ samyakstabdhanetrayugena ca |
maṇḍalañcārghyapātraṃ tu punaḥ prokṣya kuśāmbhasā || 89 ||
14.d:
निरीक्ष्य सकलं सम्यक्स्तब्धनेत्रयुगेन च |
मण्डलञ्चार्घ्यपात्रं तु पुनः प्रोक्ष्य कुशाम्भसा || 89 ||
14.m: Having looked upon everything thoroughly with unblinking eyes, / and having again sprinkled the maṇḍala and the arghya-vessel with kuśa-water, // 89

14.s: [ādhāraśaktyādyāsanakalpanatatpūjanakramaḥ]
14.d: [आधारशक्त्याद्यासनकल्पनतत्पूजनक्रमः]
14.m: [The procedure of fashioning and worshipping the seats beginning with Ādhāraśakti]

14.s:
pūjanaṃ prārabhetpaścātsārdhyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ krameṇa tu |
p. 114) ādhāraśakterārabhya anusandhānapūrvakam || 90 ||
14.d:
पूजनं प्रारभेत्पश्चात्सार्ध्यैः पुष्पैः क्रमेण तु |
प्. 114) आधारशक्तेरारभ्य अनुसन्धानपूर्वकम् || 90 ||
14.m: he should then begin the worship in order with flowers and arghya, / p. 114) starting from Ādhāraśakti, accompanied by meditation. // 90

14.s:
yugāvasānaṃ prāk datvā sthūlaṃ mantrāsanāsanam |
tatrordhve madhyadeśe'pi prāguktavidhinā nyaset || 91 ||
14.d:
युगावसानं प्राक् दत्वा स्थूलं मन्त्रासनासनम् |
तत्रोर्ध्वे मध्यदेशेऽपि प्रागुक्तविधिना न्यसेत् || 91 ||
14.m: Having first offered the gross seat of the mantras up to the end of the yuga, / above it, in the central region also, he should install [them] according to the previously stated rule: // 91

14.s:
dviraṣṭakaṃ tu dharmādyaṃ kāntimatpararūpadhṛt |
tacca ṣoḍaśakaṃ nyasya bhūyo bhūyo digaṣṭake || 92 ||
14.d:
द्विरष्टकं तु धर्माद्यं कान्तिमत्पररूपधृत् |
तच्च षोडशकं न्यस्य भूयो भूयो दिगष्टके || 92 ||
14.m: the twice-eight, beginning with dharma, radiant, bearing the supreme form. / And having installed that group of sixteen again and again in the eight directions, // 92

14.s:
sūkṣmarūpadharaṃ vipra prākpadādīśagocaram |
padmādivanhiveśmāntamekaikasminnyasettataḥ || 93 ||
14.d:
सूक्ष्मरूपधरं विप्र प्राक्पदादीशगोचरम् |
पद्मादिवन्हिवेश्मान्तमेकैकस्मिन्न्यसेत्ततः || 93 ||
14.m: assuming a subtle form, O Brahmin, from the east to the northeast, / from the lotus to the fire-enclosure, he should install them on each one. // 93

14.s:
tadeva garbhadeśasthaṃ hyanusandhāya vinyaset |
bhāvāsanāvasānāntaṃ (naṃ tat ?) mantraiḥ svaissvairathārcayet || 94 ||
14.d:
तदेव गर्भदेशस्थं ह्यनुसन्धाय विन्यसेत् |
भावासनावसानान्तं (नं तत् ?) मन्त्रैः स्वैस्स्वैरथार्चयेत् || 94 ||
14.m: Meditating on that very [group] situated in the central womb, he should install it; / up to the end of the bhāvāsana, he should then worship [them] each with their own mantras, // 94

14.s: uparyupari yogena puṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ |
14.d: उपर्युपरि योगेन पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः |
14.m: one above the other in sequence, with flowers, incense, and ointments.

14.s: [caturasrāyatamaṇḍalakalpanam]
14.d: [चतुरस्रायतमण्डलकल्पनम्]
14.m: [Fashioning the rectangular maṇḍala]

14.s: yugāvasāne pīṭhasya pṛṣṭhe vidhisamīpataḥ || 95 ||
14.d: युगावसाने पीठस्य पृष्ठे विधिसमीपतः || 95 ||
14.m: At the end of the yuga, at the back of the seat, near the ritual enclosure, // 95

14.s:
kalpanājanitaṃ kuryāccaturasrāyataṃ tataḥ |
maṇḍalaṃ devadevasya dakṣiṇe maṇḍalopari || 96 ||
14.d:
कल्पनाजनितं कुर्याच्चतुरस्रायतं ततः |
मण्डलं देवदेवस्य दक्षिणे मण्डलोपरि || 96 ||
14.m: he should then make, generated by mental conception, an oblong rectangular / maṇḍala to the right of the God of gods, above the maṇḍala, // 96

14.s: vāyavyakoṇādārabhya yāvadīśānagocaram |
14.d: वायव्यकोणादारभ्य यावदीशानगोचरम् |
14.m: starting from the northwest corner up to the domain of the northeast.

14.s: [gaṇeśādipūjanam]
14.d: [गणेशादिपूजनम्]

14.s: tatrādau tu svamantreṇa gaṇeśaṃ pūjayetdvijaḥ || 97 ||
14.d: तत्रादौ तु स्वमन्त्रेण गणेशं पूजयेत्द्विजः || 97 ||
14.m: There, first of all, the twice-born should worship Gaṇeśa with his own mantra; // 97

14.s:
tato vāgīśvarīṃ devīṃ tadante garuḍaṃ yajet |
pūjayecca tato bhaktyā guruṃ paramasaṃjñitat || 98 ||
14.d:
ततो वागीश्वरीं देवीं तदन्ते गरुडं यजेत् |
पूजयेच्च ततो भक्त्या गुरुं परमसंज्ञितत् || 98 ||
14.m: then the goddess Vāgīśvarī, and after that he should worship Garuda; / then with devotion he should worship the guru designated as supreme. // 98

14.s:
parameṣṭhī tataḥ pūjyastataḥ pitṛgaṇaṃ yajet |
ādisiddhasamūhaṃ ca bhagavaddhyānatatparam || 99 ||
14.d:
परमेष्ठी ततः पूज्यस्ततः पितृगणं यजेत् |
आदिसिद्धसमूहं च भगवद्ध्यानतत्परम् || 99 ||
14.m: Parameṣṭhin is then to be worshipped; then he should worship the host of ancestors / and the group of primordial siddhas intent on meditation on the Lord. // 99

14.s: anujñāṃ prārthayettebhyo yathānukramameva ca |
14.d: अनुज्ञां प्रार्थयेत्तेभ्यो यथानुक्रममेव च |
14.m: He should request permission from them in proper order.

14.s: [hṛdayakamalādbhagavata āvāhana pūjanaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [हृदयकमलाद्भगवत आवाहन पूजनप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of invocation and worship of the Lord from the lotus of the heart]

14.s: gṛhītvā śirasā tāṃ ca tata āvāhayetprabhum || 100 ||
14.d: गृहीत्वा शिरसा तां च तत आवाहयेत्प्रभुम् || 100 ||
14.m: Receiving it with his head, he should then invoke the Lord. // 100

14.s:
āvāhya mantreṇa mune mudrāyuktena bhaktitaḥ |
proccārya mūlamantraṃ tu hṛdayasthaṃ ca sarvagam || 101 ||
14.d:
आवाह्य मन्त्रेण मुने मुद्रायुक्तेन भक्तितः |
प्रोच्चार्य मूलमन्त्रं तु हृदयस्थं च सर्वगम् || 101 ||
14.m: Invoking with the mantra, O sage, joined with the mudrā, with devotion, / and pronouncing the root-mantra residing in the heart and all-pervading, // 101

14.s:
avatārya krameṇaiva recakena śanaiśśanaiḥ |
nāḍībhyāṃ sandhideśena nīrūpeṇāmalena ca || 102 ||
14.d:
अवतार्य क्रमेणैव रेचकेन शनैश्शनैः |
नाडीभ्यां सन्धिदेशेन नीरूपेणामलेन च || 102 ||
14.m: gradually bringing [him] down very slowly with exhalation, / through the channels by the junction point, formless, taintless, // 102

14.s:
kalpanārahitenaiva cidbhāvābhāsitena ca |
sarvagasya tato vipra sārghyaṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ vibhoḥ || 103 ||
14.d:
कल्पनारहितेनैव चिद्भावाभासितेन च |
सर्वगस्य ततो विप्र सार्घ्यं पुष्पाञ्जलिं विभोः || 103 ||
14.m: free from conceptual thought, and illuminated by the nature of consciousness; / then, O brahmin, [offering] to the all-pervading Lord an añjali of flowers with arghya, // 103

14.s:
p. 115) nikṣipyāthomukhenaiva pāṇiyugmena mūrdhani |
layayāgoktavidhinā pūjayetprathamaṃ tataḥ || 104 ||
14.d:
प्. 115) निक्षिप्याथोमुखेनैव पाणियुग्मेन मूर्धनि |
लययागोक्तविधिना पूजयेत्प्रथमं ततः || 104 ||
14.m: having cast [it] upon his head with both hands facing downwards, / he should then first worship according to the procedure taught for the dissolution sacrifice, // 104

14.s: puṣpārghyalepanairdhūpairmūlamantrādibhiḥ kramāt |
14.d: पुष्पार्घ्यलेपनैर्धूपैर्मूलमन्त्रादिभिः क्रमात् |
14.m: with flowers, arghya, unguents, and incenses, in order with the root-mantra and the rest.

14.s: [lakṣmyādīnāṃ dhyānapūrvako nyāsakramaḥ]
14.d: [लक्ष्म्यादीनां ध्यानपूर्वको न्यासक्रमः]
14.m: [The order of installation preceded by meditation on Lakṣmī and the others]

14.s: tato bhagavato viṣṇorbhāsā bhāsvaravigrahāt || 105 ||
14.d: ततो भगवतो विष्णोर्भासा भास्वरविग्रहात् || 105 ||
14.m: Then, from the Lord Viṣṇu whose form is radiant with light, // 105

14.s:
lakṣmyādīrnissṛtā dhyāyetsphuliṅganicayā yathā |
bhogasthāne yathāyogamekaikaṃ vinyasettataḥ || 106 ||
14.d:
लक्ष्म्यादीर्निस्सृता ध्यायेत्स्फुलिङ्गनिचया यथा |
भोगस्थाने यथायोगमेकैकं विन्यसेत्ततः || 106 ||
14.m: he should meditate on Lakṣmī and the others emerging like hosts of sparks; / he should then install each one appropriately in the place of enjoyment. // 106

14.s: [maṇḍale mantranyāsakramaḥ]
14.d: [मण्डले मन्त्रन्यासक्रमः]
14.m: [The order of installation of mantras on the maṇḍala]

14.s:
maṇḍalopari mantraṃ ca yathā tadavadhāraya |
ūrdhvataḥ padmamadhye tu yathā bhūtaṃ tathā nyaset || 107 ||
14.d:
मण्डलोपरि मन्त्रं च यथा तदवधारय |
ऊर्ध्वतः पद्ममध्ये तु यथा भूतं तथा न्यसेत् || 107 ||
14.m: And comprehend how the mantra [is placed] upon the maṇḍala: / from above, in the middle of the lotus, he should install [it] just as it is, // 107

14.s:
mūlamantraṃ dvijaśreṣṭha mūrtiyuktaṃ tu pūrvavat |
tadagrasaṃsthite padme lakṣmīṃ vai karṇikāntare || 108 ||
14.d:
मूलमन्त्रं द्विजश्रेष्ठ मूर्तियुक्तं तु पूर्ववत् |
तदग्रसंस्थिते पद्मे लक्ष्मीं वै कर्णिकान्तरे || 108 ||
14.m: the root-mantra endowed with the form as before, O best of the twice-born. / On the lotus situated in front of that, Lakṣmī indeed within the pericarp; // 108

14.s:
kīrti dakṣiṇabhāgasthe pṛṣṭhage tu jayāṃ nyaset |
māyāṃ cottarapadme tu karṇikānte'tha vinyaset || 109 ||
14.d:
कीर्ति दक्षिणभागस्थे पृष्ठगे तु जयां न्यसेत् |
मायां चोत्तरपद्मे तु कर्णिकान्तेऽथ विन्यसेत् || 109 ||
14.m: on the one on the southern side, Kīrti; on the one behind, he should install Jayā; / and on the northern lotus, within the pericarp, he should then install Māyā; // 109

14.s:
āgneye hṛdayaṃ madhye śirastvīśānapaṅkaje |
śikhāṃ rākṣasadiṅmadhye kavacaṃ vāyugocare || 110 ||
14.d:
आग्नेये हृदयं मध्ये शिरस्त्वीशानपङ्कजे |
शिखां राक्षसदिङ्मध्ये कवचं वायुगोचरे || 110 ||
