14.m: in the south-east, the heart; in the middle of the north-eastern lotus, the head; / in the middle of the south-western quarter, the śikhā; in the reach of the north-west, the armour; // 110

14.s:
atha madhyasthite padme devasya purato dale |
netramantraṃ vinyasettu vidikpatreṣu cāstrarāṭ || 111 ||
14.d:
अथ मध्यस्थिते पद्मे देवस्य पुरतो दले |
नेत्रमन्त्रं विन्यसेत्तु विदिक्पत्रेषु चास्त्रराट् || 111 ||
14.m: then on the petal situated in front of the deity in the lotus located in the center, / he should install the eye-mantra, and the king of weapons on the petals of the intermediate directions. // 111

14.s:
atraiva nārasihmākhyaṃ(dyaṃ ?) varāhāntatrayaṃ kramāt |
dikṣu patratrayaṃ(ye ?) viṣṇoryāmye pratyaktathottare || 112 ||
14.d:
अत्रैव नारसिह्माख्यं(द्यं ?) वराहान्तत्रयं क्रमात् |
दिक्षु पत्रत्रयं(ये ?) विष्णोर्याम्ये प्रत्यक्तथोत्तरे || 112 ||
14.m: Here itself the triad beginning with Narasiṃha and ending with Varāha in order, / in the cardinal directions, on the three petals of Viṣṇu: in the south, in the west, and in the north. // 112

14.s:
lakṣmīkamalayantrā(patrā ?)ṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ kaustubhaṃ nyaset |
tadvaddhṛtpaṅkajīyānāṃ vanamālāṃ niveśya ca || 113 ||
14.d:
लक्ष्मीकमलयन्त्रा(पत्रा ?)णां सर्वेषां कौस्तुभं न्यसेत् |
तद्वद्धृत्पङ्कजीयानां वनमालां निवेश्य च || 113 ||
14.m: On all petals of Lakṣmī's lotus, he should install the Kaustubha; / likewise, having introduced the forest-garland on those belonging to the heart-lotus; // 113

14.s:
kīrtipaṅkajapatrāṇāṃ padmamāhūya vinyaset |
śaṅkhaṃ śikhābjapatrāṇāṃ jayābje cakrameva ca || 114 ||
14.d:
कीर्तिपङ्कजपत्राणां पद्ममाहूय विन्यसेत् |
शङ्खं शिखाब्जपत्राणां जयाब्जे चक्रमेव च || 114 ||
14.m: on the petals of Kīrti's lotus, invoking, he should install the lotus; / the conch on the petals of the śikhā's lotus, and the discus on Jayā's lotus; // 114

14.s:
tatastu tatra padme tu patrasthāṃ vinyasedgadām |
māyāmbujacchade vipra nyasetpāśaṃ tato dvija || 115 ||
14.d:
ततस्तु तत्र पद्मे तु पत्रस्थां विन्यसेद्गदाम् |
मायाम्बुजच्छदे विप्र न्यसेत्पाशं ततो द्विज || 115 ||
14.m: then on that lotus, he should install the mace situated on the petal; / on the petal of Māyā's lotus, O brahmin, he should then install the noose, O twice-born; // 115

14.s:
śīrṣādhāre tu vai padme patrāṇāmaṅkuśaṃ tataḥ |
nyaseddvāracatuṣke tu samāhūya khageśvaram || 116 ||
14.d:
शीर्षाधारे तु वै पद्मे पत्राणामङ्कुशं ततः |
न्यसेद्द्वारचतुष्के तु समाहूय खगेश्वरम् || 116 ||
14.m: on the lotus that is the base of the head, then the goad on its petals; / then in the four doorways, having invoked the lord of birds, // 116

14.s:
p. 116) karṇikāyāṃ nyasetsatyaṃ hṛnmantrasya tato(tho ?)pari |
āśritya dakṣiṇaṃ bhāgamatha brahmāmbujopari || 117 ||
14.d:
प्. 116) कर्णिकायां न्यसेत्सत्यं हृन्मन्त्रस्य ततो(थो ?)परि |
आश्रित्य दक्षिणं भागमथ ब्रह्माम्बुजोपरि || 117 ||
14.m: he should install Satya on the pericarp, then above the heart-mantra, / resorting to the right side; then upon the lotus of Brahman, // 117

14.s:
mūrtaṃ mūrtavyapekṣāyāṃ nyastaṃ mantreṣu nārada |
śirasyūrdhve tu vinyasya vāsudevaṃ tathaiva ca || 118 ||
14.d:
मूर्तं मूर्तव्यपेक्षायां न्यस्तं मन्त्रेषु नारद |
शिरस्यूर्ध्वे तु विन्यस्य वासुदेवं तथैव च || 118 ||
14.m: the manifest [one] when expecting the manifest is installed upon the mantras, O Nārada. / And having installed Vāsudeva above on the head in that manner, // 118

14.s:
śikhāyāmupari nyāsaṃ kuryātsaṅkarṣaṇasya tu |
athordhve karṇikāyāstu pradyumnaṃ kavacopari || 119 ||
14.d:
शिखायामुपरि न्यासं कुर्यात्सङ्कर्षणस्य तु |
अथोर्ध्वे कर्णिकायास्तु प्रद्युम्नं कवचोपरि || 119 ||
14.m: he should perform the installation of Saṅkarṣaṇa above upon the śikhā; / then above the pericarp, Pradyumna upon the armour; // 119

14.s:
lakṣmyādiṣvaniruddhaṃ ca ādheyatvena copari |
tatassaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ mūlamantropari nyaset || 120 ||
14.d:
लक्ष्म्यादिष्वनिरुद्धं च आधेयत्वेन चोपरि |
ततस्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं मूलमन्त्रोपरि न्यसेत् || 120 ||
14.m: and Aniruddha upon Lakṣmī and the others, as that which is supported above. / Then he should install the seven-syllable mantra upon the root-mantra; // 120

14.s:
prācyādāvīśaparyantamindrādyaṃ cāṣṭakaṃ bahiḥ |
nāgeśaṃ vinyaseccheṣamadhaḥsthamatha cordhvagam || 121 ||
14.d:
प्राच्यादावीशपर्यन्तमिन्द्राद्यं चाष्टकं बहिः |
नागेशं विन्यसेच्छेषमधःस्थमथ चोर्ध्वगम् || 121 ||
14.m: outside, the group of eight beginning with Indra from the east up to the lord of the north-east; / he should install the lord of serpents, Śeṣa, below, and then above, // 121

14.s:
brahmāṇaṃ ca sureśānamevaṃ lokeśasantatim |
nyasettadanu cāstrāṇi bahisteṣāṃ tu vinyaset || 122 ||
14.d:
ब्रह्माणं च सुरेशानमेवं लोकेशसन्ततिम् |
न्यसेत्तदनु चास्त्राणि बहिस्तेषां तु विन्यसेत् || 122 ||
14.m: Brahmā, the lord of the gods. In this way he should install the succession of world-protectors. / After that, he should install the weapons outside them, // 122

14.s:
pūrvādikramayogena yāvadīśānagocaram |
adho nāgeśvarāstraṃ ca brahmāstramupari nyaset || 123 ||
14.d:
पूर्वादिक्रमयोगेन यावदीशानगोचरम् |
अधो नागेश्वरास्त्रं च ब्रह्मास्त्रमुपरि न्यसेत् || 123 ||
14.m: by order beginning with the east up to the realm of the north-east; / and below, the weapon of the lord of serpents, and above, he should install the weapon of Brahmā. // 123

14.s:
tryambakottaradigbhyāṃ tu madhyataḥ khasthitaṃ smaret |
viṣvaksenaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha āyāntaṃ gaganāntarāt || 124 ||
14.d:
त्र्यम्बकोत्तरदिग्भ्यां तु मध्यतः खस्थितं स्मरेत् |
विष्वक्सेनं द्विजश्रेष्ठ आयान्तं गगनान्तरात् || 124 ||
14.m: Between the north-east and the north, he should remember Viṣvaksena / stationed in the sky in the middle, O best of the twice-born, arriving from the midst of the heavens. // 124

14.s: evaṃ nyāsaṃ purā kṛtvā mantrāṇāṃ maṇḍalāntare |
14.d: एवं न्यासं पुरा कृत्वा मन्त्राणां मण्डलान्तरे |
14.m: Having previously performed the installation of mantras within the maṇḍala in this way, // 125

14.s: [atha mantrāṇāṃ yathānyāsaṃ dhyānavidhiḥ]
14.d: [अथ मन्त्राणां यथान्यासं ध्यानविधिः]
14.m: [The rule of meditation on the mantras according to their installation]

14.s: tatassaṃcintayeddhyānamekaikasya yathāsthitam || 125 ||
14.d: ततस्संचिन्तयेद्ध्यानमेकैकस्य यथास्थितम् || 125 ||
14.m: he should then contemplate the visualization of each one as it stands. // 125

14.s:
mūlamantrasya devā(vī ?)nāṃ purā proktaṃ mayā mune |
noktaṃ yaddhṛdayādīnāṃ tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu || 126 ||
14.d:
मूलमन्त्रस्य देवा(वी ?)नां पुरा प्रोक्तं मया मुने |
नोक्तं यद्धृदयादीनां तदेकाग्रमनाः शृणु || 126 ||
14.m: That of the root-mantra and of the goddesses was taught by me previously, O sage; / hear with a focused mind that of the heart and the others which was not spoken: // 126

14.s: [hṛdayamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [हृदयमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the heart-mantra]

14.s:
sitaśoṇitavarṇābhamekavaktraṃ caturbhujam |
garuḍāsanasaṃsthaṃ ca padmaśaṅkhakarānvitam || 127 ||
14.d:
सितशोणितवर्णाभमेकवक्त्रं चतुर्भुजम् |
गरुडासनसंस्थं च पद्मशङ्खकरान्वितम् || 127 ||
14.m: Possessing the lustrous hue of white and red, single-faced, four-armed, / seated on the throne of Garuda, and endowed with lotus and conch in his hands; // 127

14.s:
mudrālaṅkṛtimat dhyāyeddakṣiṇaṃ cāparaṃ karam |
vāmapāṇiṃ dvitīyaṃ ca saṃyuktamabhayena tu || 128 ||
14.d:
मुद्रालङ्कृतिमत् ध्यायेद्दक्षिणं चापरं करम् |
वामपाणिं द्वितीयं च संयुक्तमभयेन तु || 128 ||
14.m: he should meditate on the other right hand as ornamented with the mudrā, / and the second left hand endowed with [the gesture of] fearlessness; // 128

14.s:
sitābharaṇamālyaiśca karpūrāliptavigraham |
sammukhaṃ devadevasya hṛnmantraṃ saṃsmaretsadā || 129 ||
14.d:
सिताभरणमाल्यैश्च कर्पूरालिप्तविग्रहम् |
सम्मुखं देवदेवस्य हृन्मन्त्रं संस्मरेत्सदा || 129 ||
14.m: his body smeared with camphor, with white ornaments and garlands, / facing the god of gods: he should constantly remember the heart-mantra. // 129

14.s: p. 117) [śiromantradhyāna prakāraḥ]
14.d: प्. 117) [शिरोमन्त्रध्यान प्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the head-mantra]

14.s:
bandhujīvopamaṃ raktaṃ padmacakrodyataṃdvija |
svamudrāsaṃyutaṃ dhyāyetpāṇinā varadena ca || 130 ||
14.d:
बन्धुजीवोपमं रक्तं पद्मचक्रोद्यतंद्विज |
स्वमुद्रासंयुतं ध्यायेत्पाणिना वरदेन च || 130 ||
14.m: Resembling the bandhujīva flower, red, holding up the lotus and the discus, O twice-born, / he should meditate on him endowed with his own mudrā and with a hand granting boons; // 130

14.s:
kuṅkumena viliptāṅgaṃ raktabhāsaṃ manoharam |
raktābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ raktapuṣpavibhūṣitam || 131 ||
14.d:
कुङ्कुमेन विलिप्ताङ्गं रक्तभासं मनोहरम् |
रक्ताभरणसंयुक्तं रक्तपुष्पविभूषितम् || 131 ||
14.m: his limbs smeared with saffron, of red brilliance, charming, / adorned with red ornaments, decorated with red flowers, // 131

14.s: sammukhaṃ mantranāthasya śiromantraṃ ca saṃsmaret |
14.d: सम्मुखं मन्त्रनाथस्य शिरोमन्त्रं च संस्मरेत् |
14.m: facing the lord of mantras: he should remember the head-mantra.

14.s: [śikhāmantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [शिखामन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the śikhā-mantra]

14.s: calālipaṭalābhaṃ tu padmakaumodakīdharam || 132 ||
14.d: चलालिपटलाभं तु पद्मकौमोदकीधरम् || 132 ||
14.m: Resembling a swarm of moving bees, holding a lotus and Kaumodakī, // 132

14.s:
ātmīyamudrāṃ dharttāraṃ yuktaṃ cābhayapāṇinā |
yuktaṃ mṛgamadenaiva puṣpādyairasitaiśca tam || 133 ||
14.d:
आत्मीयमुद्रां धर्त्तारं युक्तं चाभयपाणिना |
युक्तं मृगमदेनैव पुष्पाद्यैरसितैश्च तम् || 133 ||
14.m: bearing his own mudrā, and endowed with a hand of fearlessness, / smeared with musk, and with black flowers and the like, // 133

14.s: īṣatsmitānanaṃ dhyāyecchikhāmantraṃ ca nārada |
14.d: ईषत्स्मिताननं ध्यायेच्छिखामन्त्रं च नारद |
14.m: with a gently smiling face: he should meditate on the śikhā-mantra, O Nārada.

14.s: [kavacamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [कवचमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the armour-mantra]

14.s: madhupiṅgalavarṇābhaṃ śaṅkhacakradharaṃ tathā || 134 ||
14.d: मधुपिङ्गलवर्णाभं शङ्खचक्रधरं तथा || 134 ||
14.m: Having the lustrous colour of tawny honey, likewise holding a conch and a discus, // 134

14.s:
svamudrāvyagritaṃ dhyāyetpāṇiyugmayuto(taṃ) param |
miśrairvilepanairliptaṃ miśraiḥ puṣpādibhistathā || 135 ||
14.d:
स्वमुद्राव्यग्रितं ध्यायेत्पाणियुग्मयुतो(तं) परम् |
मिश्रैर्विलेपनैर्लिप्तं मिश्रैः पुष्पादिभिस्तथा || 135 ||
14.m: he should meditate on him occupied with his own mudrā, endowed with a supreme pair of hands, / smeared with mixed unguents, and likewise with mixed flowers and the like, // 135

14.s: nirīkṣya(kṣa ?)māṇaṃ ca vibhoḥ kavacaṃ saṃsmareddvija |
14.d: निरीक्ष्य(क्ष ?)माणं च विभोः कवचं संस्मरेद्द्विज |
14.m: and gazing upon the Lord: he should remember the armour, O twice-born.

14.s: [netramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [नेत्रमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the eye-mantra]

14.s: raktapītaprabhaṃ caiva gadāpadmodyataṃ kramāt || 136 ||
14.d: रक्तपीतप्रभं चैव गदापद्मोद्यतं क्रमात् || 136 ||
14.m: Having the splendour of red and yellow, and raising the mace and lotus in order // 136

14.s:
dakṣiṇāparahastābhyāṃ yuktaṃ caiva svamudrayā |
sakāśmīreṇa liptāṅgaṃ candanena sitena ca || 137 ||
14.d:
दक्षिणापरहस्ताभ्यां युक्तं चैव स्वमुद्रया |
सकाश्मीरेण लिप्ताङ्गं चन्दनेन सितेन च || 137 ||
14.m: with the right and left hands, and endowed with his own mudrā, / his limbs smeared with saffron and white sandalwood, // 137

14.s:
puṣpābharaṇavāsobhiḥ pītairmaṇḍitavigraham |
saṃsmarennetramantraṃ tu sunetraṃ ca smitānanam || 138 ||
14.d:
पुष्पाभरणवासोभिः पीतैर्मण्डितविग्रहम् |
संस्मरेन्नेत्रमन्त्रं तु सुनेत्रं च स्मिताननम् || 138 ||
14.m: his body adorned with yellow flowers, ornaments, and garments; / he should remember the eye-mantra, beautiful-eyed and with a smiling face. // 138

14.s: [astramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [अस्त्रमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the weapon-mantra]

14.s:
rājopaladyutimuṣaṃ gadācakrodyataṃ mahat |
yuktaṃ caiva svamudrābhyāṃ suvarṇasadṛśaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 139 ||
14.d:
राजोपलद्युतिमुषं गदाचक्रोद्यतं महत् |
युक्तं चैव स्वमुद्राभ्यां सुवर्णसदृशैः शुभैः || 139 ||
14.m: Surpassing the brilliance of lapis lazuli, holding up the mace and discus, immense, / and endowed with his two mudrās, auspicious and resembling gold, // 139

14.s:
yuktamābharaṇādyaiśca pralayānalavikramam |
astramantraṃ vibhordhyāyetsammukhaṃ svāminaḥ sadā || 140 ||
14.d:
युक्तमाभरणाद्यैश्च प्रलयानलविक्रमम् |
अस्त्रमन्त्रं विभोर्ध्यायेत्सम्मुखं स्वामिनः सदा || 140 ||
14.m: adorned with ornaments and the like, possessing the valor of the dissolution fire; / he should meditate on the all-pervading Lord's weapon-mantra, always facing his Master. // 140

14.s:
ekavaktrāḥ smṛtāḥ sarve sarve ca garuḍāsanāḥ |
itīdamuktamaṅgānāṃ dhyānaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham || 141 ||
14.d:
एकवक्त्राः स्मृताः सर्वे सर्वे च गरुडासनाः |
इतीदमुक्तमङ्गानां ध्यानं पापहरं शुभम् || 141 ||
14.m: All are remembered as single-faced, and all seated upon Garuda. / Thus has been stated this meditation on the ancillary [mantras], which removes sin and is auspicious. // 141

14.s: p. 118) nṛsiṃhapūrvamantrāṇāṃ trayāṇāmavadhāraya |
14.d: प्. 118) नृसिंहपूर्वमन्त्राणां त्रयाणामवधारय |
14.m: Understand the three mantras beginning with Nṛsiṃha: // 142ab

14.s: [nṛsihmamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [नृसिह्ममन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the Nṛsiṃha-mantra]

14.s: pralayāmbudanirghoṣaṃ prodvamantaṃ ca pāvakam || 142 ||
14.d: प्रलयाम्बुदनिर्घोषं प्रोद्वमन्तं च पावकम् || 142 ||
14.m: having the roar of dissolution clouds, and vomiting forth fire, // 142cd

14.s:
padmaśaṅkhagadācakradharttāraṃ parameśvaram |
dravaccāmīkarābhāsaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitam || 143 ||
14.d:
पद्मशङ्खगदाचक्रधर्त्तारं परमेश्वरम् |
द्रवच्चामीकराभासं नानाभरणभूषितम् || 143 ||
14.m: bearing the lotus, conch, mace, and discus, the Supreme Lord, / having the appearance of molten gold, adorned with various ornaments, // 143

14.s:
nānāvilepanāṅgaṃ ca prabhūtasragdharaṃ dvija |
raktakauśeyavasanaṃ nṛsihmaṃ saṃsmaredvibhum || 144 ||
14.d:
नानाविलेपनाङ्गं च प्रभूतस्रग्धरं द्विज |
रक्तकौशेयवसनं नृसिह्मं संस्मरेद्विभुम् || 144 ||
14.m: his limbs anointed with various ointments, wearing abundant garlands, O twice-born, / clad in red silk garments: he should remember the all-pervading Nṛsiṃha. // 144

14.s: [kapilamantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [कपिलमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the Kapila-mantra]

14.s:
udayādityasaṅkāśaṃ piṅgalaśmaśrulocanam |
caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ padmādyairupaśobhitam || 145 ||
14.d:
उदयादित्यसङ्काशं पिङ्गलश्मश्रुलोचनम् |
चतुर्भुजमुदाराङ्गं पद्माद्यैरुपशोभितम् || 145 ||
14.m: Resembling the rising sun, with tawny beard and eyes, / four-armed, of noble frame, adorned with [weapons] beginning with the lotus, // 145

14.s:
sitavastrottarīyaṃ ca muktābharaṇabhūṣitam |
sitamālyadharaṃ dhyāyetkāpilaṃ mantranāyakam || 146 ||
14.d:
सितवस्त्रोत्तरीयं च मुक्ताभरणभूषितम् |
सितमाल्यधरं ध्यायेत्कापिलं मन्त्रनायकम् || 146 ||
14.m: having a white cloth and upper garment, adorned with pearl ornaments, / wearing a white garland: he should meditate on the leader of mantras pertaining to Kapila. // 146

14.s: [vārāhadhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [वाराहध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on Varāha]

14.s:
rājāśmarāśivarṇābhaṃ pītābharaṇabhūṣitam |
mahādyutidharaṃ dhyāyeccaturhastaṃ ca nārada || 147 ||
14.d:
राजाश्मराशिवर्णाभं पीताभरणभूषितम् |
महाद्युतिधरं ध्यायेच्चतुर्हस्तं च नारद || 147 ||
14.m: Resembling the colour of a heap of lapis lazuli, adorned with yellow ornaments, / possessing great brilliance: he should meditate on him as four-armed, O Nārada, // 147

14.s:
prāgvallāñchanasaṅghena kamalādyena maṇḍitam |
varāhamantranāthaṃ ca madhupiṅgalalocanam || 148 ||
14.d:
प्राग्वल्लाञ्छनसङ्घेन कमलाद्येन मण्डितम् |
वराहमन्त्रनाथं च मधुपिङ्गललोचनम् || 148 ||
14.m: adorned, as before, with a multitude of insignia beginning with the lotus, / the lord of the Varāha-mantra, having eyes tawny like honey, // 148

14.s:
caladvidyudbhruvaṃ raudraṃ jvālāśmasrusaṭaṃ smaret |
bālacandrāgratulyena yuktaṃ daṃṣṭrādvayena tu || 149 ||
14.d:
चलद्विद्युद्भ्रुवं रौद्रं ज्वालाश्मस्रुसटं स्मरेत् |
बालचन्द्राग्रतुल्येन युक्तं दंष्ट्राद्वयेन तु || 149 ||
14.m: with eyebrows like flashing lightning, terrible, with a mane like flaming stones, / endowed with a pair of tusks resembling the tip of the crescent moon. // 149

14.s:
padmāsanopaviṣṭāśca cintayantaḥ svakāraṇam |
sammukhāḥ karṇikādhaḥsthāḥ smartavyāḥ sarvadā mune || 150 ||
14.d:
पद्मासनोपविष्टाश्च चिन्तयन्तः स्वकारणम् |
सम्मुखाः कर्णिकाधःस्थाः स्मर्तव्याः सर्वदा मुने || 150 ||
14.m: Seated in the lotus posture, contemplating their own cause, / facing forward, situated beneath the pericarp: they are always to be remembered, O sage. // 150

14.s: [kaustubhādidhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [कौस्तुभादिध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on Kaustubha and the rest]

14.s:
kaustubhaṃ dvibhujaṃ dhyāyetsahasrārkasamaprabham |
nānāvarṇadharāṃ devīṃ vanamālāṃ tathaiva ca || 151 ||
14.d:
कौस्तुभं द्विभुजं ध्यायेत्सहस्रार्कसमप्रभम् |
नानावर्णधरां देवीं वनमालां तथैव च || 151 ||
14.m: He should meditate on the Kaustubha as two-armed, with splendour equal to a thousand suns; / and likewise the goddess, the forest-garland, possessing various colours, // 151

14.s:
kāntāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ prauḍhastrīsadṛśīṃ dvija |
puṇḍarīkaprabhaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkhaṃ kundendusannibham || 152 ||
14.d:
कान्तां कमलपत्राक्षीं प्रौढस्त्रीसदृशीं द्विज |
पुण्डरीकप्रभं पद्मं शङ्खं कुन्देन्दुसन्निभम् || 152 ||
14.m: charming, with eyes like lotus petals, resembling a mature woman, O twice-born; / the lotus, having the splendour of a white lotus; the conch, resembling the jasmine and moon; // 152

14.s:
rājopalaprabhaṃ cakraṃ hemābhāṃ saṃsmaredgadām |
dviraṣṭavarṣavatkāntāṃ kumārīṃ navayuvanām || 153 ||
14.d:
राजोपलप्रभं चक्रं हेमाभां संस्मरेद्गदाम् |
द्विरष्टवर्षवत्कान्तां कुमारीं नवयुवनाम् || 153 ||
14.m: the discus, having the splendour of lapis lazuli; he should remember the mace as possessing the appearance of gold, / charming like a maiden of sixteen years, a youthful maiden. // 153

14.s: [garuḍadhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [गरुडध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on Garuda]

14.s:
raktatuṇḍaṃ mahāprāṇaṃ bhīmabhukuṭilocanam |
p. 119) dravaccāmīkarākāraṃ pakṣamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam || 154 ||
14.d:
रक्ततुण्डं महाप्राणं भीमभुकुटिलोचनम् |
प्. 119) द्रवच्चामीकराकारं पक्षमण्डलमण्डितम् || 154 ||
14.m: With a red beak, of great vitality, with terrible knitting of the brow and eyes, / having the form of molten gold, adorned with a circle of wings, // 154

14.s: saṃsmaredgaruḍaṃ vipra gṛdhravaktraṃ pṛthūdaram |
14.d: संस्मरेद्गरुडं विप्र गृध्रवक्त्रं पृथूदरम् |
14.m: he should remember Garuda, O vipra, vulture-faced and large-bellied. // 155ab

14.s: [pāśāṅkuśayordhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [पाशाङ्कुशयोर्ध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the noose and goad]

14.s: navadūrvāṅkuraśyāmaṃ pāśeśaṃ pannagānanam || 155 ||
14.d: नवदूर्वाङ्कुरश्यामं पाशेशं पन्नगाननम् || 155 ||
14.m: Dark as a fresh blade of dūrvā grass, the lord of the noose, serpent-faced; // 155cd

14.s:
saṃsmaredaṅkuśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dīrghanāsaṃ bhayānakam |
svamudrālaṅkṛtāḥ sarve dvibhujāścārukuṇḍalāḥ || 156 ||
14.d:
संस्मरेदङ्कुशं कृष्णं दीर्घनासं भयानकम् |
स्वमुद्रालङ्कृताः सर्वे द्विभुजाश्चारुकुण्डलाः || 156 ||
14.m: he should remember the goad as black, long-nosed, terrifying. / All are adorned with their own mudrās, two-armed, with beautiful earrings, // 156

14.s:
dhyātavyāḥ puruṣākārāḥ svaprabhābhirvirājitāḥ |
etallāñchanamantrāṇāṃ dhyānamuktaṃ mayā mune || 157 ||
14.d:
ध्यातव्याः पुरुषाकाराः स्वप्रभाभिर्विराजिताः |
एतल्लाञ्छनमन्त्राणां ध्यानमुक्तं मया मुने || 157 ||
14.m: to be meditated upon in human form, shining with their own splendours. / This meditation on the mantras of the insignia has been spoken by me, O sage. // 157

14.s: [satyādipañcakadhyānaprakārāḥ]
14.d: [सत्यादिपञ्चकध्यानप्रकाराः]
14.m: [The procedures of meditation on the group of five beginning with Satya]

14.s:
satyādīnāmatha dhyānaṃ samāsādavadhāraya |
dvibhujaṃ saṃsmaretsatyaṃ sitaminduśatākṛtim || 158 ||
14.d:
सत्यादीनामथ ध्यानं समासादवधारय |
द्विभुजं संस्मरेत्सत्यं सितमिन्दुशताकृतिम् || 158 ||
14.m: Now understand briefly the meditation on Satya and the others: / he should remember Satya as two-armed, white, having the appearance of a hundred moons, // 158

14.s:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca dhyānonmīlitalocanam |
sitakauśeyavasanaṃ muktādāmādyalataṅkṛm || 159 ||
14.d:
वरदाभयहस्तं च ध्यानोन्मीलितलोचनम् |
सितकौशेयवसनं मुक्तादामाद्यलतङ्कृम् || 159 ||
14.m: with hands bestowing boons and freedom from fear, eyes opened in meditation, / wearing white silk garments, adorned with pearl necklaces and the like, // 159

14.s:
sitacandanaliptāṅgaṃ sitapuṣpavibhūṣitam |
ūrdhvasthaṃ mantranāthasya brahmapu(pa ?)trasthitaṃ smaret || 160 ||
14.d:
सितचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गं सितपुष्पविभूषितम् |
ऊर्ध्वस्थं मन्त्रनाथस्य ब्रह्मपु(प ?)त्रस्थितं स्मरेत् || 160 ||
14.m: his limbs smeared with white sandalwood, decorated with white flowers; / situated above the lord of mantras, he should remember him standing on a lotus petal, // 160

14.s:
padmāsanenopaviṣṭaṃ prasannavadanaṃ dvija |
evaṃ vidhaṃ tato dhyāyedvāsudevaṃ caturbhujam || 161 ||
14.d:
पद्मासनेनोपविष्टं प्रसन्नवदनं द्विज |
एवं विधं ततो ध्यायेद्वासुदेवं चतुर्भुजम् || 161 ||
14.m: seated in the lotus posture, with a serene countenance, O twice-born. / In such a manner he should then meditate on Vāsudeva as four-armed, // 161

14.s:
śaṅkhapadmadharaṃ caiva varadābhayadaṃ vibhum |
praśāntahutabhugrūpaṃ na sitaṃ nāticāruṇam || 162 ||
14.d:
शङ्खपद्मधरं चैव वरदाभयदं विभुम् |
प्रशान्तहुतभुग्रूपं न सितं नातिचारुणम् || 162 ||
14.m: holding the conch and lotus, and bestowing boons and freedom from fear, all-pervading, / of the form of a tranquil fire, neither white nor excessively red. // 162

14.s:
dhyāyetsaṅkarṣaṇaṃ devaṃ pradyumnaṃ saṃsmarettataḥ |
pītacampakavarṇābhaṃ kamalāyatalocanam || 163 ||
14.d:
ध्यायेत्सङ्कर्षणं देवं प्रद्युम्नं संस्मरेत्ततः |
पीतचम्पकवर्णाभं कमलायतलोचनम् || 163 ||
14.m: He should meditate on the god Saṅkarṣaṇa; then he should remember Pradyumna, / having the colour and splendour of a yellow campaka, with wide eyes like lotus flowers. // 163

14.s:
śaradgaganasaṅkāśamaniruddhaṃ smarettataḥ |
vāsudevasamāḥ sarve bhujābharaṇalāñchanaiḥ || 164 ||
14.d:
शरद्गगनसङ्काशमनिरुद्धं स्मरेत्ततः |
वासुदेवसमाः सर्वे भुजाभरणलाञ्छनैः || 164 ||
14.m: Then he should remember Aniruddha, resembling the autumn sky. / All are equal to Vāsudeva in arms, ornaments, and insignia; // 164

14.s: upaviṣṭāstathaivete brahmarandhrāmbujeṣu ca |
14.d: उपविष्टास्तथैवेते ब्रह्मरन्ध्राम्बुजेषु च |
14.m: and they are likewise seated in the lotuses of the aperture of Brahman. // 165ab

14.s: [saptākṣaramantradhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [सप्ताक्षरमन्त्रध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of meditation on the seven-syllable mantra]

14.s: suśuddhasphaṭikaprakhyaṃ nīrūpamiva (mapi ?)rūpiṇam || 165 ||
14.d: सुशुद्धस्फटिकप्रख्यं नीरूपमिव (मपि ?)रूपिणम् || 165 ||
14.m: Resembling pure crystal, possessed of form as if formless, // 165cd

14.s:
sarvākāradharaṃ caiva sarvākāravivarjitam |
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ ca sarvato'kṣiśiromukham || 166 ||
14.d:
सर्वाकारधरं चैव सर्वाकारविवर्जितम् |
सर्वतः पाणिपादं च सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् || 166 ||
14.m: assuming all forms and devoid of all form, / having hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads, and faces everywhere; // 166

14.s:
prasannaraśmijālena sphaṭikāmalarūpiṇā |
p. 120) svadehanissṛtenaiva bhāsitaṃ paritaḥ prabhum || 167 ||
14.d:
प्रसन्नरश्मिजालेन स्फटिकामलरूपिणा |
प्. 120) स्वदेहनिस्सृतेनैव भासितं परितः प्रभुम् || 167 ||
14.m: the Lord illumined all around by a web of serene rays / issuing from his own body, having the spotless form of crystal, // 167

14.s:
pratibimbati vai yasminmantracakraṃ yathāsthitam |
dhyāyetsaptākṣaraṃ mantraṃ bhogasthānagataṃ mune || 168 ||
14.d:
प्रतिबिम्बति वै यस्मिन्मन्त्रचक्रं यथास्थितम् |
ध्यायेत्सप्ताक्षरं मन्त्रं भोगस्थानगतं मुने || 168 ||
14.m: in whom the circle of mantras is truly reflected as it exists: / he should meditate on the seven-syllable mantra situated in the place of enjoyment, O sage. // 168

14.s: evaṃ dhyātvā samabhyarcya yathānyāsakrameṇa ca |
14.d: एवं ध्यात्वा समभ्यर्च्य यथान्यासक्रमेण च |
14.m: Having thus meditated and thoroughly worshipped according to the sequence of installation, // 169ab

14.s: [dhyānānānantaraṃ nyāsakrameṇa mantragaṇasya bāhyayāgaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [ध्यानानानन्तरं न्यासक्रमेण मन्त्रगणस्य बाह्ययागप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure of external sacrifice of the host of mantras according to the sequence of installation following meditation]

14.s: arghaiḥ pādyaistathā puṣpaiḥ sugandhairanulepanaiḥ || 169 ||
14.d: अर्घैः पाद्यैस्तथा पुष्पैः सुगन्धैरनुलेपनैः || 169 ||
14.m: with arghya-offerings, pādya-water, flowers, fragrant ointments, // 169cd

14.s:
śālipūrṇotthitāghārapṛṣṭhasaṃsthairanekaśaḥ |
sugandhaghṛtadīpaiśca puṣpālambanacarcitaiḥ || 170 ||
14.d:
शालिपूर्णोत्थिताघारपृष्ठसंस्थैरनेकशः |
सुगन्धघृतदीपैश्च पुष्पालम्बनचर्चितैः || 170 ||
14.m: placed repeatedly upon broad dishes filled with rice, / and with fragrant ghee lamps strewn with garlands of flowers, // 170

14.s:
mahāmodaiśśubhoddipairacchinnairguggulānvitaiḥ |
bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā lehyaiḥ peyairanyairanekadhā || 171 ||
14.d:
महामोदैश्शुभोद्दिपैरच्छिन्नैर्गुग्गुलान्वितैः |
भक्ष्यैर्भोज्यैस्तथा लेह्यैः पेयैरन्यैरनेकधा || 171 ||
14.m: with greatly fragrant, auspicious, blazing, unbroken [incense] mixed with guggulu; / with foods that are chewed, eaten, licked, and various kinds to be drunk; // 171

14.s:
madhuparkaiśca mātrābhiḥ phalamūlairanekaśaḥ |
pāyasairvividhairdivyaiḥ modakaiḥ kṛsarādibhiḥ || 172 ||
14.d:
मधुपर्कैश्च मात्राभिः फलमूलैरनेकशः |
पायसैर्विविधैर्दिव्यैः मोदकैः कृसरादिभिः || 172 ||
14.m: and with honey-mixtures in proper measures, with fruits and roots in abundance, / with various divine milk-rice dishes, sweetmeats, kṛsara, and the like, // 172

14.s:
susaṃskṛtaiśca bahubhirmadhvājyādipariplutaiḥ |
ekaikasmiṃstu vai bhoge mudrāṃ kāmadughāṃ purā || 173 ||
14.d:
सुसंस्कृतैश्च बहुभिर्मध्वाज्यादिपरिप्लुतैः |
एकैकस्मिंस्तु वै भोगे मुद्रां कामदुघां पुरा || 173 ||
14.m: well-prepared and abundant, overflowing with honey, ghee, and the like: / for each separate enjoyment, he should first meditate as before // 173

14.s:
samantrāṃ pūrvavaddhyāyetprokṣayerdarghyavāriṇā |
datvā puṣpārghyamupari saṃspṛśedviṣṇupāṇinā || 174 ||
14.d:
समन्त्रां पूर्ववद्ध्यायेत्प्रोक्षयेर्दर्घ्यवारिणा |
दत्वा पुष्पार्घ्यमुपरि संस्पृशेद्विष्णुपाणिना || 174 ||
14.m: on the Kāmadhenu mudrā with its mantra, and sprinkle with arghya-water. / Having offered an arghya of flowers upon it, he should touch it with the hand of Viṣṇu. // 174

14.s:
nivedayettato vipra śirasā'vanatena ca |
yatkiñcanmānase yāge purā proktaṃ mayā ca te || 175 ||
14.d:
निवेदयेत्ततो विप्र शिरसाऽवनतेन च |
यत्किञ्चन्मानसे यागे पुरा प्रोक्तं मया च ते || 175 ||
14.m: Then, O vipra, with head bowed low, he should present it. / Whatever was previously stated by me to you in the mental sacrifice, // 175

14.s:
tatsarvaṃ devadevasya bahumūrtaṃ nivedayet |
asannidhiśca yo bhogo hyaṅgabhāvamanuvrajet || 176 ||
14.d:
तत्सर्वं देवदेवस्य बहुमूर्तं निवेदयेत् |
असन्निधिश्च यो भोगो ह्यङ्गभावमनुव्रजेत् || 176 ||
14.m: all that he should present in manifold forms to the God of gods. / And whatever enjoyment is not directly present, entering into an ancillary state, // 176

14.s:
tattaddhyātvā tu manasā bhaktyā viṣṇornivedayet |
yathānukramato hyevaṃ sarvamantragaṇaṃ mune || 177 ||
14.d:
तत्तद्ध्यात्वा तु मनसा भक्त्या विष्णोर्निवेदयेत् |
यथानुक्रमतो ह्येवं सर्वमन्त्रगणं मुने || 177 ||
14.m: having meditated on each one in the mind, he should present it with devotion to Viṣṇu. / Having thus worshipped the entire host of mantras in sequence, O sage, // 177

14.s: iṣṭvā pūrvaṃ vidhānena bhūyaḥ saṃpūjya keśavam |
14.d: इष्ट्वा पूर्वं विधानेन भूयः संपूज्य केशवम् |
14.m: first according to rule, and having worshipped Keśava once more: // 178ab

14.s: [puṣpāñjaliprakāraḥ]
14.d: [पुष्पाञ्जलिप्रकारः]

14.s: mūlamantraṃ samuccārya puṣpairāpūrya cāñjalim || 178 ||
14.d: मूलमन्त्रं समुच्चार्य पुष्पैरापूर्य चाञ्जलिम् || 178 ||
14.m: having recited the root-mantra and filled his folded hands with flowers, // 178cd

14.s:
tanmadhye paramātmānaṃ mantraṃ māṇikyadīdhitim |
samastamantrasaṃlīnaṃ dhyāyeduddhārayogataḥ || 179 ||
14.d:
तन्मध्ये परमात्मानं मन्त्रं माणिक्यदीधितिम् |
समस्तमन्त्रसंलीनं ध्यायेदुद्धारयोगतः || 179 ||
14.m: he should meditate through the practice of extraction on the Supreme Self, the mantra radiant as a ruby, / dissolved within all mantras, in their midst, // 179

14.s:
pūrakādivibhāgena śabdenātiplutātmanā |
yāvacchabdāvasānastho vyajyate'sāvanekadhā || 180 ||
14.d:
पूरकादिविभागेन शब्देनातिप्लुतात्मना |
यावच्छब्दावसानस्थो व्यज्यतेऽसावनेकधा || 180 ||
14.m: by means of the division of inhalation and the rest, with sound of a highly protracted nature, / until, residing at the end of the sound, it is manifested in various ways. // 180

14.s:
p. 121) tantrīśabdātmanā vipra tato bhāsātmanā tu vai |
hlādātmanā ca tadanu ānandavibhavātmanā || 181 ||
14.d:
प्. 121) तन्त्रीशब्दात्मना विप्र ततो भासात्मना तु वै |
ह्लादात्मना च तदनु आनन्दविभवात्मना || 181 ||
14.m: as having the nature of lute-sound, O Brahmin, and then indeed as having the nature of radiance, / and thereafter as having the nature of delight, and as having the nature of the power of bliss; // 181

14.s:
tasmātsarvapadātītaḥ sarvatra vibhavātmanā |
saccidghanorminirmuktaśāntabodhāntarātmanā || 182 ||
14.d:
तस्मात्सर्वपदातीतः सर्वत्र विभवात्मना |
सच्चिद्घनोर्मिनिर्मुक्तशान्तबोधान्तरात्मना || 182 ||
14.m: beyond all words, everywhere by virtue of his omnipresence, / as the inner Self of tranquil consciousness freed from the waves of being and consciousness; // 182

14.s:
evaṃ ṣaḍūrminirmuktaṃ vikalpātītagocaram |
avagāhya krameṇātha punaretya padātpadam || 183 ||
14.d:
एवं षडूर्मिनिर्मुक्तं विकल्पातीतगोचरम् |
अवगाह्य क्रमेणाथ पुनरेत्य पदात्पदम् || 183 ||
14.m: having thus entered [that which is] free from the six waves, whose sphere is beyond conceptual thought, / and then coming down again step by step, // 183

14.s:
dhyātvā mantraṃ sahastrāṃśuṃ sahasrakarajāmṛtam |
recakena vinikṣipya devadevasya mūrdhani || 184 ||
14.d:
ध्यात्वा मन्त्रं सहस्त्रांशुं सहस्रकरजामृतम् |
रेचकेन विनिक्षिप्य देवदेवस्य मूर्धनि || 184 ||
14.m: having meditated on the thousand-rayed mantra, the nectar born of a thousand rays, / he deposits it with an exhalation upon the head of the God of gods. // 184

14.s: tato'chinnaṃ kare kṛtvā dhūpapātraṃ tu dakṣiṇe |
14.d: ततोऽछिन्नं करे कृत्वा धूपपात्रं तु दक्षिणे |
14.m: Then, taking the unbroken incense-burner in his right hand— // 185ab

14.s: [dhūpapātravidhiḥ]
14.d: [धूपपात्रविधिः]

14.s: padmacakrāṅkitaṃ divyamādhāraṃ kañjarūpiṇam || 185 ||
14.d: पद्मचक्राङ्कितं दिव्यमाधारं कञ्जरूपिणम् || 185 ||
14.m: a divine receptacle marked with lotus and discus, having the form of a lotus, // 185cd

14.s:
ekanālaṃ ca kartavyaṃ (kurvīta ?) śeṣaṃ saptaphaṇaṃ vibhum |
baddhāñjalipuṭaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyantaṃ kāraṇaṃ param || 186 ||
14.d:
एकनालं च कर्तव्यं (कुर्वीत ?) शेषं सप्तफणं विभुम् |
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटं नित्यं ध्यायन्तं कारणं परम् || 186 ||
14.m: one should make it with a single stalk, and the all-pervading Śeṣa with seven hoods, / having his palms joined, always meditating on the supreme cause; // 186

14.s:
cakralāṅgalahastaṃ ca padmāsanagataṃ vibhum |
kartavyaṃ (kurvīta ?) dhūpagharttāraṃ kiṅkiṇījālaśobhitam || 187 ||
14.d:
चक्रलाङ्गलहस्तं च पद्मासनगतं विभुम् |
कर्तव्यं (कुर्वीत ?) धूपघर्त्तारं किङ्किणीजालशोभितम् || 187 ||
14.m: and the all-pervading lord with discus and plough in hand, seated on a lotus, / one should make as the bearer of the incense, adorned with a network of tiny bells. // 187

14.s:
cakraṃ taccakrahṛdayaṃ padmaṃ hṛtkoṭaraṃ viduḥ |
cakre yā yā (ye ye ?) arākhyā (ssyu ?)stā nāḍyo vai dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ||
188 ||
14.d:
चक्रं तच्चक्रहृदयं पद्मं हृत्कोटरं विदुः |
चक्रे या या (ये ये ?) अराख्या (स्स्यु ?)स्ता नाड्यो वै द्वादश स्मृताः ||
188 ||
14.m: They know that discus to be the heart of the discus, and the lotus to be the hollow of the heart; / whatever are called spokes in the discus are known as the twelve nāḍīs. // 188

14.s:
kiṅkiṇyo yāḥ smṛtā vipra jñeyāstāḥ sūkṣmanāḍayaḥ |
yāsāṃ vai madhyamā śaktirbhujaṅgakuṭilopamā || 189 ||
14.d:
किङ्किण्यो याः स्मृता विप्र ज्ञेयास्ताः सूक्ष्मनाडयः |
यासां वै मध्यमा शक्तिर्भुजङ्गकुटिलोपमा || 189 ||
14.m: The tiny bells that are mentioned, O Brahmin, are to be understood as the subtle channels, / among which the central power is like a coiled serpent, // 189

14.s:
dhūmadhūsaravarṇābhā aṇḍaṃ bhitvā vinirgatā |
kālāgnihṛdayotthā sā satyānte tu layaṃ gatā || 190 ||
14.d:
धूमधूसरवर्णाभा अण्डं भित्वा विनिर्गता |
कालाग्निहृदयोत्था सा सत्यान्ते तु लयं गता || 190 ||
14.m: having the smoky grey hue, having split the egg and gone forth, / rising from the heart of the fire of time, and dissolved at the end of the Satya [world]. // 190

14.s:
tayā saṃbodhito hyātmā mantramūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ |
sannidhau bhavati, kṣipramavyucchinnaṃ dahettathā || 191 ||
14.d:
तया संबोधितो ह्यात्मा मन्त्रमूर्तिधरः प्रभुः |
सन्निधौ भवति, क्षिप्रमव्युच्छिन्नं दहेत्तथा || 191 ||
14.m: Awakened by her, the Self, the Lord bearing the mantra-form, / comes into presence; likewise, it should burn without interruption. // 191

14.s: [dhūpapātramantravidhānam]
14.d: [धूपपात्रमन्त्रविधानम्]
14.m: [Rule for the mantra of the incense-burner]

14.s:
mantreṇānena viprarṣe tanmantramavadhāraya |
oṅkāraṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya paramātmā tataḥ punaḥ || 192 ||
14.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्रर्षे तन्मन्त्रमवधारय |
ओङ्कारं पूर्वमुद्धृत्य परमात्मा ततः पुनः || 192 ||
14.m: Understand that mantra, O Brahmin-seer, by this mantra: / first extracting the syllable OṂ, then next the word "paramātmā" // 192

14.s:
vyomānandena saṃyuktamanantāya padaṃ tataḥ |
kālāgnirūpāya padaṃ jagaddhūmapadaṃ tathā || 193 ||
14.d:
व्योमानन्देन संयुक्तमनन्ताय पदं ततः |
कालाग्निरूपाय पदं जगद्धूमपदं तथा || 193 ||
14.m: joined with "vyomānandena", then the word "anantāya", / the word "kālāgnirūpāya", and the word "jagaddhūma", // 193

14.s:
sugandhine padaṃ kuryātsarvagandhavahāya ca |
p. 122) namaḥ svāhāsamāyuktamekatriṃśākṣaraṃ param || 194 ||
14.d:
सुगन्धिने पदं कुर्यात्सर्वगन्धवहाय च |
प्. 122) नमः स्वाहासमायुक्तमेकत्रिंशाक्षरं परम् || 194 ||
14.m: one should utter the word "sugandhine", and "sarvagandhavahāya", / accompanied by "namaḥ" and "svāhā", the supreme thirty-one-syllable [mantra]. // 194

14.s:
mantraṃ dvija samākhyātaṃ dhūpapātrasya nārada |
mudrādhyānasamāyuktaṃ (ktāṃ ?) sarvasiddhikaraṃ (rīṃ ?) param (rām
?) || 195 ||
14.d:
मन्त्रं द्विज समाख्यातं धूपपात्रस्य नारद |
मुद्राध्यानसमायुक्तं (क्तां ?) सर्वसिद्धिकरं (रीं ?) परम् (राम्
?) || 195 ||
14.m: This mantra of the incense-burner has been proclaimed to you, O Brahmin Nārada, / accompanied by mudrā and meditation, granting all perfections, supreme. // 195

14.s:
pūjitāṃ dhūpitāṃ liptāṃ mantravinyastavigrahām |
ekīkṛtya svaśabdena hṛdgatenāntarātmanā || 196 ||
14.d:
पूजितां धूपितां लिप्तां मन्त्रविन्यस्तविग्रहाम् |
एकीकृत्य स्वशब्देन हृद्गतेनान्तरात्मना || 196 ||
14.m: Having united [the burner], worshipped, censed, smeared, its form installed with mantra, / with his own inner Self, situated in the heart, through his own sound, // 196

14.s: [ghaṇṭācālanavidhānam]
14.d: [घण्टाचालनविधानम्]
14.m: [Rule for ringing the bell]

14.s:
sañcālayettatassamyaksaśabdāṃ cakracinhitām |
trailokyadrāviṇīṃ ghaṇṭāṃ sarvaduṣṭanibarhiṇīm || 197 ||
14.d:
सञ्चालयेत्ततस्सम्यक्सशब्दां चक्रचिन्हिताम् |
त्रैलोक्यद्राविणीं घण्टां सर्वदुष्टनिबर्हिणीम् || 197 ||
14.m: he should then sound properly the resonant bell marked with a discus, / which puts to flight the three worlds and destroys all wicked beings. // 197

14.s:
eṣā dūtī hi mantrāṇāṃ suptānāṃ ca prabodhinī |
vāraṇī sarvavighnānāṃ sarvamantraprasādinī || 198 ||
14.d:
एषा दूती हि मन्त्राणां सुप्तानां च प्रबोधिनी |
वारणी सर्वविघ्नानां सर्वमन्त्रप्रसादिनी || 198 ||
14.m: For she is the messenger of the mantras and the awakener of the sleeping, / the averter of all obstacles, the gracious pacifier of all mantras. // 198

14.s:
praṇavānte dhvanirhyeṣa śabdaśaktau layaṃ gataḥ |
varṇadehāḥ smṛtā mantrā mantradehāśca devatāḥ || 199 ||
14.d:
प्रणवान्ते ध्वनिर्ह्येष शब्दशक्तौ लयं गतः |
वर्णदेहाः स्मृता मन्त्रा मन्त्रदेहाश्च देवताः || 199 ||
14.m: For at the end of the praṇava, this sound dissolves into the power of sound; / mantras are taught as having phonemes for bodies, and deities have mantras for bodies. // 199

14.s:
ghaṇṭāstanitamūlāste prabuddhāḥ karmasiddhidāḥ |
paraśabdotthitā śaktirghaṇṭāstanitarūpiṇī || 200 ||
14.d:
घण्टास्तनितमूलास्ते प्रबुद्धाः कर्मसिद्धिदाः |
परशब्दोत्थिता शक्तिर्घण्टास्तनितरूपिणी || 200 ||
14.m: Having the chime of the bell as their source, awakened, they grant success in rituals; / the power arising from the supreme sound has the form of the bell's ringing; // 200

14.s:
varṇatvaṃ samanuprāptā tairvarṇairmunisattama |
mantrāṇāṃ kalpanādehā nānākārāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 201 ||
14.d:
वर्णत्वं समनुप्राप्ता तैर्वर्णैर्मुनिसत्तम |
मन्त्राणां कल्पनादेहा नानाकाराः सहस्रशः || 201 ||
14.m: having attained the nature of phonemes—through those phonemes, O best of sages, / are the conceptual bodies of mantras formed in thousands of diverse aspects, // 201

14.s:
svecchayā tvanayā śaktyā sāmarthyātsvātmanassvayam |
anugrahārthamiha hi bhaktānāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 202 ||
14.d:
स्वेच्छया त्वनया शक्त्या सामर्थ्यात्स्वात्मनस्स्वयम् |
अनुग्रहार्थमिह हि भक्तानां भावितात्मनाम् || 202 ||
14.m: spontaneously by this power, through its own capacity, / for the grace of devotees with cultivated minds in this world. // 202

14.s:
mananānmuniśārdūla trāṇaṃ kurvanti vai tataḥ |
dadate padamātmīyaṃ tasmānmantrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 203 ||
14.d:
मननान्मुनिशार्दूल त्राणं कुर्वन्ति वै ततः |
ददते पदमात्मीयं तस्मान्मन्त्राः प्रकीर्तिताः || 203 ||
14.m: Because they protect through being contemplated, O tiger among sages, / and grant their own state, they are called mantras. // 203

14.s:
anabhivyaktaśabdāste nirākārāstathaiva ca |
ghaṇṭāyāṃ cālyamānāyāṃ niryānti ca sahasraśaḥ || 204 ||
14.d:
अनभिव्यक्तशब्दास्ते निराकारास्तथैव च |
घण्टायां चाल्यमानायां निर्यान्ति च सहस्रशः || 204 ||
14.m: Being unmanifest sounds and formless, / when the bell is rung, they issue forth by thousands. // 204

14.s:
ata eva muniśreṣṭha mantramātā prakīrtitā |
eṣā ghaṇṭābhidhā śaktirvāgīśī ca sarasvatī || 205 ||
14.d:
अत एव मुनिश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रमाता प्रकीर्तिता |
एषा घण्टाभिधा शक्तिर्वागीशी च सरस्वती || 205 ||
14.m: Therefore, O best of sages, she is proclaimed as the Mother of Mantras, / this power called the Bell, the ruler of speech and Sarasvatī. // 205

14.s:
vāci mantrāḥ sthitāssarve vācyā mantre pratiṣṭhitāḥ |
mantrarūpātmakaṃ viśvaṃ sa bāhyābhyantaraṃ tataḥ || 206 ||
14.d:
वाचि मन्त्राः स्थितास्सर्वे वाच्या मन्त्रे प्रतिष्ठिताः |
मन्त्ररूपात्मकं विश्वं स बाह्याभ्यन्तरं ततः || 206 ||
14.m: All mantras reside in speech, and the signified reside in the mantra; / the universe, both external and internal, consists of the form of mantra. // 206

14.s:
ghaṇṭāśabdagataṃ sarvaṃ tasmāttāṃ cālayetpurā |
āvāhane'rghye dhūpe ca dīpe naivedyajoṣaṇe || 207 ||
14.d:
घण्टाशब्दगतं सर्वं तस्मात्तां चालयेत्पुरा |
आवाहनेऽर्घ्ये धूपे च दीपे नैवेद्यजोषणे || 207 ||
14.m: Everything resides in the sound of the bell; therefore, one should ring it first / in invocation, in [offering] the arghya, in incense, in light, and in presenting the food-offering. // 207

14.s:
nityameva prayuñjīta samyaṅmantrārthasiddhaye |
p. 123) pūjākālaṃ vinā'nyatra hitaṃ nāsyāḥ pracālanam || 208 ||
14.d:
नित्यमेव प्रयुञ्जीत सम्यङ्मन्त्रार्थसिद्धये |
प्. 123) पूजाकालं विनाऽन्यत्र हितं नास्याः प्रचालनम् || 208 ||
14.m: One should always employ it properly for the accomplishment of the mantras' purpose; / its sounding is not beneficial anywhere except at the time of worship. // 208

14.s:
nānayā tu vinā kāryaṃ pūjanaṃ siddhimicchatā |
yasmāttasmātparaṃ mantrametadīyamidaṃ śṛṇu || 209 ||
14.d:
नानया तु विना कार्यं पूजनं सिद्धिमिच्छता |
यस्मात्तस्मात्परं मन्त्रमेतदीयमिदं शृणु || 209 ||
14.m: Worship should never be performed without it by one who desires perfection; / therefore, listen to this supreme mantra belonging to it. // 209

14.s: [ghaṇṭāmantranirūpaṇam]
14.d: [घण्टामन्त्रनिरूपणम्]
14.m: [Explanation of the bell-mantra]

14.s:
ādāya praṇavaṃ pūrvamananteśaṃ tataḥ param |
taccānalena saṃbhinnamūrdhvādho munisattama || 210 ||
14.d:
आदाय प्रणवं पूर्वमनन्तेशं ततः परम् |
तच्चानलेन संभिन्नमूर्ध्वाधो मुनिसत्तम || 210 ||
14.m: Taking the praṇava first, and after that Ananteśa, / and that combined above and below with the fire, O best of sages, // 210

14.s:
trailokyaiśvaryadenātha lāñchayetpañcabindunā |
dadyādasyāvasāne tu jagaddhvanipadaṃ tataḥ || 211 ||
14.d:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदेनाथ लाञ्छयेत्पञ्चबिन्दुना |
दद्यादस्यावसाने तु जगद्ध्वनिपदं ततः || 211 ||
14.m: one should then mark it with the five bindus granting lordship over the three worlds; / at its end one should place the word "jagaddhvani", // 211

14.s:
mantramātre padaṃ cānyatsvāhākṣarasamanvitam |
tadante paramātmānaṃ prajñādhāropari sthitam || 212 ||
14.d:
मन्त्रमात्रे पदं चान्यत्स्वाहाक्षरसमन्वितम् |
तदन्ते परमात्मानं प्रज्ञाधारोपरि स्थितम् || 212 ||
14.m: and the other word "mantramātre", accompanied by the syllable "svāhā"; / at the end of that, the supreme Self situated upon the support of wisdom, // 212

14.s:
bhūdhareṇa yutaṃ mūrdhnā bhūdharopari vinyaset |
viśvāpyāyakarāntasthaṃ trailokyaiśvaryadaṃ mune || 213 ||
14.d:
भूधरेण युतं मूर्ध्ना भूधरोपरि विन्यसेत् |
विश्वाप्यायकरान्तस्थं त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदं मुने || 213 ||
14.m: endowed with the mountain-bearer on his head, one should install upon the mountain-bearer, / residing within that which nourishes the universe, granting sovereignty over the three worlds, O sage. // 213

14.s:
trayodaśākṣaro mantro ghaṇṭākhyassarvasiddhikṛt |
vinyāsakāle yasyā vai plutamuccārayettataḥ || 214 ||
14.d:
त्रयोदशाक्षरो मन्त्रो घण्टाख्यस्सर्वसिद्धिकृत् |
विन्यासकाले यस्या वै प्लुतमुच्चारयेत्ततः || 214 ||
14.m: The thirteen-syllable mantra named the Bell achieves all perfections; / at the time of its installation, one should recite it protractedly. // 214

14.s: [ghaṇṭādhyānaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [घण्टाध्यानप्रकारः]
14.m: [Manner of meditating on the bell]

14.s:
dhyānayuktaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha taddhyānamavadhāraya |
adhomukhaṃ tu brahmāṇḍaṃ dhyāyejjanaravākulam || 215 ||
14.d:
ध्यानयुक्तं द्विजश्रेष्ठ तद्ध्यानमवधारय |
अधोमुखं तु ब्रह्माण्डं ध्यायेज्जनरवाकुलम् || 215 ||
14.m: Understand that meditation, O best of the twice-born, accompanied by visualisation: / one should meditate on the universe facing downward, filled with the roar of people, // 215

14.s:
sanālaṃ ca tadūrdhve tu padmamaṣṭadalaṃ tathā |
prakīrṇapatraṃ susitaṃ (ta ?) kesarālaṃ (liṃ ?) sukarṇikam || 216 ||
14.d:
सनालं च तदूर्ध्वे तु पद्ममष्टदलं तथा |
प्रकीर्णपत्रं सुसितं (त ?) केसरालं (लिं ?) सुकर्णिकम् || 216 ||
14.m: and above that, an eight-petalled lotus with its stalk, / with spread petals, pure white, with filaments and a fine pericarp. // 216

14.s:
tanmadhye cintayeddevīṃ vargāṣṭaka bhujānvitām |
mukhyahastacatuṣke tu lāñchanaṃ kamalādikam || 217 ||
14.d:
तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेद्देवीं वर्गाष्टक भुजान्विताम् |
मुख्यहस्तचतुष्के तु लाञ्छनं कमलादिकम् || 217 ||
14.m: In its centre one should contemplate the goddess endowed with eight arms [representing] the eight groups; / in her four principal hands are the emblems, lotus and the rest: // 217

14.s:
kamalaṃ ca tataḥ śaṅkhaṃ pāśaṃ caivāṅkuśaṃ kramāt |
sphaṭikaṃ cākṣasūtraṃ ca tathā vijñānapustakam || 218 ||
14.d:
कमलं च ततः शङ्खं पाशं चैवाङ्कुशं क्रमात् |
स्फटिकं चाक्षसूत्रं च तथा विज्ञानपुस्तकम् || 218 ||
14.m: the lotus, and then the conch, the noose, and the goad in order, / and a crystal rosary, as well as the book of transcendent knowledge; // 218

14.s:
abhayaṃ varadaṃ caiva hastadvidvitaye pare |
padmāsane copaviṣṭhāṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇām || 219 ||
14.d:
अभयं वरदं चैव हस्तद्विद्वितये परे |
पद्मासने चोपविष्ठां पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणाम् || 219 ||
14.m: and the gestures of fearlessness and boon-bestowal in the other two pairs of hands; / seated upon a lotus-seat, with eyes wide as lotus petals, // 219

14.s:
padmagarbhapratīkāśāṃ padmamālāvibhūṣitām |
vidyābharaṇasaṃchannāṃ pītavastraviveṣṭitām || 220 ||
14.d:
पद्मगर्भप्रतीकाशां पद्ममालाविभूषिताम् |
विद्याभरणसंछन्नां पीतवस्त्रविवेष्टिताम् || 220 ||
14.m: resembling the interior of a lotus, adorned with a garland of lotuses, / covered with the ornament of knowledge, wrapped in yellow garments. // 220

14.s: darśayeddevadevasya mudrāṃ nārāyaṇātmanaḥ |
14.d: दर्शयेद्देवदेवस्य मुद्रां नारायणात्मनः |
14.m: He should show to the God of gods the mudrā of the nature of Nārāyaṇa. // 221ab

14.s: [lakṣmyādimantrāṇāmabhyarcanam]
14.d: [लक्ष्म्यादिमन्त्राणामभ्यर्चनम्]
14.m: [Worship of the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others]

14.s: lakṣmyādīnāṃ tato bhaktyā mantrāṇāṃ ca mahāmune || 221 ||
14.d: लक्ष्म्यादीनां ततो भक्त्या मन्त्राणां च महामुने || 221 ||
14.m: Then with devotion [he should worship] the mantras of Lakṣmī and the others, O great sage, // 221cd

14.s: p. 124) bhūyo'rghyapuṣpagandhena dhūpāntena samarcayet |
14.d: प्. 124) भूयोऽर्घ्यपुष्पगन्धेन धूपान्तेन समर्चयेत् |
14.m: again with arghya, flowers, and incense, concluding with incense. // 222ab

14.s: [atha stutiḥ]
14.d: [अथ स्तुतिः]

14.s: tataḥ stuvīta deveśaṃ stotreṇānena nārada || 222 ||
14.d: ततः स्तुवीत देवेशं स्तोत्रेणानेन नारद || 222 ||
14.m: Then he should praise the Lord of gods with this hymn, O Nārada: // 222cd

14.s:
samyakpraṇavapūrveṇa namo'ntena tu vai tridhā |
jitante puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana || 223 ||
14.d:
सम्यक्प्रणवपूर्वेण नमोऽन्तेन तु वै त्रिधा |
जितन्ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष नमस्ते विश्वभावन || 223 ||
14.m: fully preceded by the praṇava and ending in 'namaḥ', three times indeed: / 'Victory to You, O lotus-eyed one! Salutation to You, O Creator of the universe! // 223

14.s: namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣapūrvaja |
14.d: नमस्तेऽस्तु हृषीकेश महापुरुषपूर्वज |
14.m: Salutation be to You, O Hṛṣīkeśa, first-born of the Great Puruṣa!' // 224ab

14.s: [madhuparkādisamarpaṇaprakāraḥ]
14.d: [मधुपर्कादिसमर्पणप्रकारः]
14.m: [The procedure for offering the honey-mixture and other items]

14.s: japanvai dadhisaṃpūrṇaṃ madhunā sarpiṣā'nvitam || 224 ||
14.d: जपन्वै दधिसंपूर्णं मधुना सर्पिषाऽन्वितम् || 224 ||
14.m: While reciting [the mantra], holding in the palm of his hand a vessel full of curd, / combined with honey and clarified butter, // 224cd

14.s:
pātraṃ karatale kṛtvā tanmadhyasthaṃ prabhuṃ smaret |
mūlamantreṇa tadvastu svarūpāduditena ca || 225 ||
14.d:
पात्रं करतले कृत्वा तन्मध्यस्थं प्रभुं स्मरेत् |
मूलमन्त्रेण तद्वस्तु स्वरूपादुदितेन च || 225 ||
14.m: he should remember the Lord situated within it, / with the root-mantra and as arisen from His own form, // 225

14.s:
lasatpīyūṣakallolasattaraṅgeṇa nārada |
tannivedya punarbhaktyā bhūyaḥ puṣpāñjaliṃ kṣipet || 226 ||
14.d:
लसत्पीयूषकल्लोलसत्तरङ्गेण नारद |
तन्निवेद्य पुनर्भक्त्या भूयः पुष्पाञ्जलिं क्षिपेत् || 226 ||
14.m: with gleaming surges and splendid waves of nectar, O Nārada. / Having offered that with devotion, he should again cast a handful of flowers. // 226

14.s:
tato nivedayedviṣṇorhiraṇyakaṭakādikam |
anantaraṃ nimittārthaṃ tāmbūlaṃ tadanantaram || 227 ||
14.d:
ततो निवेदयेद्विष्णोर्हिरण्यकटकादिकम् |
अनन्तरं निमित्तार्थं ताम्बूलं तदनन्तरम् || 227 ||
14.m: Then he should offer to Viṣṇu gold, bracelets, and the like, / immediately thereafter for the sake of the rite, and immediately after that, betel. // 227

14.s:
prakṣālya gandhatoyena arghyapātroddhṛtena vai |
pāṇiyugmaṃ yathā vai syātsārdhamatyantanirmalam || 228 ||
14.d:
प्रक्षाल्य गन्धतोयेन अर्घ्यपात्रोद्धृतेन वै |
पाणियुग्मं यथा वै स्यात्सार्धमत्यन्तनिर्मलम् || 228 ||
14.m: Having washed both hands with scented water / drawn from the arghya-vessel, so that they become thoroughly and exceedingly pure, // 228

14.s:
naivedyadhūpapātrādyaiḥ pātraiśca nirmalīkṛtam |
kṛtvā tadgandhadigdhau tau arghyeṇārcya parasparam || 229 ||
14.d:
नैवेद्यधूपपात्राद्यैः पात्रैश्च निर्मलीकृतम् |
कृत्वा तद्गन्धदिग्धौ तौ अर्घ्येणार्च्य परस्परम् || 229 ||
14.m: cleansed by vessels such as the food-offering and incense vessels, / and having smeared them with that scent, honoring them reciprocally with arghya, // 229

14.s: tannivedya vibhoḥ paścādvākkarmamanasā'nvitaḥ |
14.d: तन्निवेद्य विभोः पश्चाद्वाक्कर्ममनसाऽन्वितः |
14.m: he should offer that to the all-pervading Lord, afterwards accompanied by speech, action, and mind: // 230ab

14.s: [bāhyayāgaparisamāpanakramaḥ]
14.d: [बाह्ययागपरिसमापनक्रमः]
14.m: [The procedure for concluding the external sacrifice]

14.s: puṇḍarīkākṣa viśvātmanmantramūrte janārdana || 230 ||
14.d: पुण्डरीकाक्ष विश्वात्मन्मन्त्रमूर्ते जनार्दन || 230 ||
14.m: 'O lotus-eyed one, O Self of all, O embodiment of mantra, O Janārdana! // 230cd

14.s:
gṛhāṇedaṃ jagannātha mama dīnasya śāśvata |
ityuktvā sodakaṃ puṣpaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇigam || 231 ||
14.d:
गृहाणेदं जगन्नाथ मम दीनस्य शाश्वत |
इत्युक्त्वा सोदकं पुष्पं कृत्वा दक्षिणपाणिगम् || 231 ||
14.m: Accept this, O Lord of the world, from me, a wretched one, O eternal Lord!' / Having spoken thus, placing a flower with water in his right hand, // 231

14.s:
agrato nikṣipedviṣṇormūlamantreṇa nārada |
bhāvayecca tatassamyaksphurantīṃ tārakāvalīm || 232 ||
14.d:
अग्रतो निक्षिपेद्विष्णोर्मूलमन्त्रेण नारद |
भावयेच्च ततस्सम्यक्स्फुरन्तीं तारकावलीम् || 232 ||
14.m: he should cast it before Viṣṇu with the root-mantra, O Nārada. / And then he should properly visualize the radiant row of stars // 232

14.s:
praviṣṭāṃ bhavagadvakre vakrāntāddhṛdgatāṃ punaḥ |
hṛdayāddvijaśārdūla saṃhārākhyakrameṇa tu || 233 ||
14.d:
प्रविष्टां भवगद्वक्रे वक्रान्ताद्धृद्गतां पुनः |
हृदयाद्द्विजशार्दूल संहाराख्यक्रमेण तु || 233 ||
14.m: that has entered the mouth of the Lord, and from His mouth has reached the heart again; / and from the heart, O tiger among the twice-born, in the order called dissolution, // 233

14.s:
pūrvavadbrahmarandhreṇa pareṇa saha yojayet |
bhagavantaṃ tato nattvā aṣṭāṃgena tu bhaktitaḥ || 234 ||
14.d:
पूर्ववद्ब्रह्मरन्ध्रेण परेण सह योजयेत् |
भगवन्तं ततो नत्त्वा अष्टांगेन तु भक्तितः || 234 ||
14.m: he should unite it with the Supreme through the aperture of Brahman as before. / Then, having bowed down to the Lord with eight limbs out of devotion, // 234

14.s:
p. 125) samutthāyāsanāttasminnarghyapuṣpe vinikṣipet |
yasmāttatkṣaṇamantraṃ(?) tu na śūnyaṃ saṃparityajet || 235 ||
14.d:
प्. 125) समुत्थायासनात्तस्मिन्नर्घ्यपुष्पे विनिक्षिपेत् |
यस्मात्तत्क्षणमन्त्रं(?) तु न शून्यं संपरित्यजेत् || 235 ||
14.m: rising from his seat, he should cast arghya and flowers upon it, / because he should not leave that moment's seat empty: // 235

14.s:
ajñānātjñānato vā'pi yātamūnādhikaṃ ca yat |
dāsasya mama dīnasya kṣantavyaṃ lokalocana || 236 ||
14.d:
अज्ञानात्ज्ञानतो वाऽपि यातमूनाधिकं च यत् |
दासस्य मम दीनस्य क्षन्तव्यं लोकलोचन || 236 ||
14.m: 'Whatever has been deficient or redundant, whether done through ignorance or knowledge, / must be forgiven to me, a wretched servant, O Eye of the world!' // 236

14.s:
iti śrīpāñcarātre jayākhyaṃsahitāyāṃ bāhyayāgākhyānaṃ nāma
trayodaśaḥ paṭalaḥ || 13 ||
14.d:
इति श्रीपाञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यंसहितायां बाह्ययागाख्यानं नाम
त्रयोदशः पटलः || 13 ||
14.m: Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'The Exposition of the External Sacrifice', in the venerable Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the Pāñcarātra. // 13

15.s: atha japavidhānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ paṭalaḥ
15.d: अथ जपविधानं नाम चतुर्दशः पटलः
15.m: Now the fourteenth chapter, named 'The Procedure for Japa'.

15.s: nāradaḥ-
15.d: नारदः-

15.s:
brūhi me devadeveśa viṣṇorvibhavamātmanaḥ |
nirṇayaṃ japayajñasya na jñātaṃ tatkathaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
15.d:
ब्रूहि मे देवदेवेश विष्णोर्विभवमात्मनः |
निर्णयं जपयज्ञस्य न ज्ञातं तत्कथं भवेत् || 1 ||
15.m: "Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, the glory of Viṣṇu Himself, / and the determination of the sacrifice of japa; how can that which is not understood be known?" // 1

15.s: śrībhagavānuvāca
15.d: श्रीभगवानुवाच

15.s:
evaṃ santarpya deveśaṃ kumbhe vā maṇḍalādiṣu |
japayajñavidhānena devaṃ santarpayettataḥ || 2 ||
15.d:
एवं सन्तर्प्य देवेशं कुम्भे वा मण्डलादिषु |
जपयज्ञविधानेन देवं सन्तर्पयेत्ततः || 2 ||
15.m: "Having thus gratified the Lord of gods in the pot or in the maṇḍalas and the like, / he should then gratify the god according to the procedure of the sacrifice of japa. // 2

15.s: tadā sa sarvakāmārthānmanaseṣṭānprayacchati |
15.d: तदा स सर्वकामार्थान्मनसेष्टान्प्रयच्छति |
15.m: Then He grants all desired ends wished for in the mind. // 3ab

15.s: [japasya traividhyam]
15.d: [जपस्य त्रैविध्यम्]

15.s: japaṃ tu trividhaṃ kuryādakṣasūtrakarārpitaḥ || 3 ||
15.d: जपं तु त्रिविधं कुर्यादक्षसूत्रकरार्पितः || 3 ||
15.m: Holding the rosary in his hand, he should perform japa of three kinds: // 3cd

15.s:
vācikaṃ kṣudrakarmabhya upāṃśuṃ siddhikarmaṇi |
mānasaṃ mokṣakamārthaṃ dhyāyeddevaṃ tu sarvataḥ || 4 ||
15.d:
वाचिकं क्षुद्रकर्मभ्य उपांशुं सिद्धिकर्मणि |
मानसं मोक्षकमार्थं ध्यायेद्देवं तु सर्वतः || 4 ||
15.m: vocal for minor rites, whispered in a rite for siddhi, / and mental for the sake of liberation; and he should meditate on the god everywhere. // 4

15.s: akṣasūtraṃ śubhaṃ kāryamadṛśyamitarairjanaiḥ |
15.d: अक्षसूत्रं शुभं कार्यमदृश्यमितरैर्जनैः |
15.m: An auspicious rosary should be made, unseen by other people. // 5ab

15.s: [akṣasūtravidhānam tatra maṇipramāṇādiviśeṣāḥ]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रविधानम् तत्र मणिप्रमाणादिविशेषाः]
15.m: [The rule for the rosary, therein the particulars such as bead sizes]

15.s: akṣāsthimātrairmaṇibhirjyeṣṭhaṃ kuryātsuvarttulam || 5 ||
15.d: अक्षास्थिमात्रैर्मणिभिर्ज्येष्ठं कुर्यात्सुवर्त्तुलम् || 5 ||
15.m: He should make the superior one perfectly spherical with beads the size of vibhītaka nuts. // 5cd

15.s:
ghātrīphalānāṃ garbheṇa pramāṇaṃ madhyamaṃ smṛtam |
badarāsthipramāṇena kanīyaṃḥ samudāhṛtam || 6 ||
15.d:
घात्रीफलानां गर्भेण प्रमाणं मध्यमं स्मृतम् |
बदरास्थिप्रमाणेन कनीयंः समुदाहृतम् || 6 ||
15.m: The size of an āmalaka fruit's seed is considered intermediate; / and the size of a jujube seed is declared to be the smallest. // 6

15.s:
aṣṭottaraśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tadardhaṃ pādameva vā |
kuryāttacca vidhānoktaṃ vidhinā pratikarmaṇi || 7 ||
15.d:
अष्टोत्तरशतं पूर्णं तदर्धं पादमेव वा |
कुर्यात्तच्च विधानोक्तं विधिना प्रतिकर्मणि || 7 ||
15.m: He should make it full with one hundred and eight [beads], or half that, or a quarter, / prescribed according to rule, in each rite according to injunction. // 7

15.s:
sauvarṇaṃ dravyasidhyarthamuttamaṃ tatra kārayet |
puṣṭyarthaṃ rūpalābhāya rājataṃ pitṛkarmaṇi || 8 ||
15.d:
सौवर्णं द्रव्यसिध्यर्थमुत्तमं तत्र कारयेत् |
पुष्ट्यर्थं रूपलाभाय राजतं पितृकर्मणि || 8 ||
15.m: There he should have a superior one made of gold for attaining wealth; / one of silver for nourishment and obtaining beauty, in rites for the ancestors; // 8

15.s:
medhāvīryamahātejolābhārthaṃ tāmrameva ca |
madhyamaṃ muniśārdūla kāryaṃ caivākṣasūtrakam || 9 ||
15.d:
मेधावीर्यमहातेजोलाभार्थं ताम्रमेव च |
मध्यमं मुनिशार्दूल कार्यं चैवाक्षसूत्रकम् || 9 ||
15.m: and one made of copper for obtaining intellect, vigor, and great splendor. / An intermediate rosary should be made, O tiger among sages, // 9

15.s:
p. 126) yakṣāṇāṃ yakṣiṇīnāṃ ca sādhane trapujaṃ smṛtam |
rākṣasānāṃ piśācānāṃ vaśe sīsamayaṃ tu vai || 10 ||
15.d:
प्. 126) यक्षाणां यक्षिणीनां च साधने त्रपुजं स्मृतम् |
राक्षसानां पिशाचानां वशे सीसमयं तु वै || 10 ||
15.m: one made of tin is prescribed in the propitiation of yakṣas and yakṣiṇīs; / and one made of lead for subjugating rākṣasas and piśācas. // 10

15.s:
pātālasādhanārthaṃ tu arītimayamucyate |
sapannagānāṃ nāgānāṃ sādhane syāttu kāṃsyajam || 11 ||
15.d:
पातालसाधनार्थं तु अरीतिमयमुच्यते |
सपन्नगानां नागानां साधने स्यात्तु कांस्यजम् || 11 ||
15.m: For propitiating the netherworld, one of brass is taught; / and in propitiating serpents with snakes, it should be made of bell-metal. // 11

15.s:
kanīyastu tadā kuryādāyasaṃ kṣudrakarmaṇi |
iti dhātumayānāṃ ca sūtrāṇāṃ vidhayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 12 ||
15.d:
कनीयस्तु तदा कुर्यादायसं क्षुद्रकर्मणि |
इति धातुमयानां च सूत्राणां विधयः स्मृताः || 12 ||
15.m: Then he should make the smallest one of iron for minor rites. / Thus are declared the rules for rosaries made of metals. // 12

15.s:
vakṣye maṇimayānāṃ ca vibhāgaṃ munisattama |
sarvaṃ maṇimayaṃ caiva āyurārogyabhūtidam || 13 ||
15.d:
वक्ष्ये मणिमयानां च विभागं मुनिसत्तम |
सर्वं मणिमयं चैव आयुरारोग्यभूतिदम् || 13 ||
15.m: I shall also speak of the division of those made of gems, O best of sages. / Every [rosary] made of gems bestows long life, health, and prosperity; // 13

15.s:
mokṣadaṃ tu viśeṣeṇa sphāṭikaṃ śāntikarmaṇi |
tritayaṃ cottamādyaṃ yatsamaṃ sarveṣu karmasu || 14 ||
15.d:
मोक्षदं तु विशेषेण स्फाटिकं शान्तिकर्मणि |
त्रितयं चोत्तमाद्यं यत्समं सर्वेषु कर्मसु || 14 ||
15.m: and one of crystal especially bestows liberation in a rite of pacification. / That triad beginning with the superior is equal in all rites. // 14

15.s:
mūlajānāmatho vakṣye bījānāṃ vidhimuttamam |
saubhāgye vaidrumaṃ kāryamuttamādyaṃ sadā trayam || 15 ||
15.d:
मूलजानामथो वक्ष्ये बीजानां विधिमुत्तमम् |
सौभाग्ये वैद्रुमं कार्यमुत्तमाद्यं सदा त्रयम् || 15 ||
15.m: Now I shall speak of the superior rule for seeds originating from plants. / For good fortune, one of coral should be made; the triad beginning with the superior is always [applicable]. // 15

15.s:
muktyarthaṃ putra dīptaistu puṣpaṣairdopraśāntaye |
vakṣye jalotthitānāṃ ca viṣayaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 16 ||
15.d:
मुक्त्यर्थं पुत्र दीप्तैस्तु पुष्पषैर्दोप्रशान्तये |
वक्ष्ये जलोत्थितानां च विषयं सर्वसिद्धिदम् || 16 ||
15.m: For liberation, O son, with bright [seeds], and with flowers for the pacification of blemishes. / I shall also speak of the category of things born in water, which bestows all accomplishments: // 16

15.s:
padmabījaiśca śāṅkhaiśca śrīkāmo japamārabhet |
āyuḥprajñāyaśaśśāntau mauktikaṃ sarvasiddhidam || 17 ||
15.d:
पद्मबीजैश्च शाङ्खैश्च श्रीकामो जपमारभेत् |
आयुःप्रज्ञायशश्शान्तौ मौक्तिकं सर्वसिद्धिदम् || 17 ||
15.m: one who desires prosperity should begin japa with lotus seeds and conch beads; / one of pearl bestows all accomplishments for long life, wisdom, fame, and pacification. // 17

15.s:
uttamādivibhāgena tritayaṃ yatprakīrtitam |
ebhyo madhyādekatamaṃ grāhyaṃ caiva śubhe dine || 18 ||
15.d:
उत्तमादिविभागेन त्रितयं यत्प्रकीर्तितम् |
एभ्यो मध्यादेकतमं ग्राह्यं चैव शुभे दिने || 18 ||
15.m: Regarding that triad which has been proclaimed according to the division beginning with superior, / on an auspicious day one should choose any one from among these. // 18

15.s: [maṇīnāṃ kṣālanaprakāraḥ]
15.d: [मणीनां क्षालनप्रकारः]
15.m: [The procedure for washing the beads]

15.s: sāstreṇa gandhatoyena kṣālayettadanantaram |
15.d: सास्त्रेण गन्धतोयेन क्षालयेत्तदनन्तरम् |
15.m: Immediately after, he should wash [them] with scented water with the astra[-mantra]. // 19ab

15.s: [sūtraviśeṣavidhānam]
15.d: [सूत्रविशेषविधानम्]

15.s: śāṇaṃ kārpāsakaṃ vā'tha prāpya sūtraṃ navaṃ dṛḍham || 19 ||
15.d: शाणं कार्पासकं वाऽथ प्राप्य सूत्रं नवं दृढम् || 19 ||
15.m: Having obtained a fresh, strong cord of hemp or cotton, // 19cd

15.s:
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya caturthā vā yathā dṛḍham |
suveṣṭitaṃ tu vai kṛtvā kṣālayetpūrvavaddvija || 20 ||
15.d:
त्रिगुणं त्रिगुणीकृत्य चतुर्था वा यथा दृढम् |
सुवेष्टितं तु वै कृत्वा क्षालयेत्पूर्ववद्द्विज || 20 ||
15.m: three-ply made three-fold, or four-fold so that it is strong, / having wound it well, he should wash it as before, O twice-born. // 20

15.s: [sūtre maṇīnāṃ yojanaprakāraḥ]
15.d: [सूत्रे मणीनां योजनप्रकारः]
15.m: [The procedure for joining the beads on the cord]

15.s:
nikṣepyā maṇayastasminsandhānakramayuktitaḥ |
maṇayassusamāssarve ūnādhikyavivarjitāḥ || 21 ||
15.d:
निक्षेप्या मणयस्तस्मिन्सन्धानक्रमयुक्तितः |
मणयस्सुसमास्सर्वे ऊनाधिक्यविवर्जिताः || 21 ||
15.m: The beads are to be strung on it according to the method of joining; / all the beads must be thoroughly uniform, free from deficiency or excess, // 21

15.s:
japārthaṃ muniśārdūla nityaṃ mantreṣu niṣkale |
maṇibhiḥ kramasūtraistu mutantukala niṣkale (?) || 22 ||
15.d:
जपार्थं मुनिशार्दूल नित्यं मन्त्रेषु निष्कले |
मणिभिः क्रमसूत्रैस्तु मुतन्तुकल निष्कले (?) || 22 ||
15.m: for the sake of japa, O tiger among sages, constantly in mantras without parts. / With beads and ordered cords […] in the unmanifest, // 22

15.s:
p. 127) sakale tu yathecchā vai sūtrārthaṃ maṇigolakāḥ | (?)
yugalaṃ yugalaṃ sūtre parasparamukhaṃ dvija || 23 ||
15.d:
प्. 127) सकले तु यथेच्छा वै सूत्रार्थं मणिगोलकाः | (?)
युगलं युगलं सूत्रे परस्परमुखं द्विज || 23 ||
15.m: and in the manifest, as desired, the bead-globes for the cord [should be arranged], / each pair facing one another on the cord, O twice-born, // 23

15.s:
pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhasya lagnaṃ vā yathā syādyojayettathā |
sandhāya cātisuśliṣṭaṃ gahanaṃ na bhavedyathā || 24 ||
15.d:
पृष्ठं पृष्ठस्य लग्नं वा यथा स्याद्योजयेत्तथा |
सन्धाय चातिसुश्लिष्टं गहनं न भवेद्यथा || 24 ||
15.m: or joined back-to-back, so he should join them, / having fitted them very closely so that it is not impenetrable. // 24

15.s: [akṣasūtrasya valayākāratāpādanam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रस्य वलयाकारतापादनम्]
15.m: [Giving the rosary the form of a ring]

15.s:
parasparamaṇīnāṃ tu protānāṃ munisattama |
avyucchinnena tenaiva tvekena protatantunā || 25 ||
15.d:
परस्परमणीनां तु प्रोतानां मुनिसत्तम |
अव्युच्छिन्नेन तेनैव त्वेकेन प्रोततन्तुना || 25 ||
15.m: When the beads have been strung mutually, O best of sages, / with that very same unbroken thread on which they were strung, // 25

15.s:
maṇibhyāṃ saṅgamoddeśātsūtraṃ sūtreṇa veṣṭayet |
yathā syātkaṭakākāraṃ stabdhaṃ vṛttaṃ vibhaktimat || 26 ||
15.d:
मणिभ्यां सङ्गमोद्देशात्सूत्रं सूत्रेण वेष्टयेत् |
यथा स्यात्कटकाकारं स्तब्धं वृत्तं विभक्तिमत् || 26 ||
15.m: from the point of union of the two beads, he should wrap cord with cord, / so that it takes the shape of a bracelet, rigid, circular, and divided into parts. // 26

15.s: [akṣasūtre merukalpanam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रे मेरुकल्पनम्]
15.m: [Arranging the meru on the rosary]

15.s:
grandhisandhāvato vipra maṇisakhyādhikaṃ tataḥ |
meruṃ prakalpayenmadhye ekena gulikena ca || 27 ||
15.d:
ग्रन्धिसन्धावतो विप्र मणिसख्याधिकं ततः |
मेरुं प्रकल्पयेन्मध्ये एकेन गुलिकेन च || 27 ||
15.m: At the junction of the knot, O brahmin, beyond the count of the beads, / he should then fashion the meru in the middle with a single bead. // 27

15.s: [akṣasūtrasaṃśodhanāvadhānam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रसंशोधनावधानम्]
15.m: [Rules for purifying the rosary]

15.s:
vilipya candanādyaistu sthāpayedbhājane śubhe |
saṃpūjya puṣpadhūpādyaistasya śuddhimathācaret || 28 ||
15.d:
विलिप्य चन्दनाद्यैस्तु स्थापयेद्भाजने शुभे |
संपूज्य पुष्पधूपाद्यैस्तस्य शुद्धिमथाचरेत् || 28 ||
15.m: Having smeared it with sandal and [other unguents], he should place it in an auspicious vessel; / having worshipped it with flowers, incense, and the like, he should then perform its purification. // 28

15.s:
dagdhamastreṇa saṃcintya varmaṇā māruteritam |
āplāvya mūlamantreṇa paramāmṛtarūpiṇā || 29 ||
15.d:
दग्धमस्त्रेण संचिन्त्य वर्मणा मारुतेरितम् |
आप्लाव्य मूलमन्त्रेण परमामृतरूपिणा || 29 ||
15.m: Thinking of it as burnt by the astra, driven by the wind with the kavaca, / and inundated with the mūlamantra in the form of supreme nectar, // 29

15.s: saṃśodhyaivaṃ purā sūtraṃ dehavaccintayettataḥ |
15.d: संशोध्यैवं पुरा सूत्रं देहवच्चिन्तयेत्ततः |
15.m: having thus first purified the cord, he should then contemplate it like a body.

15.s: [akṣasūtrasya divyadehatvena cintanam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रस्य दिव्यदेहत्वेन चिन्तनम्]
15.m: [Contemplation of the rosary as having a divine body]

15.s: caturbhujaṃ tu virajo nārāyaṇamivāparam || 30 ||
15.d: चतुर्भुजं तु विरजो नारायणमिवापरम् || 30 ||
15.m: He should recall it as four-armed, immaculate, like another Nārāyaṇa, // 30

15.s:
varadābhayahastaṃ ca baddhāñjalidharaṃ smaret |
brahmadvārasthitaṃ tacca sūtraṃ dhyāyecchikhopamam || 31 ||
15.d:
वरदाभयहस्तं च बद्धाञ्जलिधरं स्मरेत् |
ब्रह्मद्वारस्थितं तच्च सूत्रं ध्यायेच्छिखोपमम् || 31 ||
15.m: with hands bestowing boons and freedom from fear, and holding folded hands. / And he should meditate on that cord resting at the door of Brahman, resembling a tuft of hair, // 31

15.s: svamantreṇa dvijaśreṣṭha mantramatra nibodhatu |
15.d: स्वमन्त्रेण द्विजश्रेष्ठ मन्त्रमत्र निबोधतु |
15.m: with its own mantra, O best of the twice-born; hear the mantra here:

15.s: [akṣasūtramantraḥ]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रमन्त्रः]

15.s: proddharetpraṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ tadante kaustubhaṃ nyaset || 32 ||
15.d: प्रोद्धरेत्प्रणवं पूर्वं तदन्ते कौस्तुभं न्यसेत् || 32 ||
15.m: He should first extract the praṇava; after that he should place kaustubha; // 32

15.s:
trailokyaiśvaryadopetaṃ gopanenāṅkayecca tat |
tadante tvakṣasūtrāya padaṃ pañcākṣaraṃ nyaset || 33 ||
15.d:
त्रैलोक्यैश्वर्यदोपेतं गोपनेनाङ्कयेच्च तत् |
तदन्ते त्वक्षसूत्राय पदं पञ्चाक्षरं न्यसेत् || 33 ||
15.m: he should mark that which bestows sovereignty over the three worlds with concealing; / after that he should place the five-syllable word akṣasūtrāya, // 33

15.s: namaskārānvitaḥ prokto hyakṣasūtrasya mantrarāṭ |
15.d: नमस्कारान्वितः प्रोक्तो ह्यक्षसूत्रस्य मन्त्रराट् |
15.m: endowed with namas—thus is declared the king of mantras of the rosary.

15.s: [svamantreṇākṣasūtrasya sakalīkaraṇapūjane]
15.d: [स्वमन्त्रेणाक्षसूत्रस्य सकलीकरणपूजने]
15.m: [Sakalīkaraṇa and worship of the rosary with its own mantra]

15.s: sakalīkaraṇaṃ kuryānmantreṇānena tasya vai || 34 ||
15.d: सकलीकरणं कुर्यान्मन्त्रेणानेन तस्य वै || 34 ||
15.m: He should indeed perform the sakalīkaraṇa of it with this mantra, // 34

15.s: p. 128) pūjayecca svamantreṇa tatastatsanghaye kramāt |
15.d: प्. 128) पूजयेच्च स्वमन्त्रेण ततस्तत्सन्घये क्रमात् |
15.m: and then worship it with its own mantra in its collection in due order.

15.s: [vaiṣṇavyāḥ paraśakterakṣasūtre bhāvanākramavidhānam]
15.d: [वैष्णव्याः परशक्तेरक्षसूत्रे भावनाक्रमविधानम्]
15.m: [Prescription of the order of meditation on the supreme Vaiṣṇava power in the rosary]

15.s: yā parā vaiṣṇavī śaktirabhinnā paramātmanaḥ || 35 ||
15.d: या परा वैष्णवी शक्तिरभिन्ना परमात्मनः || 35 ||
15.m: That supreme Vaiṣṇava power which is non-different from the Supreme Self, // 35

15.s:
pracalatpūrṇacandrābhā sūryavatkiraṇāvṛtā |
yugakṣayograhutabhuktejasā tīvṛbṛṃhitā || 36 ||
15.d:
प्रचलत्पूर्णचन्द्राभा सूर्यवत्किरणावृता |
युगक्षयोग्रहुतभुक्तेजसा तीवृबृंहिता || 36 ||
15.m: radiant like a trembling full moon, enveloped in rays like the sun, / intensely augmented by the radiance of the fire that consumes fiercely at the end of an aeon, // 36

15.s:
prāgvatsṛṣṭikrameṇaiva smareddhṛtpadmamadhyagām |
pūrakeṇa tu viprendra kumbhakena nirodhitām || 37 ||
15.d:
प्राग्वत्सृष्टिक्रमेणैव स्मरेद्धृत्पद्ममध्यगाम् |
पूरकेण तु विप्रेन्द्र कुम्भकेन निरोधिताम् || 37 ||
15.m: he should recall, following the sequence of creation as before, situated in the centre of the heart-lotus, / [drawn] by inhalation, O chief of brahmins, and restrained by retention. // 37

15.s:
hṛtpadmādutthitāṃ bhūyo brahmarandhrāvadhiṃ smaret |
brahmarandhrāttato vipra prollasantīṃ śanaiśśanaiḥ || 38 ||
15.d:
हृत्पद्मादुत्थितां भूयो ब्रह्मरन्ध्रावधिं स्मरेत् |
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रात्ततो विप्र प्रोल्लसन्तीं शनैश्शनैः || 38 ||
15.m: He should again recall it risen from the heart-lotus up to the aperture of Brahman, / and then, O brahmin, shining forth gradually from the aperture of Brahman, // 38

15.s:
pūrvavatsandhimārgeṇa cintayeddvādaśāntagām | (?)
recakākhyena yogena tayā sūtraṃ tu bhāvayet || 39 ||
15.d:
पूर्ववत्सन्धिमार्गेण चिन्तयेद्द्वादशान्तगाम् | (?)
रेचकाख्येन योगेन तया सूत्रं तु भावयेत् || 39 ||
15.m: he should contemplate it going to the end of the twelve along the junction-path as before; / by means of the yoga called exhalation, he should infuse the cord with it. // 39

15.s: [akṣasūtraprabhodbhāsitatvena yāgālayasmaraṇam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रप्रभोद्भासितत्वेन यागालयस्मरणम्]
15.m: [Recollection of the sacrificial hall as illuminated by the radiance of the rosary]

15.s: bhāsitaṃ cātha sūtreṇa sarvaṃ yāgālayaṃ smaret |
15.d: भासितं चाथ सूत्रेण सर्वं यागालयं स्मरेत् |
15.m: And then he should recall the whole sacrificial hall illuminated by the cord,

15.s: pūrṇenduneva gaganaṃ,
15.d: पूर्णेन्दुनेव गगनं,

15.s:
[mantrātmano bhagavacchatteḥ sūtrasya mantrākṣarāṇāṃ
caikībhūtatvabhāvanavidhiḥ]
15.d:
[मन्त्रात्मनो भगवच्छत्तेः सूत्रस्य मन्त्राक्षराणां
चैकीभूतत्वभावनविधिः]
15.m: [The rule for meditating on the oneness of the Lord's power, which is the self of the mantra, the cord, and the syllables of the mantra]

15.s: niṣkalo mantrarāṭ tataḥ || 40 ||
15.d: निष्कलो मन्त्रराट् ततः || 40 ||
15.m: then the partless king of mantras, // 40

15.s:
mantrabṛndasamāyukto magnastatreti cintayet |
mantrātmā bhagavacchaktissūtramantrākṣarāṇi vai || 41 ||
15.d:
मन्त्रबृन्दसमायुक्तो मग्नस्तत्रेति चिन्तयेत् |
मन्त्रात्मा भगवच्छक्तिस्सूत्रमन्त्राक्षराणि वै || 41 ||
15.m: joined with the host of mantras, he should contemplate as immersed therein. / The power of the Lord, which is the self of the mantra, the cord, and the syllables of the mantra— // 41

15.s: sarvamekīkṛtaṃ dhyāyedyathā kṣīreṇa sodakam |
15.d: सर्वमेकीकृतं ध्यायेद्यथा क्षीरेण सोदकम् |
15.m: he should meditate upon all this made one, like water with milk.

15.s: [sakalaniṣkalamantrasya sṛṣṭikrameṇākṣasūtre sānnidhyacintanam]
15.d: [सकलनिष्कलमन्त्रस्य सृष्टिक्रमेणाक्षसूत्रे सान्निध्यचिन्तनम्]
15.m: [Contemplation of the presence of the mantra, both with and without parts, in the rosary according to the sequence of creation]

15.s: tatra puṣpāñjalau pṛṣṭhe gṛhītvā cintayedimam || 42 ||
15.d: तत्र पुष्पाञ्जलौ पृष्ठे गृहीत्वा चिन्तयेदिमम् || 42 ||
15.m: Taking it there on the reverse side in a handful of flowers, he should contemplate this: // 42

15.s:
susaṃskṛtākṣasūtrasya patantaṃ pṛṣṭhato dvija |
sṛṣṭikramātsamāyātaṃ mantraṃ sakalaniṣkalam || 43 ||
15.d:
सुसंस्कृताक्षसूत्रस्य पतन्तं पृष्ठतो द्विज |
सृष्टिक्रमात्समायातं मन्त्रं सकलनिष्कलम् || 43 ||
15.m: falling upon the back of the well-consecrated rosary, O twice-born, / the mantra, possessing parts and partless, arrived in the sequence of creation, // 43

15.s: sphuliṅgagaṇasaṅkāśamādheyatanutāṃ gatam |
15.d: स्फुलिङ्गगणसङ्काशमाधेयतनुतां गतम् |
15.m: resembling a swarm of sparks, having attained the condition of the body to be supported.

15.s: [bhagavatprārthanāpūrvaka tadabhyanujñayā'kṣasūtrasya grahaṇam]
15.d: [भगवत्प्रार्थनापूर्वक तदभ्यनुज्ञयाऽक्षसूत्रस्य ग्रहणम्]
15.m: [Taking the rosary with the Lord's permission preceded by prayer to the Lord]

15.s: idaṃ vijñāpya deveśamakṣasūtramayācyuta || 44 ||
15.d: इदं विज्ञाप्य देवेशमक्षसूत्रमयाच्युत || 44 ||
15.m: Having petitioned the Lord of Gods with this: 'O Acyuta, bestow this rosary // 44

15.s:
prayaccha mantrajāpārthaṃ smareddattaṃ ca tena tat |
gṛhīsvā śirasā paścātprasīda iti coccaret || 45 ||
15.d:
प्रयच्छ मन्त्रजापार्थं स्मरेद्दत्तं च तेन तत् |
गृहीस्वा शिरसा पश्चात्प्रसीद इति चोच्चरेत् || 45 ||
15.m: upon me for the sake of mantra-japa', he should recall that it has been given by Him. / Having received it with his head, he should afterwards utter: 'Be gracious!' // 45

15.s: [abhyarcanapūrvakamakṣasūtre mantrasya pratiṣṭhāpanakramaḥ]
15.d: [अभ्यर्चनपूर्वकमक्षसूत्रे मन्त्रस्य प्रतिष्ठापनक्रमः]
15.m: [The sequence of establishing the mantra in the rosary preceded by worship]

15.s: prāptaṃ saṃsnāpayetpaścādarghyapātrācca vāriṇā |
15.d: प्राप्तं संस्नापयेत्पश्चादर्घ्यपात्राच्च वारिणा |
15.m: He should afterwards bathe what was received with water from the arghya-vessel,

15.s: p. 129) saṃpūjya puṣpadhūpādyairmantraṃ tava ca vinyaset || 46 ||
15.d: प्. 129) संपूज्य पुष्पधूपाद्यैर्मन्त्रं तव च विन्यसेत् || 46 ||
15.m: and having worshipped it with flowers, incense, and the like, he should install the mantra there: // 46

15.s:
sādhāraṃ sādhanaṃ caiva śaktipūrvaissamāvṛtam |
sannidhau bhava deveśa sanniruddho bhavācyuta || 47 ||
15.d:
साधारं साधनं चैव शक्तिपूर्वैस्समावृतम् |
सन्निधौ भव देवेश सन्निरुद्धो भवाच्युत || 47 ||
15.m: 'With support and with the instrument, and surrounded by the primary powers, / be present, O Lord of Gods! Be restrained [here], O Acyuta, // 47

15.s:
sūtrākhye maṇijāle'sminyāvaccaṃdrārkatārakam |
evaṃ mune pratiṣṭhāpya mantraṃ sūtre'kṣasaṃjñike || 48 ||
15.d:
सूत्राख्ये मणिजालेऽस्मिन्यावच्चंद्रार्कतारकम् |
एवं मुने प्रतिष्ठाप्य मन्त्रं सूत्रेऽक्षसंज्ञिके || 48 ||
15.m: in this web of beads called a cord, as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure!' / Having thus established the mantra in the cord called akṣa, O sage, // 48

15.s: pratiṣṭhitasya vai paścānmudrāṃ svāṃ ca pradarśayet |
15.d: प्रतिष्ठितस्य वै पश्चान्मुद्रां स्वां च प्रदर्शयेत् |
15.m: he should then show its own mudrā to the one established.

15.s: [akṣasūtramudrā]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रमुद्रा]

15.s: lagnaṃ tiryaggataṃ kuryātkuñcitaṃ dakṣiṇātkarāt || 49 ||
15.d: लग्नं तिर्यग्गतं कुर्यात्कुञ्चितं दक्षिणात्करात् || 49 ||
15.m: He should place [the four fingers] adjoining, transverse, and bent from the right hand; // 49

15.s:
catuṣkamaṅgulīnāṃ ca aṅguṣṭhāgreṇa saṃspṛśet |
tarjanādikrameṇaiva kaniṣṭhāntaṃ dvijottama || 50 ||
15.d:
चतुष्कमङ्गुलीनां च अङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण संस्पृशेत् |
तर्जनादिक्रमेणैव कनिष्ठान्तं द्विजोत्तम || 50 ||
15.m: and he should touch the group of four fingers with the tip of the thumb, / in order beginning with the forefinger and ending with the little finger, O best of the twice-born. // 50

15.s:
saṃspṛśantaṃ kaniṣṭhāntamaṅguṣṭhaṃ cordhvamānayet |
akṣasūtrasya mudraiṣā nityasannidhikāriṇī || 51 ||
15.d:
संस्पृशन्तं कनिष्ठान्तमङ्गुष्ठं चोर्ध्वमानयेत् |
अक्षसूत्रस्य मुद्रैषा नित्यसन्निधिकारिणी || 51 ||
15.m: Touching up to the little finger, he should bring the thumb upwards. / This is the mudrā of the rosary, which effects perpetual presence. // 51

15.s: japaṃ samārabhetpaścādadṛśyamitarairjanaiḥ |
15.d: जपं समारभेत्पश्चाददृश्यमितरैर्जनैः |
15.m: Afterwards he should begin the japa, invisible to other people.

15.s: [japārambhātprākkartavyo'nusandhānaviśeṣaḥ]
15.d: [जपारम्भात्प्राक्कर्तव्योऽनुसन्धानविशेषः]
15.m: [The specific reflection to be made before beginning japa]

15.s: karaṇaṃ vāṅmanaścaiva mantreṇa paramātmanā || 52 ||
15.d: करणं वाङ्मनश्चैव मन्त्रेण परमात्मना || 52 ||
15.m: He should first contemplate the organ, and speech and mind, // 52

15.s:
viṣṇunā śaktirūpeṇa bhāvitaṃ bhāvayetpurā |
cetasā yadupārūḍhaṃ tadyuktaṃ vastu vāggatam || 53 ||
15.d:
विष्णुना शक्तिरूपेण भावितं भावयेत्पुरा |
चेतसा यदुपारूढं तद्युक्तं वस्तु वाग्गतम् || 53 ||
15.m: as infused by the mantra, by the Supreme Self, by Viṣṇu in the form of power. / That which has ascended in thought, the object endowed with that, situated in speech, // 53

15.s:
vastuyuktaṃ ca caitanyaṃ vāktṛtīyā ca nārada |
samārohetkarmapade vikāratve śanaiśśanaiḥ || 54 ||
15.d:
वस्तुयुक्तं च चैतन्यं वाक्तृतीया च नारद |
समारोहेत्कर्मपदे विकारत्वे शनैश्शनैः || 54 ||
15.m: consciousness endowed with the object, and speech as the third, O Nārada, / should gradually ascend to the state of action in the condition of transformation. // 54

15.s:
evaṃ vivartate mantrasturyājjāgrāvadhi kramāt |
prātilomyena vai vipra punareva nivartate || 55 ||
15.d:
एवं विवर्तते मन्त्रस्तुर्याज्जाग्रावधि क्रमात् |
प्रातिलोम्येन वै विप्र पुनरेव निवर्तते || 55 ||
15.m: Thus the mantra evolves gradually from the fourth state up to waking; / in reverse order, O brahmin, it indeed turns back again. // 55

15.s:
karaṇaṃ vāksvarūpaṃ syādvākca cidrūpiṇī bhavet |
yaccittaṃ sa bhavenmantro yo mantrassa tvajo hariḥ || 56 ||
15.d:
करणं वाक्स्वरूपं स्याद्वाक्च चिद्रूपिणी भवेत् |
यच्चित्तं स भवेन्मन्त्रो यो मन्त्रस्स त्वजो हरिः || 56 ||
15.m: The organ would be of the nature of speech, and speech would consist of consciousness; / that which is mind becomes the mantra; that which is the mantra is the unborn Hari. // 56

15.s:
brahmādyajāgratparyantaṃ punaratraiva saṃnayet |
vyāpakaṃ yatparaṃ brahma śaktirnārāyaṇī ca yā || 57 ||
15.d:
ब्रह्माद्यजाग्रत्पर्यन्तं पुनरत्रैव संनयेत् |
व्यापकं यत्परं ब्रह्म शक्तिर्नारायणी च या || 57 ||
15.m: He should lead it back right here from Brahman down to waking. / That all-pervading Supreme Brahman, and that power of Nārāyaṇa— // 57

15.s:
sā hyeva pariṇāmena turyākhyaṃ bhajate padam |
turyaṃ suṣuptatāmeti suṣuptaṃ svapnatāṃ vrajet || 58 ||
15.d:
सा ह्येव परिणामेन तुर्याख्यं भजते पदम् |
तुर्यं सुषुप्ततामेति सुषुप्तं स्वप्नतां व्रजेत् || 58 ||
15.m: she indeed, through transformation, assumes the state called the fourth; / the fourth attains deep sleep; deep sleep goes to the state of dreaming; // 58

15.s: jāgratvaṃ svapnamāyāti evaṃ jāgrāditaḥ punaḥ |
15.d: जाग्रत्वं स्वप्नमायाति एवं जाग्रादितः पुनः |
15.m: dreaming arrives at the waking state. In this way, again from waking,

15.s: p. 130) [jāgradādibhedanirūpaṇam]
15.d: प्. 130) [जाग्रदादिभेदनिरूपणम्]
15.m: [Determination of the differences between waking and the other states]

15.s: bhagavacchaktiparyantaṃ sandhānaṃ caikatāṃ smaret || 59 ||
15.d: भगवच्छक्तिपर्यन्तं सन्धानं चैकतां स्मरेत् || 59 ||
15.m: up to the power of the Lord, he should recall the union and unity. // 59

15.s:
yadanityamidaṃ vipra citravatparidṛśyate |
bāhyaṃ viṣayajālaṃ ca jāgradetadudāhṛtam || 60 ||
15.d:
यदनित्यमिदं विप्र चित्रवत्परिदृश्यते |
बाह्यं विषयजालं च जाग्रदेतदुदाहृतम् || 60 ||
15.m: This which is transient, O brahmin, perceived like a painting, / and the external web of sense-objects—this is called waking. // 60

15.s:
anityapratipattiryā asminnupari sarvadā |
bhaṅgure svapnatulyo yassa svapno jāgrakāraṇam || 61 ||
15.d:
अनित्यप्रतिपत्तिर्या अस्मिन्नुपरि सर्वदा |
भङ्गुरे स्वप्नतुल्यो यस्स स्वप्नो जाग्रकारणम् || 61 ||
15.m:
The cognition of the impermanent that always exists upon this [waking state],
frail and dream-like—that is dreaming, the cause of waking. // 61

15.s:
suṣuptaṃ śāntatāṃ viddhi svapnavṛtteḥ paraṃ tu yat |
śaktirūpasya vai viṣṇoḥ prāptasturyatvameti saḥ || 62 ||
15.d:
सुषुप्तं शान्ततां विद्धि स्वप्नवृत्तेः परं तु यत् |
शक्तिरूपस्य वै विष्णोः प्राप्तस्तुर्यत्वमेति सः || 62 ||
15.m:
Know deep sleep to be stillness beyond the activity of dreaming;
reaching the form of power of Viṣṇu, he attains the fourth state. // 62

15.s:
tayā saha samatvaṃ ca turyātītaṃ taducyate |
mantrātītaṃ paraṃ mantraṃ sthūlasūkṣmadvayaṃ tathā || 63 ||
15.d:
तया सह समत्वं च तुर्यातीतं तदुच्यते |
मन्त्रातीतं परं मन्त्रं स्थूलसूक्ष्मद्वयं तथा || 63 ||
15.m:
And equality with that [power] is said to be beyond the fourth state.
Beyond the mantra, the supreme mantra, as well as the gross and subtle pair, // 63

15.s:
ātmānaṃ pañcamaṃ vipra ekatvenānusandhayet |
kṛtvaivamanusandhānaṃ prārabheta japaṃ tathā || 64 ||
15.d:
आत्मानं पञ्चमं विप्र एकत्वेनानुसन्धयेत् |
कृत्वैवमनुसन्धानं प्रारभेत जपं तथा || 64 ||
15.m:
and the self as the fifth, O brahmin, he should integrate into oneness.
Having thus made this integration, he should then begin the japa. // 64

15.s: [antarhṛtpuṇḍarīkādiva bahirakṣasūtre mantrasyodaya kramabhāvanam]
15.d: [अन्तर्हृत्पुण्डरीकादिव बहिरक्षसूत्रे मन्त्रस्योदय क्रमभावनम्]
15.m: [Meditation on the order of the mantra's arising, inside in the heart-lotus and the like, as well as outside on the rosary]

15.s:
hṛtpuṇḍarīkamadhyastho bhārūpaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
nirmalasphaṭikaprakhyaḥ prasphuranyaḥ svatejasā || 65 ||
15.d:
हृत्पुण्डरीकमध्यस्थो भारूपः परमेश्वरः |
निर्मलस्फटिकप्रख्यः प्रस्फुरन्यः स्वतेजसा || 65 ||
15.m:
The Supreme Lord, abiding in the middle of the heart-lotus, whose nature is light,
resembling a spotless crystal, flashing forth with His own splendour— // 65

15.s:
tasya śabdamayī śaktī(ktiḥ ?)jvālāvannissṛtaṃ mahat (tāhiyā ?) |
taddharmadharmiṇī śuddhā tasyā vai varṇasantatiḥ || 66 ||
15.d:
तस्य शब्दमयी शक्ती(क्तिः ?)ज्वालावन्निस्सृतं महत् (ताहिया ?) |
तद्धर्मधर्मिणी शुद्धा तस्या वै वर्णसन्ततिः || 66 ||
15.m:
from Him, His sonic power has emerged like a great flame;
sharing His qualities, pure, His succession of phonemes // 66

15.s:
nissṛtā mantrajananī tadagrāccaiva mantrarāṭ |
nissṛtaṃ(tu) yathā puṣpaṃ latāgrānmunisattama || 67 ||
15.d:
निस्सृता मन्त्रजननी तदग्राच्चैव मन्त्रराट् |
निस्सृतं(तु) यथा पुष्पं लताग्रान्मुनिसत्तम || 67 ||
15.m:
has issued forth as the mother of mantras, and from its tip the king of mantras,
