just as a flower emerges from the tip of a creeper, O best of sages. // 67

15.s:
evamevākṣasūtre tu uditaṃ ca kramaṃ smaret |
hṛllayaṃ tallayīkuryāddhṛllayasya ca tattathā || 68 ||
15.d:
एवमेवाक्षसूत्रे तु उदितं च क्रमं स्मरेत् |
हृल्लयं तल्लयीकुर्याद्धृल्लयस्य च तत्तथा || 68 ||
15.m:
Just so he should recall the order that has arisen upon the rosary:
he should dissolve it into that which is dissolved in the heart, and that likewise into that which is dissolved in the heart, // 68

15.s: ekasya mantranāthasya antarbāhyoditasya ca |
15.d: एकस्य मन्त्रनाथस्य अन्तर्बाह्योदितस्य च |
15.m: of the single Lord of Mantras who has arisen internally and externally.

15.s: [japasaṅkhyāvidhānam]
15.d: [जपसङ्ख्याविधानम्]

15.s: yadaikaṃ tajjapo vipra lakṣasaṃkhyābhidho bhavet || 69 ||
15.d: यदैकं तज्जपो विप्र लक्षसंख्याभिधो भवेत् || 69 ||
15.m: When it is one, O brahmin, that japa is designated as amounting to one hundred thousand. // 69

15.s:
evaṃ lakṣasthito yasmājjapastu parisaṃkhyate |
prayatnādakṣasūtreṇa japasaṃkhyā tu sā smṛtā || 70 ||
15.d:
एवं लक्षस्थितो यस्माज्जपस्तु परिसंख्यते |
प्रयत्नादक्षसूत्रेण जपसंख्या तु सा स्मृता || 70 ||
15.m:
Because japa fixed at one hundred thousand is thus enumerated,
that, through effort with the rosary, is traditionally known as the count of japa. // 70

15.s:
anena kramayogena viṣṇuvatkaraṇaṃ bhavet |
viṣṇuvadyogamāśritya akṣamakṣaṃ samāharet || 71 ||
15.d:
अनेन क्रमयोगेन विष्णुवत्करणं भवेत् |
विष्णुवद्योगमाश्रित्य अक्षमक्षं समाहरेत् || 71 ||
15.m:
By this ritual sequence, action becomes like that of Viṣṇu;
resorting to yoga like Viṣṇu, he should draw bead after bead, // 71

15.s: saha prāṇodayenaiva niṣṭhākṣaṃ yāvadeva hi |
15.d: सह प्राणोदयेनैव निष्ठाक्षं यावदेव हि |
15.m: along with the rise of the breath, right up to the final bead.

15.s: p. 131) [merorlaṅghananiṣedhaḥ]
15.d: प्. 131) [मेरोर्लङ्घननिषेधः]
15.m: p. 131) [Prohibition of crossing over the meru]

15.s: tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānmerumūrtisthitasya ca || 72 ||
15.d: ततः प्रदक्षिणं कुर्यान्मेरुमूर्तिस्थितस्य च || 72 ||
15.m: Then he should make a circumambulation of that which is situated in the form of the meru, // 72

15.s:
niṣkalasya ca mantrasya tadūrdhve'vasthitasya ca |
grandhīrūpasya ca vibhoramalasya mahātmanaḥ || 73 ||
15.d:
निष्कलस्य च मन्त्रस्य तदूर्ध्वेऽवस्थितस्य च |
ग्रन्धीरूपस्य च विभोरमलस्य महात्मनः || 73 ||
15.m:
and of the partless mantra situated above it,
and of the all-pervading, spotless, great-souled [Lord] who has the form of the knot. // 73

15.s:
pṛṣṭhena laṅghanaṃ yasmādvarjanīyaṃ tu nārada |
merumūle'ṅguliprāntaṃ śiṣṭaṃ kṛtvā śanaiśśanaiḥ || 74 ||
15.d:
पृष्ठेन लङ्घनं यस्माद्वर्जनीयं तु नारद |
मेरुमूलेऽङ्गुलिप्रान्तं शिष्टं कृत्वा शनैश्शनैः || 74 ||
15.m:
Since, O Nārada, crossing over by the back is to be avoided,
leaving the tip of the finger at the base of the meru, slowly and slowly // 74

15.s:
aṅguṣṭhasya bhramaṃ kuryānnamerorlaṅghanaṃ bhavet |
aṅguṣṭhamūlamadhye ca bhrāmaṇīyaṃ ca chatravat || 75 ||
15.d:
अङ्गुष्ठस्य भ्रमं कुर्यान्नमेरोर्लङ्घनं भवेत् |
अङ्गुष्ठमूलमध्ये च भ्रामणीयं च छत्रवत् || 75 ||
15.m:
he should make a turn of the thumb, so that no crossing over of the meru occurs;
and it should be turned like an umbrella at the base of the thumb. // 75

15.s: vidhinā'nena japtavyo mantro dhyānasamanvitaḥ |
15.d: विधिनाऽनेन जप्तव्यो मन्त्रो ध्यानसमन्वितः |
15.m: According to this rule, the mantra should be recited, accompanied by meditation.

15.s:
[śāntikapauṣṭikādinimittabhedena mantrasya bhinnabhinnarūpatayā
dhyānavidhānam]
15.d:
[शान्तिकपौष्टिकादिनिमित्तभेदेन मन्त्रस्य भिन्नभिन्नरूपतया
ध्यानविधानम्]
15.m: [Rules for meditating on the mantra in different forms according to the difference of motives such as pacification and nourishment]

15.s: śāntike sphāṭikābhaṃ ca pītaṃ dhyāyecca pauṣṭike || 76 ||
15.d: शान्तिके स्फाटिकाभं च पीतं ध्यायेच्च पौष्टिके || 76 ||
15.m: In a pacifying rite he should meditate on it as crystal-like, and as yellow in a nourishing rite; // 76

15.s:
vaśye kiṃśukapuṣpābhamākṛṣṭau nṛpaśailavat |
māraṇe kajjalābhaṃ tu vidveṣe cāṣapakṣavat || 77 ||
15.d:
वश्ये किंशुकपुष्पाभमाकृष्टौ नृपशैलवत् |
मारणे कज्जलाभं तु विद्वेषे चाषपक्षवत् || 77 ||
15.m:
in subjugation, like a kiṃśuka flower; in attraction, like [the colour of] a mountain of cinnabar;
in eradication, like collyrium; in causing hostility, like the wing of a roller bird; // 77

15.s: uccāṭane ca dhūmrābhaṃ mantraṃ dhyāyejjapetsadā |
15.d: उच्चाटने च धूम्राभं मन्त्रं ध्यायेज्जपेत्सदा |
15.m: and in expulsion, he should meditate on the mantra as smoke-coloured and recite it constantly.

15.s: [parāparabhedena japasya dvaividhyam]
15.d: [परापरभेदेन जपस्य द्वैविध्यम्]
15.m: [Twofold division of japa by the distinction between higher and lower]

15.s: parāparasvarūpeṇa japastu dvividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || 78 ||
15.d: परापरस्वरूपेण जपस्तु द्विविधः स्मृतः || 78 ||
15.m: Japa is remembered to be twofold in nature: higher and lower. // 78

15.s:
paradehaprade (ve ?)śe ca tattvānāṃ preraṇe dvijaṃ |
krūrakarmaṇi sidhyarthaṃ japo jyotirmayassmṛtaḥ || 79 ||
15.d:
परदेहप्रदे (वे ?)शे च तत्त्वानां प्रेरणे द्विजं |
क्रूरकर्मणि सिध्यर्थं जपो ज्योतिर्मयस्स्मृतः || 79 ||
15.m:
For entering another's body and impelling the principles, O twice-born,
and for the success of fierce acts, japa is remembered as consisting of light. // 79

15.s:
tatrāntarlīnamamalaṃ śabdaṃ tu paribhāvayet |
bhuktimuktiprasidhyarthaṃ doṣaduḥkhakṣayaṅkaram || 80 ||
15.d:
तत्रान्तर्लीनममलं शब्दं तु परिभावयेत् |
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रसिध्यर्थं दोषदुःखक्षयङ्करम् || 80 ||
15.m:
There he should contemplate the spotless sound dissolved within,
which brings about the destruction of flaws and sorrow, for the accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation. // 80

15.s:
śāntau tu sarvakāryāṇāṃ sidhyarthamavicārataḥ |
sukhasaubhāgyasidhyarthaṃ tathā'pyādhānakarmaṇi || 81 ||
15.d:
शान्तौ तु सर्वकार्याणां सिध्यर्थमविचारतः |
सुखसौभाग्यसिध्यर्थं तथाऽप्याधानकर्मणि || 81 ||
15.m:
For pacification, for the accomplishment of all undertakings without doubt,
for the attainment of happiness and good fortune, and likewise in an act of revitalisation, // 81

15.s:
japo bhavati śabdākhyastatrāntastu vibhāvayet |
niśāmbukaṇasaṅkāśaprakāśātmajanārdanam || 82 ||
15.d:
जपो भवति शब्दाख्यस्तत्रान्तस्तु विभावयेत् |
निशाम्बुकणसङ्काशप्रकाशात्मजनार्दनम् || 82 ||
15.m:
the japa is termed sonic; there he should contemplate within
Janārdana, whose luminous self resembles a drop of dew at night. // 82

15.s:
hṛtpadmāttu svamantreṇaṃ bhāvayecchabdamutthitam |
nityoditaṃ tu tenaiva prayatnahari (rahi ?) tena tu || 83 ||
15.d:
हृत्पद्मात्तु स्वमन्त्रेणं भावयेच्छब्दमुत्थितम् |
नित्योदितं तु तेनैव प्रयत्नहरि (रहि ?) तेन तु || 83 ||
15.m:
He should contemplate the sound arisen from the heart-lotus by means of his own mantra,
ever-arisen indeed by it, devoid of [forced] effort, // 83

15.s:
prāṇāpannapadasthena bhāvanāmiśritena ca |
japyamānastu vai mantrassarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 84 ||
15.d:
प्राणापन्नपदस्थेन भावनामिश्रितेन च |
जप्यमानस्तु वै मन्त्रस्सर्वकामफलप्रदः || 84 ||
15.m:
resting in the place reached by prāṇa, combined with contemplation;
recited in this way, the mantra indeed bestows the fruit of all desires. // 84

15.s:
p. 132) atha prayatnajanitaṃ śabdamutthāpya nārada |
kevalaṃ tu svamantreṇa baddhalakṣastu pūrvavat || 85 ||
15.d:
प्. 132) अथ प्रयत्नजनितं शब्दमुत्थाप्य नारद |
केवलं तु स्वमन्त्रेण बद्धलक्षस्तु पूर्ववत् || 85 ||
15.m:
p. 132) Now, raising the sound produced with effort, O Nārada,
solely by means of his own mantra, fixing his aim as before, // 85

15.s:
akṣarādakṣaraṃ yātamṛtadoṣeṇa varjitam |
vilambitaṃ ca nātītaṃ tathā'sphuṭapadojjhitam || 86 ||
15.d:
अक्षरादक्षरं यातमृतदोषेण वर्जितम् |
विलम्बितं च नातीतं तथाऽस्फुटपदोज्झितम् || 86 ||
15.m:
proceeding from syllable to syllable, free from all faults,
neither drawn out nor hurried, and devoid of indistinct words, // 86

15.s: cittavikṣeparahitamatyutkṛṣṭadhiyā'nvitam |
15.d: चित्तविक्षेपरहितमत्युत्कृष्टधियाऽन्वितम् |
15.m: free from mental distraction, endowed with an exceedingly elevated intellect.

15.s: [adhikāriṇāṃ sattvādiguṇabhedena japakālabhedaḥ]
15.d: [अधिकारिणां सत्त्वादिगुणभेदेन जपकालभेदः]
15.m: [Difference in the time of japa according to the difference of the qualities of sattva and the others of the qualified practitioners]

15.s: pūrvānhe madhyabhāge'tha aparānhe dinasya tu || 87 ||
15.d: पूर्वान्हे मध्यभागेऽथ अपरान्हे दिनस्य तु || 87 ||
15.m: In the morning, in the middle part, and in the afternoon of the day, // 87

15.s:
kramādvai sātvikādīnāṃ velātrayamudāhṛtam |
evaṃ kṛtvā japanvipra vinivedya ca yāgavat || 88 ||
15.d:
क्रमाद्वै सात्विकादीनां वेलात्रयमुदाहृतम् |
एवं कृत्वा जपन्विप्र विनिवेद्य च यागवत् || 88 ||
15.m:
three times are stated respectively for the sāttvika and other [practitioners].
Reciting thus, O brahmin, and offering it as in a sacrifice, // 88

15.s:
mantrātmā bhagavānviṣṇuracirātsiddhido bhavet |
pratimāsaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha iṣṭvā'rghyakusumādibhiḥ || 89 ||
15.d:
मन्त्रात्मा भगवान्विष्णुरचिरात्सिद्धिदो भवेत् |
प्रतिमासं द्विजश्रेष्ठ इष्ट्वाऽर्घ्यकुसुमादिभिः || 89 ||
15.m:
the Lord Viṣṇu, who is the mantra itself, quickly becomes the bestower of success.
Every month, O best of the twice-born, having worshipped with arghya, flowers, and the like, // 89

15.s: [akṣasūtrasyapunarnavīkaraṇa prācīnasūtraparityāgayorvidhānam]
15.d: [अक्षसूत्रस्यपुनर्नवीकरण प्राचीनसूत्रपरित्यागयोर्विधानम्]
15.m: [Rules for renewing the rosary and discarding the old thread]

15.s:
sandhānamupasaṃhṛtya pūrvaṃ yaccākṣasūtrakam |
visarjanākhyamantreṇa mudrāyuktena nārada || 90 ||
15.d:
सन्धानमुपसंहृत्य पूर्वं यच्चाक्षसूत्रकम् |
विसर्जनाख्यमन्त्रेण मुद्रायुक्तेन नारद || 90 ||
15.m:
withdrawing the integration that was previously in the rosary
with the mantra named dismissal, accompanied by the mudrā, O Nārada, // 90

15.s:
sūtraṃ cābhinavaṃ kṛtvā prāgvatsaṃskṛtya veṣṭayet |
yathāsthitaṃ maṇīnāṃ ca yojanaṃ cācaretpunaḥ || 91 ||
15.d:
सूत्रं चाभिनवं कृत्वा प्राग्वत्संस्कृत्य वेष्टयेत् |
यथास्थितं मणीनां च योजनं चाचरेत्पुनः || 91 ||
15.m:
and making a new cord, having consecrated it as before, he should wind it;
and he should perform the stringing of the beads once again as they were. // 91

15.s:
saṃsnāpya vidhivanmantrī bhūyastasmiṃstu vinyaset |
purā yadāhṛtaṃ caiva sūtracchedabhayāttataḥ || 92 ||
15.d:
संस्नाप्य विधिवन्मन्त्री भूयस्तस्मिंस्तु विन्यसेत् |
पुरा यदाहृतं चैव सूत्रच्छेदभयात्ततः || 92 ||
15.m:
Having bathed them according to rule, the mantrin should once more install in it
what was previously drawn into it; then, out of fear of the cord breaking, // 92

15.s:
pūjāṃ kṛtvā tathā homaṃ tatkarmachidrakāraṇam |
purāṇasūtramādāya vibhajettantujaṃ ca tat || 93 ||
15.d:
पूजां कृत्वा तथा होमं तत्कर्मछिद्रकारणम् |
पुराणसूत्रमादाय विभजेत्तन्तुजं च तत् || 93 ||
15.m:
having performed worship and likewise homa for flaws in that act,
taking the old cord, he should undo that which is made of threads; // 93

15.s:
badhvā pāṣāṇakhaṇḍe ca agādhe'mbhasi nikṣipet |
viṣvaksenīyamantreṇa kṣiptvā'camya smareddharim || 94 ||
15.d:
बध्वा पाषाणखण्डे च अगाधेऽम्भसि निक्षिपेत् |
विष्वक्सेनीयमन्त्रेण क्षिप्त्वाऽचम्य स्मरेद्धरिम् || 94 ||
15.m:
binding it to a piece of stone, he should cast it into deep water;
having thrown it with the Viṣvaksena-mantra and sipped water, he should remember Hari // 94

15.s: mūlamantraṇa viprendra saptavārānsamāhitaḥ |
15.d: मूलमन्त्रण विप्रेन्द्र सप्तवारान्समाहितः |
15.m: with the root-mantra seven times, attentive, O prince among brahmins.

15.s:
iti śrīpañcarātre jayākhyasaṃhitāyāṃ japavidhānaṃ nāma caturdaśaḥ
paṭalaḥ || 14 ||
15.d:
इति श्रीपञ्चरात्रे जयाख्यसंहितायां जपविधानं नाम चतुर्दशः
पटलः || 14 ||
15.m: Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named 'Rules for Japa', in the Jayākhyasaṃhitā of the venerable Pāñcarātra. // 14
